content.arguments:
{"command": "$stage = @'
#Requires -Version 5.1
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Stage the Deskreen + VDD packages into the categorized runtime root, verify them,
    extract VDD, and install Deskreen (no admin required for this script).
.DESCRIPTION
    1. copies both downloads into D:\program_runtime_environment\_downloads\{deskreen,vdd}
    2. extracts the VDD control package into D:\program_runtime_environment\cli\vdd-control\<ver>
    3. verifies the VDD driver catalog + dll signatures and the Deskreen installer signature
    4. installs Deskreen silently (NSIS /S) and reports where it landed
    The virtual display driver itself is installed separately by install-vdd-driver.ps1,
    which must run elevated.
#>
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [string]$Root = 'D:\program_runtime_environment',
    [string]$DeskreenInstaller = 'E:\Deepseek\workspace\conv-20260928-3b54e160\deskreen\deskreen-ce-3.2.16-x64.exe',
    [string]$VddZip = 'E:\Deepseek\workspace\conv-20260928-3b54e160\vdd\VDD.Control.25.7.23.zip',
    [string]$VddVersion = '25.7.23',
    [switch]$SkipDeskreenInstall
)

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

function Step { param([string]$T) Write-Output ''; Write-Output ('=== ' + $T + ' ===') }
function Ok { param([string]$T) Write-Output ('[OK]   ' + $T) }
function Warn { param([string]$T) Write-Output ('[WARN] ' + $T) }
function Fail { param([string]$T) Write-Output ('[FAIL] ' + $T); exit 1 }

Step '1. stage the packages under _downloads'
$dlDeskreen = Join-Path $Root '_downloads\deskreen'
$dlVdd = Join-Path $Root '_downloads\vdd'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $dlDeskreen, $dlVdd | Out-Null
Copy-Item -LiteralPath $DeskreenInstaller -Destination $dlDeskreen -Force
Copy-Item -LiteralPath $VddZip -Destination $dlVdd -Force
Ok ('deskreen -> ' + (Join-Path $dlDeskreen (Split-Path -Leaf $DeskreenInstaller)))
Ok ('vdd zip  -> ' + (Join-Path $dlVdd (Split-Path -Leaf $VddZip)))

Step '2. extract the VDD control package'
$vddDir = Join-Path $Root ('cli\vdd-control\' + $VddVersion)
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $vddDir) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $vddDir -Recurse -Force }
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $vddDir | Out-Null
Expand-Archive -LiteralPath $VddZip -DestinationPath $vddDir -Force
Ok ('extracted -> ' + $vddDir)
Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $vddDir -Force | ForEach-Object { Write-Output ('    ' + $_.Name) }

Step '3. verify signatures'
$items = @(
    (Join-Path $dlDeskreen (Split-Path -Leaf $DeskreenInstaller)),
    (Join-Path $vddDir 'SignedDrivers\x86\VDD\mttvdd.cat'),
    (Join-Path $vddDir 'SignedDrivers\x86\VDD\MttVDD.dll')
)
$bad = 0
foreach ($f in $items) {
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $f)) { Warn ('missing: ' + $f); $bad++; continue }
    $sig = Get-AuthenticodeSignature -LiteralPath $f
    $who = if ($sig.SignerCertificate) { $sig.SignerCertificate.Subject } else { '(none)' }
    Write-Output ('    ' + $sig.Status.ToString().PadRight(8) + ' ' + (Split-Path -Leaf $f) + '  <- ' + $who)
    if ($sig.Status -ne 'Valid') { $bad++ }
}
if ($bad -gt 0) { Fail ('' + $bad + ' file(s) failed signature verification — refusing to install') }
Ok 'all signatures valid'

Step '4. install Deskreen'
if ($SkipDeskreenInstall) { Warn 'skipped by -SkipDeskreenInstall' } else {
    $exe = Join-Path $dlDeskreen (Split-Path -Leaf $DeskreenInstaller)
    Write-Output '    running installer with /S (silent, per-user) ...'
    $p = Start-Process -FilePath $exe -ArgumentList '/S' -Wait -PassThru
    Write-Output ('    installer exit code: ' + $p.ExitCode)
    Start-Sleep -Seconds 5
    $candidates = @(
        (Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Programs\Deskreen CE\Deskreen CE.exe'),
        (Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Programs\deskreen-ce\Deskreen CE.exe'),
        (Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Programs\Deskreen\Deskreen.exe'),
        'C:\Program Files\Deskreen CE\Deskreen CE.exe'
    )
    $found = $candidates | Where-Object { Test-Path -LiteralPath $_ } | Select-Object -First 1
    if ($found) { Ok ('installed: ' + $found) }
    else {
        Warn 'no known install path matched; searching ...'
        $hit = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Programs') -Recurse -Force -Filter '*.exe' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
               Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'deskreen' } | Select-Object -First 3 -ExpandProperty FullName
        if ($hit) { $hit | ForEach-Object { Ok ('found: ' + $_) } } else { Warn 'Deskreen executable not found — the installer may need an interactive run' }
    }
    Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Join-Path $env:APPDATA 'Microsoft\Windows\Start Menu\Programs') -Recurse -Filter '*Deskreen*' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { Ok ('start menu: ' + $_.FullName) }
}

Step 'done'
Write-Output ('VDD package   : ' + $vddDir)
Write-Output ('Driver inf    : ' + (Join-Path $vddDir 'SignedDrivers\x86\VDD\MttVDD.inf'))
Write-Output ('devcon        : ' + (Join-Path $vddDir 'Dependencies\devcon.exe'))
Write-Output 'Next: run install-vdd-driver.ps1 elevated (UAC) to create the virtual display.'
exit 0
'@
$p1 = 'E:\Deepseek\scripts\conv-20260928-3b54e160\stage-and-install-deskreen.ps1'
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($p1, $stage, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
$errors = $null; [System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile($p1, [ref]$null, [ref]$errors) | Out-Null
if ($errors -and $errors.Count) { Write-Output 'PARSE ERRORS:'; $errors | ForEach-Object { $_.Message } } else { Write-Output 'stage script PARSE OK' }
powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File $p1
Write-Output "[stage exit code: $LASTEXITCODE]"", "description": "Stage packages verify and install Deskreen", "justification": "把两个安装包归入 D:\program_runtime_environment 的 _downloads/cli 分类目录并静默安装 Deskreen，这些写入都在工作区之外，workspace-write 沙箱会拒绝。", "sandbox_permissions": "danger-full-access", "timeoutMs": 900000}

{"command": "$stage = @'
#Requires -Version 5.1
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Stage the Deskreen + VDD packages into the categorized runtime root, verify them,
    extract VDD, and install Deskreen (no admin required for this script).
.DESCRIPTION
    1. copies both downloads into D:\program_runtime_environment\_downloads\{deskreen,vdd}
    2. extracts the VDD control package into D:\program_runtime_environment\cli\vdd-control\<ver>
    3. verifies the VDD driver catalog + dll signatures and the Deskreen installer signature
    4. installs Deskreen silently (NSIS /S) and reports where it landed
    The virtual display driver itself is installed separately by install-vdd-driver.ps1,
    which must run elevated.
#>
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [string]$Root = 'D:\program_runtime_environment',
    [string]$DeskreenInstaller = 'E:\Deepseek\workspace\conv-20260928-3b54e160\deskreen\deskreen-ce-3.2.16-x64.exe',
    [string]$VddZip = 'E:\Deepseek\workspace\conv-20260928-3b54e160\vdd\VDD.Control.25.7.23.zip',
    [string]$VddVersion = '25.7.23',
    [switch]$SkipDeskreenInstall
)

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

function Step { param([string]$T) Write-Output ''; Write-Output ('=== ' + $T + ' ===') }
function Ok { param([string]$T) Write-Output ('[OK]   ' + $T) }
function Warn { param([string]$T) Write-Output ('[WARN] ' + $T) }
function Fail { param([string]$T) Write-Output ('[FAIL] ' + $T); exit 1 }

Step '1. stage the packages under _downloads'
$dlDeskreen = Join-Path $Root '_downloads\deskreen'
$dlVdd = Join-Path $Root '_downloads\vdd'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $dlDeskreen, $dlVdd | Out-Null
Copy-Item -LiteralPath $DeskreenInstaller -Destination $dlDeskreen -Force
Copy-Item -LiteralPath $VddZip -Destination $dlVdd -Force
Ok ('deskreen -> ' + (Join-Path $dlDeskreen (Split-Path -Leaf $DeskreenInstaller)))
Ok ('vdd zip  -> ' + (Join-Path $dlVdd (Split-Path -Leaf $VddZip)))

Step '2. extract the VDD control package'
$vddDir = Join-Path $Root ('cli\vdd-control\' + $VddVersion)
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $vddDir) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $vddDir -Recurse -Force }
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $vddDir | Out-Null
Expand-Archive -LiteralPath $VddZip -DestinationPath $vddDir -Force
Ok ('extracted -> ' + $vddDir)
Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $vddDir -Force | ForEach-Object { Write-Output ('    ' + $_.Name) }

Step '3. verify signatures'
$items = @(
    (Join-Path $dlDeskreen (Split-Path -Leaf $DeskreenInstaller)),
    (Join-Path $vddDir 'SignedDrivers\x86\VDD\mttvdd.cat'),
    (Join-Path $vddDir 'SignedDrivers\x86\VDD\MttVDD.dll')
)
$bad = 0
foreach ($f in $items) {
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $f)) { Warn ('missing: ' + $f); $bad++; continue }
    $sig = Get-AuthenticodeSignature -LiteralPath $f
    $who = if ($sig.SignerCertificate) { $sig.SignerCertificate.Subject } else { '(none)' }
    Write-Output ('    ' + $sig.Status.ToString().PadRight(8) + ' ' + (Split-Path -Leaf $f) + '  <- ' + $who)
    if ($sig.Status -ne 'Valid') { $bad++ }
}
if ($bad -gt 0) { Fail ('' + $bad + ' file(s) failed signature verification — refusing to install') }
Ok 'all signatures valid'

Step '4. install Deskreen'
if ($SkipDeskreenInstall) { Warn 'skipped by -SkipDeskreenInstall' } else {
    $exe = Join-Path $dlDeskreen (Split-Path -Leaf $DeskreenInstaller)
    Write-Output '    running installer with /S (silent, per-user) ...'
    $p = Start-Process -FilePath $exe -ArgumentList '/S' -Wait -PassThru
    Write-Output ('    installer exit code: ' + $p.ExitCode)
    Start-Sleep -Seconds 5
    $candidates = @(
        (Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Programs\Deskreen CE\Deskreen CE.exe'),
        (Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Programs\deskreen-ce\Deskreen CE.exe'),
        (Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Programs\Deskreen\Deskreen.exe'),
        'C:\Program Files\Deskreen CE\Deskreen CE.exe'
    )
    $found = $candidates | Where-Object { Test-Path -LiteralPath $_ } | Select-Object -First 1
    if ($found) { Ok ('installed: ' + $found) }
    else {
        Warn 'no known install path matched; searching ...'
        $hit = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Programs') -Recurse -Force -Filter '*.exe' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
               Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'deskreen' } | Select-Object -First 3 -ExpandProperty FullName
        if ($hit) { $hit | ForEach-Object { Ok ('found: ' + $_) } } else { Warn 'Deskreen executable not found — the installer may need an interactive run' }
    }
    Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Join-Path $env:APPDATA 'Microsoft\Windows\Start Menu\Programs') -Recurse -Filter '*Deskreen*' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { Ok ('start menu: ' + $_.FullName) }
}

Step 'done'
Write-Output ('VDD package   : ' + $vddDir)
Write-Output ('Driver inf    : ' + (Join-Path $vddDir 'SignedDrivers\x86\VDD\MttVDD.inf'))
Write-Output ('devcon        : ' + (Join-Path $vddDir 'Dependencies\devcon.exe'))
Write-Output 'Next: run install-vdd-driver.ps1 elevated (UAC) to create the virtual display.'
exit 0
'@
$p1 = 'E:\Deepseek\scripts\conv-20260928-3b54e160\stage-and-install-deskreen.ps1'
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($p1, $stage, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
$errors = $null; [System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile($p1, [ref]$null, [ref]$errors) | Out-Null
if ($errors -and $errors.Count) { Write-Output 'PARSE ERRORS:'; $errors | ForEach-Object { $_.Message } } else { Write-Output 'stage script PARSE OK' }
powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File $p1
Write-Output "[stage exit code: $LASTEXITCODE]"", "description": "Stage packages verify and install Deskreen", "justification": "把两个安装包归入 D:\program_runtime_environment 的 _downloads/cli 分类目录并静默安装 Deskreen，这些写入都在工作区之外，workspace-write 沙箱会拒绝。", "sandbox_permissions": "danger-full-access", "timeoutMs": 900000}

## 你要按键的那一步（必须手动）

按 **`Win + P` → 选「扩展」**（或 `设置 → 系统 → 显示 → 多显示器 → 扩展这些显示器`）。

原因说明白：我尝试用三种拓扑标志调用 `SetDisplayConfig` 都被系统拒绝（返回 **87**），`DisplaySwitch /extend` 也静默无效——程序化切不了。按一次键即可，Windows 之后会记住。顺手把"显示器 2"（虚拟屏）分辨率调到 **1920x1080 或 2560x1440 @60Hz**，越流畅。

## 然后四步就能用

1. 双击桌面 **Deskreen CE** → 点绿色 **Allow / 允许** → 得到网址（形如 `http://192.168.x.x:xxxxx`）+ 二维码
2. **联想那台什么都不用装**，用 Chrome/Edge 打开这个网址
3. Deskreen 里选**虚拟显示器那块**共享（不是主屏）——这才是真扩展而非镜像
4. 联想侧按 `F11` 全屏 → 完成，窗口可以直接从红米拖到联想屏上

**预期**：延迟 100–300 ms，看文档、写代码、放参考资料够用，**看视频打游戏不行**。两台要在同一局域网、路由器别开"AP 隔离"。

## 两个过程中的坑（都解决了，记下来免得再踩）

1. **GitHub 直连超时**（`ETIMEDOUT 20.205.243.166`）。测了 5 个代理：`gh-proxy.com` **669 KB/s** 最快，`ghfast.top` 151、`ghproxy.net` 45，另两个超时——两个包都是走 gh-proxy 下来的。
2. **你那个 `.exe` 是便携版，不是安装包**。我一开始按安装包跑 `/S`，结果它把 445 MB 解包到 `%TEMP%` 里直接运行，而脚本的 `Start-Process -Wait` 一直在等这个常驻程序退出——这就是你看到"卡住"的真正原因。我已把载荷**逐字节校验后固化**到分类目录，并回收了 `%TEMP%` 那 445 MB。

## 安全与回滚

驱动由 **SignPath Foundation** 签名、`devcon.exe` 是微软签名，两者均 **Valid**；装驱动那次 UAC 是你点的"是"。

回滚：`VDD Control.exe` → Uninstall（或提权 `devcon remove Root\MttVDD`）可移除虚拟屏；Deskreen 是便携版，删目录+快捷方式即可。⚠️ VDD 官方提醒：**大版本显卡驱动更新前先卸载它**，否则可能黑屏或显示顺序错乱。

完整用法见 [wireless-second-screen-setup-v1.md](deliverables/conv-20260928-3b54e160/wireless-second-screen-setup-v1.md)，安装日志见 [20260928-175517-vdd-driver-install.log](logs/conv-20260928-3b54e160/20260928-175517-vdd-driver-install.log) 与 [20260928-175714-deskreen-vdd-install.log](logs/conv-20260928-3b54e160/20260928-175714-deskreen-vdd-install.log)。

按完 `Win+P → 扩展` 后如果 Deskreen 列表里能看到第二块屏，就说明全通了；看不到或连不上，把现象告诉我。

                break
            if not chunk:

            data += chunk

        if body:
            print("  --- 正文开头 ---")

The user says: "现在连上了，但这个分辨率咋这么低" — it's connected now, but the resolution is so low.

So the connection works. Now the resolution is low.

What's happening: The Deskreen viewer renders the shared *screen* in the browser. The resolution the Lenovo sees depends on:
1. **The virtual display's resolution** as configured in Windows (the VDD virtual display is probably at a low default, e.g., 800x600 or 1024x768, because the driver's EDID preferred mode might be the first listed resolution — 800x600).
2. **Deskreen's streaming quality settings** (Deskreen lets you choose the quality/resolution in the session: e.g., "Low/High/Best" or the resolution of the captured stream).
3. Whether the user shared the **virtual display** (which is likely at a low res) or the main screen.

Given VDD's `vdd_settings.xml` lists resolutions starting with 800x600 at 30 Hz, Windows may have picked 800x600 as the default mode for the virtual display! That's very likely the cause: **the virtual display is running at 800x600**, so the Deskreen stream looks tiny/low-res.

Fixes:
1. **Set the virtual display's resolution in Windows**: Settings → System → Display → select display 2 (the virtual one) → Display resolution → pick 1920x1080 or 2560x1440 at 60 Hz. Note the XML lists those resolutions at 30 Hz with global refresh rates 60/90/120/144/165/244 available — Windows should offer 60 Hz.
2. Better: **edit `C:\VirtualDisplayDriver\vdd_settings.xml`** to put the desired resolution first (Windows picks the EDID's preferred/first mode) and/or remove the tiny ones, then restart the display device (devcon restart, needs admin/UAC). Or use the **VDD Control app** to set the monitor's resolution/mode (it has a settings editor).
3. Also Deskreen's own quality setting: Deskreen has a "quality" selector in the viewer/session (it streams a compressed image; on high-quality it uses better settings). The viewer page may allow choosing quality. Actually Deskreen's host UI has a dropdown for "Quality" (low/medium/high/very high) and possibly a "resolution" derived from the shared screen.

#Requires -Version 5.1
<#
.SYNOPSIS

param(

    [string]$HardwareId = 'Root\MttVDD',
    [string]$PackageRoot = 'D:\program_runtime_environment\cli\vdd-control\25.7.23',
    [string]$LogPath = 'E:\Deepseek\logs\conv-20260928-3b54e160\vdd-resolution-tune.log'
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
function Log { param([string]$T)
    $line = (Get-Date).ToString('HH:mm:ss') + '  ' + $T
    Write-Output $line
    try { Add-Content -LiteralPath $LogPath -Value $line -Encoding UTF8 } catch { }
}
$parent = Split-Path -Parent $LogPath
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $parent)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $parent | Out-Null }
Set-Content -LiteralPath $LogPath -Value ('VDD resolution tune ' + (Get-Date).ToString('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')) -Encoding UTF8

$isAdmin = ([Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal][Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent()).IsInRole([Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole]::Administrator)
Log ('elevated: ' + $isAdmin)
if (-not $isAdmin) { Log 'FAIL: not elevated'; exit 1 }

$xmlPath = Join-Path $SettingsDir 'vdd_settings.xml'
Log ('settings: ' + $xmlPath)

if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $xmlPath) {
    $stamp = (Get-Date).ToString('yyyyMMdd-HHmmss')
    $bak = $xmlPath + '.bak-' + $stamp

    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path (Split-Path -Parent $keep) | Out-Null
    Copy-Item -LiteralPath $xmlPath -Destination $keep -Force
    Log ('archived: ' + $keep)
} else { Log 'WARN: no existing settings file; writing a fresh one' }

$xml = @'
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<vdd_settings>
    <monitors>
        <count>1</count>
    </monitors>
    <gpu>
        <friendlyname>default</friendlyname>
    </gpu>
    <global>
        <g_refresh_rate>60</g_refresh_rate>
    </global>
    <resolutions>
        <resolution>
            <width>1920</width>
            <height>1080</height>
            <refresh_rate>60</refresh_rate>
        </resolution>
        <resolution>
            <width>2560</width>
            <height>1440</height>
            <refresh_rate>60</refresh_rate>
        </resolution>
        <resolution>
            <width>1600</width>
            <height>900</height>
            <refresh_rate>60</refresh_rate>
        </resolution>
        <resolution>
            <width>1366</width>
            <height>768</height>
            <refresh_rate>60</refresh_rate>
        </resolution>
        <resolution>
            <width>1280</width>
            <height>720</height>
            <refresh_rate>60</refresh_rate>
        </resolution>
        <resolution>
            <width>800</width>
            <height>600</height>
            <refresh_rate>60</refresh_rate>
        </resolution>
    </resolutions>
    <options>
        <CustomEdid>false</CustomEdid>
        <PreventSpoof>false</PreventSpoof>
        <EdidCeaOverride>false</EdidCeaOverride>
        <HardwareCursor>true</HardwareCursor>
        <SDR10bit>false</SDR10bit>
        <HDRPlus>false</HDRPlus>
        <logging>false</logging>
        <debuglogging>false</debuglogging>
    </options>
</vdd_settings>
'@
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($xmlPath, $xml, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
Log 'settings rewritten: preferred mode = 1920x1080@60 (then 2560x1440, 1600x900, 1366x768, 1280x720, 800x600)'

$devcon = Join-Path $PackageRoot 'Dependencies\devcon.exe'
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $devcon)) { Log ('FAIL: devcon missing at ' + $devcon); exit 1 }

Log '--- devcon restart Root\MttVDD (driver re-reads the settings) ---'
Log ((& $devcon restart $HardwareId 2>&1 | Out-String).Trim())
Start-Sleep -Seconds 6
Log '--- devcon status ---'
Log ((& $devcon status $HardwareId 2>&1 | Out-String).Trim())
Log '--- monitor nodes ---'
$mon = & pnputil /enum-devices /class Monitor 2>&1 | Out-String
foreach ($block in ($mon -split "`r?`n`r?`n")) {
    foreach ($l in ($block -split "`r?`n")) {
        if ($l -match 'Device Description|Status|Instance ID') { Log ('    ' + $l.Trim()) }
    }
}
Log 'RESULT: settings applied; if Windows keeps the old mode, set 1920x1080 manually once in Display settings'
exit 0
'@
$wp = 'E:\Deepseek\scripts\conv-20260928-3b54e160\tune-vdd-resolution.ps1'
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($wp, $worker, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
Write-Output ('worker written: ' + $wp)
$stamp = (Get-Date).ToString('yyyyMMdd-HHmmss')
$log = 'E:\Deepseek\logs\conv-20260928-3b54e160\' + $stamp + '-vdd-resolution-tune.log'
Write-Output ('log -> ' + $log)
Write-Output ''
Write-Output '=== 启动提权执行（会弹一次 UAC，请点「是」）==='
try {
    $p = Start-Process -FilePath 'powershell.exe' -Verb RunAs -Wait -PassThru -ArgumentList @(
        '-NoProfile', '-ExecutionPolicy', 'Bypass', '-File', $wp, '-LogPath', $log
    )
    Write-Output ('  elevated exit code: ' + $p.ExitCode)
} catch { Write-Output ('  提权被拒绝或失败: ' + $_.Exception.Message) }
Write-Output ''
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $log) { Get-Content -LiteralPath $log -Raw } else { Write-Output '(没有日志：UAC 可能没确认)' }", "description": "Set virtual display preferred mode to 1080p60", "justification": "修改 C:\VirtualDisplayDriver\vdd_settings.xml 并用 devcon 重启虚拟显示设备属于系统级驱动配置，必须管理员权限，且路径在工作区之外。", "sandbox_permissions": "danger-full-access", "run_in_background": true}

The user says: "没有用看起来仅仅只是显示比例改变了" — "It didn't work; it just looks like the display scale/ratio changed."

So after setting 1920x1080 for the virtual display, the Deskreen viewer on the Lenovo still looks low-res — only the aspect ratio/scale changed.

This is a classic symptom: **the streamed image resolution is still low**, because Deskreen's streaming quality/scale setting caps the capture size. Deskreen has a "Quality" setting that includes a resolution scale (e.g., Low = 640x360, Medium = 1280x720, High = 1920x1080, Best = original?). Actually Deskreen's quality presets: Low/Medium/High/Best (maybe "Original"). If the quality is Low/Medium, the captured frames are downscaled → looks low-res regardless of the desktop resolution.

Also, another possibility: **the image is being scaled by the viewer to fit the browser window** — e.g., the viewer displays the stream in a container that scales it; if the virtual display is 1920x1080 but the Lenovo's browser window shows it at some smaller size, it's still sharp (scaling down = sharp). The user says "看起来仅仅只是显示比例改变了" = the aspect ratio changed → suggesting the desktop resolution did change (from 800x600 4:3 to 1920x1080 16:9 → the aspect ratio change is visible!) but the *sharpness* didn't improve.

That means:
1. The resolution change DID take effect (aspect ratio changed from 4:3 to 16:9) ✓
2. But the *stream* is still low quality → the bottleneck is **Deskreen's quality setting** (bitrate/scale), or the viewer's rendering.

So the fix: in Deskreen, change the **quality preset** to a higher one. Where is it? In Deskreen's host UI: after selecting a screen to share, there's a "Quality" dropdown (values like "Low", "Medium", "High", "Best"/"Original"). Hmm — I recall Deskreen's UI has a quality selector: "Low (360p)", "Medium (720p)", "High (1080p)", "Best (original)". So if it's on Low/Medium, the stream is limited.

Also possible: Deskreen uses `desktopCapturer` with `thumbnailSize` set by quality — Electron's desktopCapturer returns a thumbnail at a *specified size*; Deskreen sets that size based on quality. So yes: quality preset = capture resolution.

Additionally: Deskreen streams over a WebRTC-ish channel (it uses socket.io + WebRTC? Actually Deskreen CE 3.x uses WebRTC for the video). The viewer may show "poor connection" and reduce quality automatically.

Another important factor: **the viewer's display size**. If the Lenovo's browser window is smaller than 1920x1080, the image is downscaled (still sharp, but smaller). If the user expects it to fill the screen, they press F11.

第一次请求包含一条持久基线消息：先是用户全局 `$DSH_HOME/AGENTS.md`，再按从宽泛到具体的顺序包含项目指令链——从项目根目录到会话工作目录的每个目录中所有现有候选文件。去除空白后内容一致的同级文件只渲染一次，因此复制了 `AGENTS.md` 的 `CLAUDE.md` 不会被重复加载。当成功的 `read`、`write` 或 `edit` 调用到达更深的目录后，下一次请求会包含新适用的指令文件；已改变的文件会替换其内容，消失或成为较早候选文件重复项的文件会产生移除通知。
默认设置适合典型检出：`.git` 标记项目根目录，`AGENTS.md` 与 `CLAUDE.md` 是基础候选，`AGENTS.local.md` 与 `CLAUDE.local.md` 是叠加的本地 overlay。只有 `maxBytes` 必填——它限制完整渲染后的基线，让每个部署显式选择自己的提示词预算。

description: "Workspace-instruction context for users and maintainers enabling, sizing, or debugging AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md loading and refresh."

`dsh-agent-instructions` gives agents workspace guidance from user-global and project-level `AGENTS.md`-compatible files. It loads the applicable chain for the first request. It does not watch external edits continuously: successful filesystem operations discover newly relevant nested files and make later changes or removals visible, while session resume reconciles the baseline. `dsh-base` enables this behavior by default, while profiles can disable it. A byte budget bounds the injected context: broader files are omitted before the most specific file is truncated, and an empty chain adds nothing.

The first request includes one durable baseline message with the user-global `$DSH_HOME/AGENTS.md` followed by the project chain — every existing candidate file from the project root down to the session working directory, in broad-to-specific order. Sibling files whose content matches after trimming render once, so a `CLAUDE.md` that duplicates its `AGENTS.md` is not repeated. After a successful `read`, `write`, or `edit` call reaches a deeper directory, the next request includes the newly applicable instruction file; a changed file replaces its content, and a file that disappears or duplicates an earlier candidate produces a removal notice.

The defaults suit a typical checkout: `.git` marks the project root, `AGENTS.md` and `CLAUDE.md` are the base candidates, and `AGENTS.local.md` and `CLAUDE.local.md` are additive local overlays. Only `maxBytes` is required — it caps the complete rendered baseline so each deployment chooses its prompt budget explicitly.
| `instructionFileCandidates` | `['AGENTS.md', 'CLAUDE.md']` | Base file names loaded in each project directory |
- [Documentation standard](../../../docs/AGENTS.md) — what `AGENTS.md` instruction files contain and how they are maintained.

- **Per-directory dedup is content-based** — sibling candidates collapse only when byte-identical after trimming leading and trailing whitespace; a `CLAUDE.md` that symlinks its sibling `AGENTS.md` resolves to the same content and collapses like any duplicate, while a distinct real copy that has drifted from `AGENTS.md` loads in full alongside it.

lines.text: description: "面向用户与维护者的工作区指令上下文说明，用于启用、设置预算或排查 AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md 的加载与刷新。"

`dsh-agent-instructions` 从用户全局和项目级、兼容 `AGENTS.md` 的文件向 agent 提供工作区指引。它为第一次请求加载适用的指令链。它不会持续监视外部编辑：成功的文件系统操作会发现新适用的嵌套文件，并让后续变更或移除可见；恢复会话也会对账基线。`dsh-base` 默认启用此行为，profile 可以禁用。字节预算限制注入的上下文：较宽泛的文件先被省略，最具体的文件最后被截断，空指令链不添加任何内容。
当 agent（智能体）需要依据工作区自身的指令文件工作时，挂载此插件。`dsh-base` 已包含它并给予 65,536 字节预算，因此基于 base 的 profile 仅在需要其他 `maxBytes` 时替换该配置行；没有文件系统提供方的树加载不到任何内容，直到提供方出现。

第一次请求包含一条持久基线消息：先是用户全局 `$DSH_HOME/AGENTS.md`，再按从宽泛到具体的顺序包含项目指令链——从项目根目录到会话工作目录的每个目录中所有现有候选文件。去除空白后内容一致的同级文件只渲染一次，因此复制了 `AGENTS.md` 的 `CLAUDE.md` 不会被重复加载。当成功的 `read`、`write` 或 `edit` 调用到达更深的目录后，下一次请求会包含新适用的指令文件；已改变的文件会替换其内容，消失或成为较早候选文件重复项的文件会产生移除通知。
默认设置适合典型检出：`.git` 标记项目根目录，`AGENTS.md` 与 `CLAUDE.md` 是基础候选，`AGENTS.local.md` 与 `CLAUDE.local.md` 是叠加的本地 overlay。只有 `maxBytes` 必填——它限制完整渲染后的基线，让每个部署显式选择自己的提示词预算。
只有确认项目根标记不存在时，项目根发现才会继续上溯。权限或 I/O 失败会停止发现，并抛出宿主或文件系统提供方的原始错误，而不会选择祖先项目。[根标记元数据决策](../../../.agents/notes/implemented/bug-fix/2026-09-03-root-marker-metadata-failures.zh.md)说明发现为何必须失败，而不能替换为其他根目录。
| 字段 | 默认值 | 含义 |
| `maxBytes` | 必填 | 完整渲染基线消息的上限，单位为字节 |
| `maxSourceBytes` | `1048576` | 渲染前单个源指令文件的上限 |
| `projectRootMarkers` | `['.git']` | 标记项目根目录的目录名 |
| `instructionFileCandidates` | `['AGENTS.md', 'CLAUDE.md']` | 每个项目目录中加载的基础文件名 |
| `localInstructionFileCandidates` | `['AGENTS.local.md', 'CLAUDE.local.md']` | 在基础文件之后加载的本地 overlay 文件名 |
| `dshHome` | `$DSH_HOME` 或 `~/.dsh` | 存放用户全局 `AGENTS.md` 的目录 |
生成的[配置目录](../../../docs/config-catalog.zh.md#deepseek-aidsh-agent-instructions)是每个受支持字段及其 JSDoc 的穷尽式真源。
渲染会优先保留最具体的文件：先丢弃完整的较宽泛文件，再截断最具体的文件，并发出可见的 `Workspace instruction budget ...` 通知，指名被省略与被截断的路径。渲染后的字节数绝不超过 `maxBytes`。超出预算的宽泛文件会被忽略；刷新期间它被视为暂时不可用，而非被移除。
本节解释插件背后的设计决策；可观察行为见[使用本包](#use-this-package)。
该插件建立在一个原则上：工作区指令是持久的对话内容，按 agent 与会话分别归属。基线消息与刷新消息都是普通的带来源 `user/message` 事件，因此与其他历史一样可回放、可压缩、可恢复，模型可见状态总能从会话日志重建。插件拥有完整的 `<system-reminder>` 框架，每条注入消息都原样到达模型。
| [`src/index.ts`](src/index.ts) | 插件入口：pre-step 监听器、`tools/result` touch 跟踪、inbox 组合 |
| [`src/files.ts`](src/files.ts) | 候选发现、项目根搜索、有界流式读取 |
| [`src/render.ts`](src/render.ts) | 指令渲染、预算截断、变更记录 |
| [`src/state.ts`](src/state.ts) | 持久消息来源、版本／digest 缓存、对账 |
| [`src/digest.ts`](src/digest.ts) | SHA-1 内容标识与每目录重复键 |
| — | 不发布运行时不变式伴生入口；回放会容忍未知或格式错误的 workspace source，私有 pending/cache 状态转换由聚焦 pipeline 测试覆盖。 |

在会话第一次符合条件的 `agent/pre-step`，插件组合基线并把它折入进入步骤的批次、紧随已领取的消息之后。成功的第一方 `read`、`write`、`edit` 调用贡献的 touch 会沿父级执行 token 逐层上浮；当外层步骤进入持久历史后，一次投影会把可见会话状态与 inbox 对账，并排入新增、替换或移除。路径与 digest 都未变的内容绝不重复注入。发现跟随结构化文件系统活动，而非 shell 导航，因为每次本地 shell 调用都启动新进程，解析任意 shell 语法不是可靠的文件系统 seam。
每条注入消息都携带带类型的来源及其变更列表；完整基线还携带从规范化发现、优先级、项目根与预算配置派生的标识，匹配的持久消息会确认已排队的基线。模型可见文本不含隐藏状态标记，指令内容或模型可见元数据中的字面 `</system-reminder>` 文本都会被转义，因此仓库控制的文本无法关闭插件控制的框架。
包级约定不够用时阅读以下页面。它们从指令文件格式逐步进入设计决策与穷尽式配置。
- [文档标准](../../../docs/AGENTS.md)——`AGENTS.md` 指令文件包含什么、如何维护。
- [工作区上下文决策记录](../../../.agents/notes/archived/feature/2026-06-24-workspace-context.md)——按 agent／会话隔离与生命周期理由。
- [context 组地图](../README.zh.md)——相邻的请求上下文包。
- [生成的配置目录](../../../docs/config-catalog.zh.md#deepseek-aidsh-agent-instructions)——每个受支持配置字段及其源声明。
第一次请求的派生历史中包含一条持久 user 角色消息，其中按从宽泛到具体的顺序包含有界用户全局指令与项目指令链。可见基线兼容时，恢复会复用该消息。

The following workspace instructions may be relevant to your work. Use them as guidance when applicable. More specific instructions take precedence over broader ones. They do not override system, developer, or direct user instructions.
渲染后基线只追加一次，并保留在派生历史中直到压缩。`maxBytes` 限制完整消息，较宽泛文件在最具体文件截断之前被省略，空指令链不产生 token。
仅追加，位于现有可复用前缀之后。可见基线标识兼容时，恢复会保持复用；不兼容的标识会追加一条完整替代基线，因此发现、优先级、项目根或预算变更只会从该历史位置起影响复用。
### 新发现的 scope 上下文
成功的第一方文件系统调用到达更深目录后，下一次请求会包含一条保留的带来源 `user/message`，其中包含新适用的指令文件。

These instructions apply to work under `packages/app`. Use them as guidance when relevant; more specific instructions take precedence. They do not override system, developer, or direct user instructions.
每个已发现 scope 都会添加有界历史 token，直到压缩。可见会话状态与版本／digest 比较会抑制未更改内容，PTC mode 将同一消息延迟至外层 `run_code` 结果及其所属持久步骤之后。
仅追加；新可见内容位于可复用请求前缀之后，不会使现有 KV-cache 条目失效。
### 已改变或移除的指令上下文
已改变的文件会产生 `Updated instructions from: <path>` 加替换内容。消失或成为同一目录中较早候选文件重复项的候选文件会产生下方移除通知。
The previously loaded instructions from this file no longer apply.
每项已确认变更或移除都是一条受 `maxBytes` 限制的保留历史消息。提供方失败不添加消息，预算省略的更新仍可在后续文件系统 touch 中处理。
仅追加；新可见内容位于可复用请求前缀之后，不会使现有 KV-cache 条目失效。
这些限制说明指令加载何时不合适或需要运维注意。它们是当前包约束，不是任务积压。
- **发现跟随结构化 fs 工具，而非 shell 导航**：更改目录的 `bash` 命令不会触发嵌套指令发现，因为 shell 语法与每次调用的 shell 状态不是可靠的文件系统 seam。
- **刷新由 touch 驱动**：没有 watcher；外部编辑会在下一次成功的第一方 `read`、`write` 或 `edit` 时、恢复对账可见基线时，或进入步骤的 pre-step 恢复被遮蔽基线时可见。
- **候选语义有意保持简单**：不解释小写名称、`.claude/rules/` 与 `@path` import；项目 scope 默认加载 `AGENTS.local.md`／`CLAUDE.local.md` overlay，但用户全局 `$DSH_HOME` scope 没有本地 overlay，其他自定义名称需要显式候选配置。
- **每目录去重基于内容**：同级候选只有在去除首尾空白后字节完全一致时才折叠。`CLAUDE.md` 若 symlink 到同级 `AGENTS.md`，会解析为相同内容并像任何重复项一样折叠；从 `AGENTS.md` 漂移的独立副本则会与它一起完整加载。
- **Symlink 指令文件会跨越信任边界跟随**：最终组件是 symlink 的候选文件会被解析并加载其目标，因此克隆仓库可以将树外文件内容呈现为较低优先级的工作区指引（它绝不覆盖 system、developer 或用户直接下达的指令）。加载不受信任仓库时，请用文件系统策略门禁或 OS 沙箱限制 `ctx.fs`。
- **指令内容受限但不会被摘要**：超出预算的宽泛文件会被省略，最具体文件可能被截断；该插件绝不请求模型压缩指令文本。

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "Get-Process" → "List running processes".

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact command the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact command needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

name.description: Short kebab-case workflow name.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact command the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. - `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

Write-Output '=== 1) 生成提权卸载脚本（移除驱动，无嵌套 here-string） ==='
$workerLines = @(
  '#Requires -Version 5.1'
  '# uninstall-vdd.ps1 - elevated: remove the virtual display device, its driver package and settings'
  '[CmdletBinding()]'
  'param('
  '    [string]$HardwareId = ''Root\MttVDD'','
  '    [string]$PublishedInf = ''oem86.inf'','
  '    [string]$MonitorInstance = ''DISPLAY\MTT1337\1&28a6823a&0&UID256'','
  '    [string]$SettingsDir = ''C:\VirtualDisplayDriver'','
  '    [string]$PackageRoot = ''D:\program_runtime_environment\cli\vdd-control\25.7.23'','
  '    [string]$LogPath = ''E:\Deepseek\logs\conv-20260928-3b54e160\vdd-uninstall.log'''
  ')'
  '$ErrorActionPreference = ''Continue'''
  'function Log { param([string]$T)'
  '    $line = (Get-Date).ToString(''HH:mm:ss'') + ''  '' + $T'
  '    Write-Output $line'
  '    try { Add-Content -LiteralPath $LogPath -Value $line -Encoding UTF8 } catch { }'
  '}'
  '$parent = Split-Path -Parent $LogPath'
  'if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $parent)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $parent | Out-Null }'
  'Set-Content -LiteralPath $LogPath -Value (''VDD uninstall '' + (Get-Date).ToString(''yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'')) -Encoding UTF8'
  '$isAdmin = ([Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal][Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent()).IsInRole([Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole]::Administrator)'
  'Log (''elevated: '' + $isAdmin)'
  'if (-not $isAdmin) { Log ''FAIL: not elevated''; exit 1 }'
  '$devcon = Join-Path $PackageRoot ''Dependencies\devcon.exe'''
  'if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $devcon) {'
  '    Log ''--- devcon remove Root\MttVDD ---'''
  '    Log ((& $devcon remove $HardwareId 2>&1 | Out-String).Trim())'
  '} else { Log ''WARN: devcon not found; skipping device removal'''  '}'
  'Log ''--- pnputil /delete-driver (remove the driver package) ---'''
  'Log ((& pnputil /delete-driver $PublishedInf /uninstall /force 2>&1 | Out-String).Trim())'
  'Start-Sleep -Seconds 3'
  'if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $MonitorInstance -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { } '
  'Log ''--- remove the leftover monitor node if still present ---'''
  'Log ((& pnputil /remove-device $MonitorInstance 2>&1 | Out-String).Trim())'
  'Start-Sleep -Seconds 2'
  'if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $SettingsDir) {'
  '    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $SettingsDir -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue'
  '    Log (''settings dir removed: '' + $SettingsDir + ''  (still exists: '' + (Test-Path -LiteralPath $SettingsDir) + '')'')'
  '} else { Log ''settings dir already absent'' }'
  'Log ''--- devices left in Display / Monitor class ---'''
  '$d = & pnputil /enum-devices /class Display 2>&1 | Out-String'
  'foreach ($b in ($d -split "`r?`n`r?`n")) { foreach ($l in ($b -split "`r?`n")) { if ($l -match ''Device Description|Status'') { Log (''    '' + $l.Trim()) } } }'
  '$m = & pnputil /enum-devices /class Monitor 2>&1 | Out-String'
  'foreach ($b in ($m -split "`r?`n`r?`n")) { foreach ($l in ($b -split "`r?`n")) { if ($l -match ''Device Description|Status'') { Log (''    '' + $l.Trim()) } } }'
  'Log ''RESULT: VDD removal finished'''
  'exit 0'
)

[System.IO.File]::WriteAllLines($wp, $workerLines, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
$errs = $null
[System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile($wp, [ref]$null, [ref]$errs) | Out-Null
if ($errs -and $errs.Count) { Write-Output '  PARSE ERRORS:'; $errs | ForEach-Object { Write-Output ('   ' + $_.Message) } } else { Write-Output ('  OK: ' + $wp) }
$stamp = (Get-Date).ToString('yyyyMMdd-HHmmss')
$log = 'E:\Deepseek\logs\conv-20260928-3b54e160\' + $stamp + '-vdd-uninstall.log'
Write-Output ('  log -> ' + $log)
Write-Output ''
Write-Output '=== 2) 提权移除驱动（请点 UAC「是」） ==='
try {
  $p = Start-Process -FilePath 'powershell.exe' -Verb RunAs -Wait -PassThru -ArgumentList @(
    '-NoProfile', '-ExecutionPolicy', 'Bypass', '-File', $wp, '-LogPath', $log)
  Write-Output ('  elevated exit code: ' + $p.ExitCode)
} catch { Write-Output ('  提权失败/被拒绝: ' + $_.Exception.Message) }
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $log) { Get-Content -LiteralPath $log -Raw } else { Write-Output '  (无日志：UAC 未确认)' }", "description": "Remove VDD driver with elevation", "justification": "完全卸载虚拟显示驱动需要管理员权限（devcon/pnputil 删除驱动包与设备，并清理 C:\VirtualDisplayDriver），这些都在工作区之外。", "run_in_background": true, "sandbox_permissions": "danger-full-access"}

tools.description: Read the current session goal, including the id and revision that update_goal requires.

tools.name: glob
tools.description: Find files, not directories, whose paths match a glob pattern, including hidden and ignored files. Returns up to 100 paths in modification-time order; a larger result keeps the first paths and reports where the complete list was saved.

pattern.description: Glob pattern to match file paths against (e.g. "**/*.ts", "src/**/*.test.js"). A pattern with no "/" matches the basename at any depth, so "*" and "*.ts" both search the whole tree; include a separator to anchor the depth.

path.description: Directory to search in. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path resolves against it.

tools.name: grep
tools.description: Search file contents with a ripgrep regular expression. Returns matching lines with line numbers, grouped by file. Returns up to 250 matches; a larger result reports where the complete match list was saved.

pattern.description: Regular expression to search for (ripgrep syntax).

path.description: File or directory to search. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path resolves against it.

include.description: One glob filter for which files to search (e.g. "*.ts", "*.{js,jsx}"). Not a list; negation is not supported.

tools.name: interrupt_agent
tools.description: Ask a subagent to stop its current work. This call returns without waiting for it to stop. You can continue a direct child's conversation later with send_message. Subagents it started will keep running.

agent_id.description: The id of an agent created under you: your direct child or a deeper descendant.

tools.name: job_kill
tools.description: Request cancellation of a running background job.

job_id.description: Job id returned by the tool that started the background work.

reason.description: Optional short reason, recorded in the log and forwarded to the job.

tools.name: job_list
tools.description: List your background jobs (running and finished) with their ids, kinds, and statuses.

tools.name: job_output
tools.description: Read a background job: output since the previous read for stream jobs, or the result of a finished final-output job.

job_id.description: Job id returned by the tool that started the background work.

wait.description: Block until the job finishes or the timeout expires; a timed-out wait leaves the job running. Defaults to false.

timeout_ms.description: Max wait in milliseconds with wait: true. Defaults to and is capped by configuration.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: List subagents you started, with their ids, labels, and status. running means it is working; inactive means it is not currently working. You will be notified when a subagent finishes; there is no need to keep checking its status. Use send_message to continue the conversation.

scope.description: children (default) lists direct children, which accept send_message in any status. descendants lists the whole tree below you with each entry's parent session id and depth; entries deeper than 1 accept only interrupt_agent.

tools.name: present
tools.description: Declare existing files as final deliverables for the user. Use it when the user needs a separate file, especially Office documents, spreadsheets, and slide decks; prefer your final response when that suffices. The user opens the current files; their contents are not copied.

files.description: Usually the 1-2 most important deliverables; at most 4 per call.

path.description: Path of an existing regular file. Relative paths use the Session working directory.

description.description: Brief description for the user.

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "Get-Process" → "List running processes".

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact command the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact command needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

file_path.description: Path to read, resolved by the filesystem backend.

offset.description: 1-based first line to return. Defaults to 1.

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to return. Defaults to 2000.

tools.name: read_image

file_path.description: Path to the image file, resolved by the filesystem backend.

tools.description: Send a message to an agent. A working agent receives it at its next step; an idle agent starts a new turn with it. Returns delivery confirmation, not the agent's answer.

agent_id.description: The agent id of your direct continuable child, or your direct parent when you are a resident continuable child.

message.description: The message to deliver to the agent.

tools.name: skill

name.description: The exact skill name from the available skills list.

tools.name: subagent
tools.description: Delegate a self-contained task to a subagent (a separate agent that works in its own context) to offload focused, independent work — research, a scoped implementation, an analysis — so it does not consume this conversation's context. The subagent returns its result, not its intermediate steps. It runs in the background by default and returns a subagent id you can continue with `send_message`; you are notified when the run settles.

description.description: A short (3-5 word) description of the delegated task, for display.

run_in_background.description: Defaults to true. Set false only when your next action depends on the result.

tools.name: subagent_fork
tools.description: Delegate a task to a subagent that inherits this conversation: a child agent seeded with all completed turns so far (it does not see the current in-flight turn). Use this when the subtask builds on this conversation's context — a follow-up analysis, a review, a continuation — without consuming this conversation's context for the work itself. description.description: A short (3-5 word) description of the delegated task, for display.

prompt.description: The task for the subagent. It already sees this conversation's completed turns, so build on them freely and state only what is new.

run_in_background.description: Defaults to true. Set false only when your next action depends on the result.

objective.description: Replacement objective; valid only with action edit.

tools.description: Fetch the content of a specific HTTP(S) URL and return it decoded to text.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

name.description: Short kebab-case workflow name.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

content.description: Full UTF-8 text content to write.

# 工作区输出文件存放准则（E:\Deepseek，强制）

本工作区所有对话必须遵守本文件。完整说明见 `policy/output-storage-policy.md`，
机器可读配置为 `policy/storage-policy.json`。本文件由 DSH 自动注入，无需手动读取。

## 规则 0 · 环境事实（必读）

| 事实 | 后果与对策 |
|---|---|
| `E:\Deepseek` 在可移动 **exFAT** 卷上，不支持硬链接 | `write` / `edit` 工具报 `EISDIR: illegal operation on a directory`；改用 PowerShell 直写 |
| Shell 为 **Windows PowerShell 5.1**（本机无 `pwsh`） | 脚本需兼容 5.1；用 `powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File` 调用 |
| 沙箱内 .NET/schannel 取不到 TLS 凭证 | `Invoke-WebRequest`、`curl.exe` 全部 SSL 失败；HTTPS 下载改用 node：`node scripts\conv-20260928-3b54e160\download-file.js <url> <out> [size]` |
| 沙箱临时区 `%TEMP%\dsh-*` 的 chmod/清理被拒 | `pip`、`venv`、`ensurepip` 会因此失败；先 `$env:TEMP=$env:TMP='E:\Deepseek\workspace\<conv-id>\tmp'` |
| 机器 PATH 含 `...\WindowsApps`（Store 别名），先于用户 PATH | 已停用 python/python3 别名占位符，`python` 现解析到 D 盘安装 |
| 写 `D:\`、`%USERPROFILE%` 被沙箱拒绝 | 需申请 `danger-full-access` 提权；这是设计而非故障 |

写文件统一 UTF-8 无 BOM，读文件统一显式 UTF-8：

```powershell
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($path, $text, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
$text = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($path, [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8)
```

## 规则 1 · 先建目录，再产出文件

在写出本次对话的第一个文件之前，先运行（幂等，可重复运行）：

```powershell
powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File E:\Deepseek\tools\New-ConversationWorkspace.ps1
```

它会解析出本次对话的**会话子目录名** `<conv-id>`（形如 `conv-20260928-3b54e160`），
并在每个类别目录下创建它。之后所有输出都写入 `<类别>\<conv-id>\`。

手工创建时按同一规则：`conv-<yyyyMMdd>-<token>`，token = `$env:DSH_SESSION_ID` 中 UUID 的
前 8 位十六进制小写；无会话 ID 时用本地时间 `HHmmss`。**同一对话在所有类别下必须使用同一个
`<conv-id>`**；已登记则复用，不得另建（查 `policy/conversation-registry.json`）。

## 规则 2 · 目录类别（目录名一律英文小写）

| 目录 | 中文名 | 放什么 | 文件命名 |
|---|---|---|---|

## 规则 3 · 命名规范（兼容性优先）

- 目录名与文件名只用 ASCII：`A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ -`；禁止中文、空格、emoji、全角字符。
- 统一小写，词间用 `-`；禁止 Windows 保留名（`CON` `PRN` `AUX` `NUL` `COM1-9` `LPT1-9`）。

2. **再安装**：安装到 `D:\program_runtime_environment\<category>\`，`<category>` 为语言/工具大类，

tools.name: ask_user_question
tools.description: Ask the user a concise question when you need confirmation, a choice, or missing information before proceeding.

questions.description: Questions to ask the user before continuing.

id.description: Stable id for this question; echoed in the answer.

question.description: The specific question to ask the user.

header.description: Optional short heading for the question, such as "Confirm" or "Choose Mode".

options.description: Optional choices to show the user. If you recommend one, put it first and append "(Recommended)" to that label.

description.description: One sentence explaining the tradeoff or impact.

multi_select.description: Whether the user may select more than one option. Defaults to false.

tools.name: create_goal
tools.description: Create a persisted goal that keeps this session working across automatic continuation rounds. Use it when the direct human request is a long-running objective, even if the user did not say "goal"; not for single-turn work.

objective.description: The concrete completion objective inferred from the direct human request.

max_goal_rounds.description: Optional positive safe-integer limit on automatic continuation rounds.

tools.name: edit
tools.description: Edit an existing UTF-8 text file by replacing literal text.

file_path.description: Path to edit, resolved by the filesystem backend.

new_string.description: Literal replacement text. Use an empty string to delete the match.

replace_all.description: Replace all matches. Defaults to false; when false, old_string must appear exactly once.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact operation the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact file operation needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

tools.name: exit_plan_mode
tools.description: Use only in plan mode. Present your plan for the user's review and, on approval, leave plan mode. The user may approve (carry out the plan from your next step) or keep planning — their feedback comes back in the tool result; revise and present again.

plan.description: The complete plan, as markdown, starting with a # heading that names it.

tools.name: get_goal
tools.description: Read the current session goal, including the id and revision that update_goal requires.

tools.name: glob
tools.description: Find files, not directories, whose paths match a glob pattern, including hidden and ignored files. Returns up to 100 paths in modification-time order; a larger result keeps the first paths and reports where the complete list was saved.

pattern.description: Glob pattern to match file paths against (e.g. "**/*.ts", "src/**/*.test.js"). A pattern with no "/" matches the basename at any depth, so "*" and "*.ts" both search the whole tree; include a separator to anchor the depth.

path.description: Directory to search in. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path resolves against it.

tools.name: grep
tools.description: Search file contents with a ripgrep regular expression. Returns matching lines with line numbers, grouped by file. Returns up to 250 matches; a larger result reports where the complete match list was saved.

pattern.description: Regular expression to search for (ripgrep syntax).

path.description: File or directory to search. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path resolves against it.

include.description: One glob filter for which files to search (e.g. "*.ts", "*.{js,jsx}"). Not a list; negation is not supported.

tools.name: interrupt_agent
tools.description: Ask a subagent to stop its current work. This call returns without waiting for it to stop. You can continue a direct child's conversation later with send_message. Subagents it started will keep running.

agent_id.description: The id of an agent created under you: your direct child or a deeper descendant.

tools.name: job_kill
tools.description: Request cancellation of a running background job.

job_id.description: Job id returned by the tool that started the background work.

reason.description: Optional short reason, recorded in the log and forwarded to the job.

tools.name: job_list
tools.description: List your background jobs (running and finished) with their ids, kinds, and statuses.

tools.name: job_output
tools.description: Read a background job: output since the previous read for stream jobs, or the result of a finished final-output job.

job_id.description: Job id returned by the tool that started the background work.

wait.description: Block until the job finishes or the timeout expires; a timed-out wait leaves the job running. Defaults to false.

timeout_ms.description: Max wait in milliseconds with wait: true. Defaults to and is capped by configuration.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: List subagents you started, with their ids, labels, and status. running means it is working; inactive means it is not currently working. You will be notified when a subagent finishes; there is no need to keep checking its status. Use send_message to continue the conversation.

scope.description: children (default) lists direct children, which accept send_message in any status. descendants lists the whole tree below you with each entry's parent session id and depth; entries deeper than 1 accept only interrupt_agent.

tools.name: present
tools.description: Declare existing files as final deliverables for the user. Use it when the user needs a separate file, especially Office documents, spreadsheets, and slide decks; prefer your final response when that suffices. The user opens the current files; their contents are not copied.

files.description: Usually the 1-2 most important deliverables; at most 4 per call.

path.description: Path of an existing regular file. Relative paths use the Session working directory.

description.description: Brief description for the user.

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "Get-Process" → "List running processes".

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact command the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact command needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

tools.name: read
tools.description: Read a UTF-8 text file and return line-numbered content.

file_path.description: Path to read, resolved by the filesystem backend.

offset.description: 1-based first line to return. Defaults to 1.

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to return. Defaults to 2000.

tools.name: read_image
tools.description: Read a PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF file and return the image itself. Large images are downscaled automatically; do not install image libraries or create thumbnails to inspect an image.

file_path.description: Path to the image file, resolved by the filesystem backend.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a message to an agent. A working agent receives it at its next step; an idle agent starts a new turn with it. Returns delivery confirmation, not the agent's answer.

agent_id.description: The agent id of your direct continuable child, or your direct parent when you are a resident continuable child.

message.description: The message to deliver to the agent.

tools.name: skill
tools.description: Load the full instructions for a skill. Call it before acting on a task that names or clearly matches a skill in the session skill catalog.

name.description: The exact skill name from the available skills list.

tools.name: subagent
tools.description: Delegate a self-contained task to a subagent (a separate agent that works in its own context) to offload focused, independent work — research, a scoped implementation, an analysis — so it does not consume this conversation's context. The subagent returns its result, not its intermediate steps. It runs in the background by default and returns a subagent id you can continue with `send_message`; you are notified when the run settles.

description.description: A short (3-5 word) description of the delegated task, for display.

prompt.description: The complete, self-contained task for the subagent. It does not share this conversation's context, so include everything it needs.

tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

$target = 'D:\Application\dsh'

Write-Output '=== 1) 装前检查 ==='
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath 'D:\Application')) { Write-Output '  D:\Application 不存在，将创建' } else { Write-Output '  D:\Application 已存在' }
Write-Output ('  目标目录当前状态: ' + $(if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $target) { '已存在（内容：' + (@(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $target -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Count) + ' 项）' } else { '不存在（将新建）' }))

Write-Output ''
Write-Output '=== 2) 静默安装到 ' + $target + ' ==='

Start-Sleep -Seconds 8

Write-Output ''
Write-Output '=== 3) 安装结果 ==='

  }
  Write-Output '  --- 卸载器 ---'
  Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $target -Force -File -Filter '*nstall*.exe' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { Write-Output ('      ' + $_.FullName) }
} else {
  Write-Output ('  [失败] 目标目录未生成，安装器退出码 ' + $p.ExitCode)
}

Write-Output ''
Write-Output '=== 4) 快捷方式 / 开始菜单 ==='
foreach ($r in @((Join-Path $env:APPDATA 'Microsoft\Windows\Start Menu\Programs'), (Join-Path $env:PROGRAMDATA 'Microsoft\Windows\Start Menu\Programs'), (Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'Desktop'), (Join-Path $env:PUBLIC 'Desktop'))) {
  Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $r -Recurse -Filter '*Harness*' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { Write-Output ('  ' + $_.FullName) }
  Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $r -Recurse -Filter '*dsh*' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { Write-Output ('  ' + $_.FullName) }
}
Write-Output ''
Write-Output '=== 5) 安装后是否自动启动、是否生成卸载登记 ==='
Get-Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.ProcessName -match '(?i)harness|dsh' } | Select-Object Id, ProcessName, Path | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 160
$keys = 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\*','HKLM:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\*'
Get-ItemProperty $keys -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.DisplayName -match '(?i)harness|dsh' } | Select-Object DisplayName, DisplayVersion, InstallLocation, UninstallString | Format-List | Out-String -Width 200", "description": "Install DSH desktop to chosen path", "justification": "按你指定的 D:\Application\dsh 静默安装官方桌面端，需要写入工作区之外的目录并创建快捷方式与注册表项。", "run_in_background": true, "sandbox_permissions": "danger-full-access", "timeoutMs": 900000}

summary.text:
## Primary Request and Intent
- Original (Chinese): 制定"以后各对话输出文件存放准则"——建立交付/日志/执行脚本等文件夹（每个对话在其中再建子文件夹）；缺失运行环境可加到 `D:\program_runtime_environment` 且**不同环境必须归类**；文件夹名尽量英文以免兼容问题；**制成配置确保其他对话也照此执行**。
- Follow-ups in order: 安装 python → 查问 `D:\program_runtime_environment` 里非 python 文件是否无用 → 解释 `README.md` / `registry.json` 用途 → "帮我安装插件市场这个插件" → "升级harness版本" → "查看是否升级" → "我的电脑上有超级小爱建有本地知识库你如何可以调用" → "算了，不搞这个了" → 两台电脑互通方案（含屏幕拓展、一套键鼠控两机，**不想用远程控制软件**）→ 聚焦"无线投屏/屏幕拓展" → 选定 Deskreen 并同意装虚拟显示驱动。
- Most recent intent: install Deskreen CE (portable) + VDD virtual display driver for true wireless screen extension; user approved "装驱动 + Deskreen（真扩展，推荐）".

## Key Technical Concepts
- DSH (`@deepseek-ai/dsh`) instruction injection: user-global `$DSH_HOME\AGENTS.md` (all conversations) + project chain `AGENTS.md`.

Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.
