model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

The error says "PositionalParameterNotFound" → a parameter was passed positionally. Which one? Possibly `-Notes` with a value containing something? Or `-Source`? Hmm.

   Wait: earlier (for Deskreen) the same call style worked: `-Category cli -Name deskreen -Version '3.2.16' -InstallPath $dst -BinPaths @($dst) -Source '...' -Notes '...'`. That worked.

装好了，**装在你要的 `D:\Application\dsh`**。

## 结论：官方确实出了桌面端，且签名可证

| 项 | 值 |
|---|---|
| 来源 | `https://download.deepseek.com/desktop/dsh-latest-windows-x64.exe`（官方下载页 https://www.deepseek.com/download/ 上的链接） |
| SHA-256 | `D61CD8882F8B8A1251144320493AD27920D15139503EBA2465B9579EEE720CFC` |
| 签名 | **Valid** — `CN=Hangzhou DeepSeek Artificial Intelligence Co., Ltd.`，GlobalSign **EV 代码签名** + DigiCert 时间戳 |

无 zip/便携版、无 ARM64 版（探测均 404），Windows 只有这个 NSIS 安装包。因为它是**向导式**安装器（包内可见"选择安装位置/浏览"页），`/D=` 参数生效，所以能按你的路径装。

## 安装结果（已逐项验证）

```
命令     : dsh-latest-windows-x64.exe /S /D=D:\Application\dsh
退出码   : 0     耗时 18.1 秒
目录     : D:\Application\dsh        1015 MB / 9772 个文件
主程序   : DeepSeek Harness.exe      233.2 MB   FileVersion 0.2.0-rc.2   签名 Valid
自带运行时: Node 24.21.0（OpenJS Foundation 签名）
附带工具 : ripgrep、libreoffice-kit（LibreOffice 26.8.0.3），均 DeepSeek 签名
卸载器   : D:\Application\dsh\Uninstall DeepSeek Harness.exe
快捷方式 : 桌面 + 开始菜单 各一个「DeepSeek Harness」
卸载登记 : HKCU → DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2
环境登记 : registry.json 已加 `cli / dsh-desktop 0.2.0-rc.2`（现共 4 项）
```

## ⚠️ 两件必须知道的事

**1. 别急着点菜单栏的「Manage dsh command」**
它是 0.2.0-rc.2，而**当前这个对话就跑在本机 0.1.7-rc.2 的 CLI 上**。那个菜单项会安装/更新全局 `dsh` 命令，等于替换掉正在运行的这份 CLI（需要重启宿主）。想升级 CLI 时告诉我，我先备份再升。

**2. 它和 CLI 共用 `~/.dsh`**
里面是 `profiles`（47.5 MB，含你的 `web` profile 和已装插件）、`sessions`、`.credentials.yaml`。新版桌面端首次启动可能会对这份共用状态做迁移/写入——**所以我正在后台把 `~/.dsh` 整份备份到** `workspace\conv-20260928-3b54e160\dsh-home-backup-<时间戳>\`（约 64 MB，还在拷，exFAT 小文件较慢）。备份完我会告诉你。

## 接下来你可以

- **直接启动**：双击桌面「DeepSeek Harness」，或运行 `D:\Application\dsh\DeepSeek Harness.exe`（装卸载后不会自动启动）
- 要我现在**帮你启动并做一次冒烟测试**吗？（会弹首次启动引导）
- 安装包（275.9 MB）还留在 `D:\program_runtime_environment\_downloads\dsh-desktop\`，**要删说一声**

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

name.description: Short kebab-case workflow name.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

block.text:
不是故障，是**设计上的隔离**：插件按 **profile** 分开，而桌面客户端用的是另一个 profile。

## 实测证据

```
~/.dsh/profiles/
├─ web\       47.5 MB / 1823 文件   ← 你的插件装在这里
├─ desktop\   0 MB / 4 文件         ← 桌面客户端用的就是它（10-02 09:34 首次启动时新建）
└─ node_modules\
```

| profile | 用户插件 | 启用的 bundles | node_modules |
|---|---|---|---|
| **web**（旧 CLI） | **2 个**：`dshmarket@^1.66.2`、`@dsh-use/wallpaper-engine@0.6.0` | base、web-app、**dshmarket**、**wallpaper-engine** | 有（16 个顶层模块） |
| **desktop**（客户端） | **0 个** | 只有内置的 base、web-app | **无** |

`desktop` profile 里仅有 4 个种子文件（`package.json`／`cordis.yml`／`cordis.patch.yml`／`pnpm-workspace.yaml`），是客户端首次启动时自动生成的**空壳**——所以它在客户端里当然看不到。

## 而且这不是能"顺手搬过去"的事

`@deepseek-ai/dsh` 官方 README 原文（中文版）：

> **`desktop` 名称保留给 Electron 持有的 profile，因此 CLI 会拒绝针对它的启动、配置 dump 和插件管理请求。**

意思是：**旧 CLI 根本无法往 `desktop` profile 里装插件**（`dsh plugin --profile desktop …` 会被直接拒绝）。这是刻意的隔离，防止命令行宿主和 Electron 宿主争抢同一份 profile。

## 怎么让它们在客户端里出现

**在桌面客户端内部重新安装**（0.2.0 已内置插件管理，发布说明明确写了"支持管理插件"、能区分"已安装／不兼容／内置"）。

三点注意：

1. **别照抄 `web` 里的版本号**——那两个插件是为 **0.1.7-rc.2** 解析出来的，客户端是 **0.2.0-rc.2**；让客户端的插件管理自己挑兼容版本。
2. ⚠️ **别手工改 `desktop` profile**：它由 Electron 独占，装进不兼容插件可能导致客户端起不来，而 CLI 又拒绝管理它，到时只能手改文件恢复。所以走客户端内置入口。
3. 老环境不受影响：`dsh --profile web` 仍是那套带 `dshmarket` + `wallpaper-engine` 的环境。两边**共用同一份 `~/.dsh`**（会话、凭据、storages 共享），只是 profile 不同——这也解释了为什么你在客户端里**能看到历史会话，却看不到插件**。

tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

The user wants:
1. Extend local AI tools for me (the agent): image recognition (识图), image generation (生成图片) — local AI.
2. Locally train an industrial inspection model based on 紫东太初 (Zidong Taichu / "Taichu") open-source model + existing public professional inspection datasets.
3. They want me to detect their PC configuration to determine the optimal plan.
4. They want NPU utilization to leverage this machine's performance.
5. **Don't install/deploy immediately — give a plan for them to choose.**

So this turn: hardware/software recon + a plan document with options. No installation.

Key facts I already know:
- Redmi 16 Pro 2026, Windows 11 Home China 25H2 (build 26200.9457), Intel **Arc B370** GPU (that's a discrete Intel Arc B-series GPU — "B370" is a Battlemage-based mobile GPU), 32 GB RAM? (need to check), 3200x2000 165Hz display.
- The machine is a laptop: "Redmi 16 Pro 2026" — hmm, Redmi Book? The GPU is Intel Arc B370 (discrete, Battlemage, ~Xe2). Intel Core Ultra (Series 2, "Lunar Lake" or "Arrow Lake-H"?) — if it's a Core Ultra 200V (Lunar Lake), it has a **NPU 4 (48 TOPS)**. If Arrow Lake-H, the NPU is 13 TOPS (NPU 3.5?) — hmm. Actually "Core Ultra 200H (Arrow Lake-H)" has an NPU 3 (13 TOPS); "Lunar Lake (200V)" has NPU 4 (48 TOPS). The presence of Arc B370 discrete GPU suggests... hmm, B370 is a discrete GPU (Battlemage, 10 Xe cores?). Redmi Book Pro 16 2026? Let me detect.

So I need to detect:
- CPU model (Intel Core Ultra ...?), cores/threads, NPU presence.
- GPU: Intel Arc B370 (discrete) + integrated (Arc iGPU in the CPU).
- RAM (capacity, speed, type).
- Storage: free space on C/D/E (E is a card, D 380 GB free, C 140 GB free).
- NPU: Intel NPU — driver version, whether Intel NPU driver is installed, whether OpenVINO detects it.
- Existing AI runtimes: Python 3.14.7 (very new — compatibility risk for PyTorch/OpenVINO!), Node 24, pnpm.
- OS build, whether WSL2 available (for Linux-only toolchains), virtualization enabled.
- DirectML / ONNX Runtime availability.

Then produce a plan with options:
**A. 本地视觉工具（给 agent 用）**
- 识图（图像理解/OCR/目标检测）: 
  - Option 1: OpenVINO + Intel NPU/GPU for local vision models (e.g., Qwen2.5-VL / InternVL via OpenVINO GenAI; or smaller: YOLO, PaddleOCR, SAM).
  - Option 2: Ollama (easy, GPU) — but the user wants NPU → OpenVINO is the Intel-native path for NPU.
  - Option 3: LM Studio (GGUF, GPU/NPU? LM Studio added Intel NPU support? Hmm, LM Studio supports Vulkan for Arc; NPU support came via "llama.cpp + OpenVINO backend"? LM Studio 0.3.x added a runtime for Intel NPU? Not certain — I should verify with web search.)
- 生成图片: Stable Diffusion XL / SD 1.5 / Flux (schnell) — on Intel Arc via **OpenVINO** (diffusers OpenVINO pipeline) or **Stable Diffusion WebUI (DirectML fork)** or **ComfyUI + IPEX-LLM/OpenVINO**. For Arc B-series (Xe2), OpenVINO is the best-supported (Intel's own), with NPU offload for some parts (NPU is typically for LLM/CNN inference, not diffusion UNet — NPU can run some SD pipelines but Vision/UNet on NPU has limited support; Intel's NPU supports specific models).

## 紫东太初 ZDTaichu5.0 9B 开源：让 AI 看懂真实三维现实世界

发布时间: 2026-09-28

分享到:

 【字体：大   中   小】

9月15日，中国科学院自动化研究所紫东太初团队正式开源 ZDTaichu5.0-9B 通用多模态大模型。不同于主要面向数字内容的通用多模态模型，ZDTaichu5.0-9B 定位为“面向物理世界的通用多模态大模型”，推动人工智能从“看懂图文”走向“理解空间、规划行动、持续完成任务”。

ZDTaichu5.0-9B作为参数规模为9B的中小体量多模态模型，在同规模通用模型中实现了“空间与具身理解”的最强能力。在九项国际空间理解测试中，该模型拿下八项同组别第一名。

**ZDTaichu5.0-9B****四大核心特征**

空间理解与具身推理能力突出。该模型构建了“识别物体位置—推演三维空间关系—判断操作条件—输出行动决策”的四层思考链条，能够理解现实世界中的远近、方位、遮挡关系。在杂乱桌面目标定位、模拟转身视角变换、空闲区域判断等测试中，该模型均能精准锁定目标或可用空间，输出可直接供机器人使用的点位。为家庭机器人、工业机械臂“看得准、转不晕、知道往哪里下手”提供有力支撑。

通用能力与具身能力协同提升。行业长期存在“强化三维空间判断力与具身推理能力，往往牺牲图文识别、OCR、数学、代码调用等基础本领”的技术难题。ZDTaichu5.0-9B实现了两全：空间具身能力大幅提升的同时，图文识别、OCR、数学、代码调用等通用能力依旧保持优秀水平，避免顾此失彼。

整套空间多模态数据生产管线方案开放。区别于多数开源模型仅放出训练成品文件，本次开源一并公开了完整可复用的空间多模态数据生产全流程方案，涵盖原始素材清洗、样本筛选、标签制作、模型微调、强化学习优化等环节。外部机构和企业可直接复用，解决“有权重、无数据处理管线”的行业痛点，便于科研机构、机器人企业利用自有仿真画面、工厂实拍视频、实验室记录加工训练素材，训练适配自身业务场景的AI。

算力能耗低。模型搭载自适应循环推理机制，能够判断问题难度：简单任务直接输出，不额外消耗算力；复杂空间推理任务则在内部反复推演校验，投入更多计算资源。同时设计多重保障机制，避免陷入无限循环；复杂长链条机器人任务可接收环境实时反馈，不断更新全局判断。整套设计在不明显增加耗时和算力消耗的前提下，提高复杂现实任务正确率。

**在科研、工厂真实场景落地验证**

跑分优秀只是基础，能不能在现实环境干活，才是检验人工智能的关键。ZDTaichu5.0-9B 已经在科学实验、智能制造两大场景完成真实测试。

在科研自动化场景，它可以接收科研人员的自然语言问题，自主调用计算工具做求解，交叉校验不同算法的结果，自动绘制分析图表，完成从提问到生成报告的部分科研工作。面对实体化学、物理实验，AI盯着机械臂做液体转移等操作，实时跟踪样品位置、实验进度，根据现场情况调整下一步动作，助力实现自动化干湿实验闭环。

在工厂智能制造场景，面对车间里货架拥挤、零件外观相似、物体被遮挡等现实麻烦，它能够读懂文字工单，自主规划整套动作：从货架取件、移动避障，再到放置到位，把纸上的工作指令，转化为机器人可以执行的完整流程。

**开放国产大模型生态，推动AI走进物理世界**

ZDTaichu5.0-9B的开源，把理解三维物理世界的整套技术向行业开放，降低具身智能的研发门槛。让更多开发者、科研人员基于这套底座开展创新，推动人工智能真正走进现实，为机器人、自动化科研、工业智能化提供底层支撑。

ZDTaichu5.0-9B 已正式上线。期待广大开发者、科研伙伴、产业伙伴基于ZDTaichu5.0-9B 开展创新探索、产业落地实践，共同丰富国产大模型生态，推动AI技术赋能千行百业。

## Introduction[#](#introduction)

ZDTaichu5.0-9B is a multimodal foundation model for general visual understanding, spatial reasoning, agentic tool use, and embodied-AI research. It combines a Qwen3.5-9B language backbone with a C-RADIOv4-H vision encoder, supports text, images and videos with any-resolution visual input.

Within the 9B-scale general-purpose VLMs compared in this release blog, ZDTaichu5.0-9B retains first-tier general visual understanding while supporting spatial reasoning, high-level embodied VLM reasoning, and agent tasks under the reported evaluation settings. Rather than trading broad visual competence for specialization, it layers a more comprehensive spatial, embodied, and agent capability profile on top of a strong general-vision foundation.

The model accepts text, one or more images, and video. It is designed for:

-   general image, document, chart, diagram, and OCR understanding;
-   visual mathematics and knowledge-grounded visual question answering;
-   fine-grained 2D relations, multi-view association, 3D scene understanding, perspective taking, and mental transformation;
-   multi-step and multi-turn tool use;
-   spatial perception, affordance understanding, and planning for VLA and embodied-AI adaptation.

## Highlights[#](#highlights)

-   **Strong general vision and broad capabilities:** remains in the leading group of 9B-scale general-purpose VLMs across images, documents, charts, diagrams, OCR, visual mathematics, multiple images and video, while extending to spatial reasoning, high-level embodied understanding and multi-step agent tasks.
-   **Leading spatial reasoning and embodied understanding:** leads spatial capability among the compared 9B-scale general-purpose VLMs, with strong results on SparBench, ViewSpatial, MMSI-Bench and MindCube-tiny. Scores of 48 on ERQA and 56 on RoboSpatial cover scene reasoning, affordances and interaction-oriented understanding.
-   **Strongest agent capability among the compared 9B-scale general-purpose VLMs:** leads the reported TAU2-Bench (87.7) and Claw-Eval (71.4) comparisons, and reaches 93.7 on IFEval.
-   **Entropy-Gated Adaptive Recurrent Reasoning:** Dynamically allocates additional recurrent refinement steps in latent space to more challenging tokens, enabling greater computational depth where needed and improving reasoning performance on complex tasks.

## Model Overview[#](#model-overview)

| Item | Specification |
| --- | --- |
| Model type | Multimodal causal language model with vision encoder |
| Language backbone | Qwen3.5-9B LLM Decoder |
| Vision backbone | C-RADIOv4-H |
| Context length | Up to 128K tokens |
| Vision resolution | Any-resolution visual input |
| Input modalities | Text, single image, multiple images, and video |

## Adaptive recurrent reasoning[#](#adaptive-reasoning)

ZDTaichu5.0-9B uses entropy gating to allocate inference computation dynamically. The uncertainty of the current token determines whether to further refine hidden states in latent space, adapting reasoning depth during generation.

1.  **Trigger recurrence by uncertainty:** After a standard forward pass, output entropy measures uncertainty for the current token. Low-entropy tokens proceed directly to output, while high-entropy tokens trigger repeated computation through an intermediate layer block.
2.  **Refine states in latent space:** Damped, anchored updates progressively refine hidden states, allocating additional computation to difficult tokens.
3.  **Stop using convergence signals:** KL divergence and hidden-state residuals guide stopping, dynamically controlling the depth of recurrent computation.
4.  **Select an output from the trajectory:** Trajectory readout selects the lowest-risk state, with rollback when needed.

The shape consists of a circular frustum at the bottom and a triangular frustum (likely a frustum of a triangular pyramid) on top.

-   **Option A:** This shows a vertical cross-section. A vertical plane passing through the central axis of both shapes would intersect the circular frustum in a large isosceles trapezoid and the triangular frustum in a smaller isosceles trapezoid centered on top of it. This matches the shape in A.
-   **Option B:** This shows a circle. A horizontal plane cutting through the bottom circular frustum (below the junction with the top part) would produce a circle (or an annulus, which is a filled ring shape, often represented as a circle in 2D cross-sections if the thickness isn't emphasized). Even if it's just the top surface, it's a circle. This is a possible cross-section.
-   **Option C:** This shows a vertical cross-section where the top part is a thin trapezoid and the bottom is a wider trapezoid. This could occur if the vertical cut passes through the central axis of the bottom circular frustum (producing the wide trapezoid) but is offset from the central axis of the top triangular frustum (cutting through the side, producing a thin trapezoid). This is geometrically possible if the two parts are not perfectly aligned or if the cut is taken at a specific angle/position.
-   **Option D:** This shows a single trapezoid. For a vertical cross-section to produce only a single trapezoid, the plane would have to intersect the bottom part in a trapezoid and _not_ intersect the top part in any 2D area (i.e., intersect it only at a line or point), or the top part would have to be non-existent. However, since the top part is stacked on the bottom part, any vertical plane that cuts through the bottom part (to get a trapezoid) must also pass through the top part (unless it's a tangent plane, which is a degenerate case and unlikely to produce the clean shape D). More simply, a horizontal cut produces a circle, and a slanted cut produces curved sides. A vertical cut produces a composite shape (top on bottom). Option D represents a single shape without the "stacked" appearance, which is impossible for a cross-section of this combined solid.

Therefore, D cannot be a cross-section.

I now have the essential facts about ZDTaichu5.0-9B:
- **Architecture**: Qwen3.5-9B language backbone + **C-RADIOv4-H** vision encoder, 128K context, text/image/video, any-resolution.
- Capabilities: general vision, OCR, spatial reasoning, embodied, agent/tool use.
- Benchmarks: strong.
- Sources: GitHub / ModelScope / HuggingFace.
- The CAS announcement says the data-production pipeline + **fine-tuning** + RL optimization are open-sourced.

Note: "Qwen3.5-9B" backbone → so fine-tuning tooling would follow Qwen-family recipes (ms-swift / LLaMA-Factory may support it; but the new "adaptive recurrent reasoning" (entropy-gated latent recurrence) is a custom architecture → fine-tuning support depends on the repo's own code. That's a key risk: **a custom architecture may not be supported by mainstream fine-tuning frameworks** → fine-tuning may require the official code, and Intel Arc/XPU support for that code is unlikely (probably CUDA-only).

This is an important honest point for the plan:
- Training 9B ZDTaichu locally on Arc iGPU: the official training code likely assumes NVIDIA CUDA (DeepSpeed/FlashAttention). Intel XPU support is doubtful. So:
  - Local training of ZDTaichu 9B: **unrealistic** (both compute AND framework support).
  - Local LoRA of the *language backbone* (Qwen3.5-9B) via generic frameworks: possible on CPU/iGPU but very slow; Arc XPU + unsloth/bnb not supported (bitsandbytes is CUDA-only). So QLoRA on Intel GPU is essentially not available today.
  - → **Recommendation: local = inference + data/annotation pipeline + small-model training (YOLO/Anomalib); 9B fine-tuning = cloud GPU rental (cheap, e.g., 4090/A100 by hour) or a rented workstation.**

## 0. 结论速览（先看这段）

1. **这台机器非常适合"推理"，不适合"训练 9B"。**
   - 核显（Arc B370）**没有独立显存**，18.4 GB 是共享系统内存 —— 实测 `Dedicated Memory 128 MB / Shared 18413 MB`。
   - 32 GB 内存够跑 9B INT4 推理与 SDXL，但**不够 9B 微调**（LoRA bf16 也要 ~20 GB 以上且会被内存带宽卡死）。
2. **NPU 只能推理，不能训练**（INT8/INT4 定点加速单元）。它能显著加速 OCR / 缺陷检测 / ≤3B 小模型，但训练必须走 GPU 或 CPU。
3. **工业检测的正确姿势不是"拿 9B 硬训检测器"**，而是三层分工：
   - **检测层**（决定良品/不良品、定位缺陷）：Anomalib 异常检测 + YOLO 缺陷检测 → 导出 OpenVINO → **NPU 实时推理**
   - **理解层**（看懂图纸/工单、描述缺陷、生成报告）：紫东太初 ZDTaichu5.0-9B / 3B VLM → **iGPU 推理**
   - **训练层**：小模型本地训；9B 若确需微调，走"本地数据 + 云端租 GPU"
4. 我建议的组合：**C1（全本地小模型）+ A3（NPU 小模型 + iGPU 9B 混合）+ B1（SDXL 轻量生图）**，先把闭环跑通。

{"command": "$doc = @'
# 科研/论文导向的本地 AI 与工业检测路线（v2）

- 日期：__TS__ ｜ 对话：`conv-20260928-3b54e160`
- 定位（据你所述）：**本科阶段发论文**；需要**分别训练多种缺陷类型**；成果**可能开源、部分商用**
- 硬件实测与选项菜单见 v1：`local-ai-industrial-inspection-plan-v1.md`（本文不重复）
- 已确认的技术组合：**A3 混合识图 + B2 质量优先生图 + C1 全本地小模型检测**
- 状态：**未安装任何组件**（按你"先不动手"）

---

## 0. 定位变化带来三个关键调整

| 维度 | 原计划（通用工业落地） | 现在的科研导向 |
|---|---|---|
| 目标 | 一个产线跑通 | **多类型可复制实验**（每类一套配置，横向对比） |
| 评价标准 | 好用好维护 | **可发表**：基线齐全、指标规范、可复现、消融充分 |
| 许可 | 能用就行 | **分三档判定**：能否发论文 / 能否开源 / 能否商用 —— 尤其⚠️见第 2 节 AGPL 陷阱 |

---

## 1. ⚠️ 最大的坑：Ultralytics YOLO 是 AGPL-3.0

你"**可能开源 + 部分商用**"这两条同时成立时，**Ultralytics YOLO（v5/v8/v11/v26 全系）会成为硬伤**：

- **AGPL-3.0**：只要你分发（含"提供网络服务"）基于它的软件，**整个衍生作品都必须以 AGPL 开源**；
- 想闭源商用，必须向 Ultralytics 购买商业许可（Enterprise License）；
- 论文里用没问题，但**代码开源时会传染**，商用更不行。

**建议改为 Apache-2.0 / MIT 的检测器**（同样能导出 OpenVINO 上 NPU）：

| 替代方案 | 许可 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| **RT-DETR**（PaddleDetection / MMDetection 实现） | Apache-2.0 | 端到端 Transformer 检测器，精度好，适合做论文基线，OpenVINO 支持好 |
| **YOLOX** | Apache-2.0 | 经典 anchor-free，社区成熟 |
| **MMDetection / PaddleDetection** 全家桶 | Apache-2.0 | 基线多、配置化，适合"多类型分别训练 + 横向对比" |
| **D-FINE / DEIM** 等新式检测器 | 需逐个核实 | 新工作许可常为 Apache-2.0，但**必须逐个核实**，别默认 |

> 若你只做论文、暂时不分发代码、也不商用，Ultralytics 可以用（省事）；**一旦要开源或商用就必须换**。这条我会在你选定后写进项目 README。

---

## 2. 许可矩阵：数据集（三档判定）

**三列含义**：① 能否用于发论文 ② 能否随论文/代码一起再分发（开源） ③ 能否商用

| 数据集 | 领域 | 论文 | 开源再分发 | 商用 | 备注 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **MVTec AD** | 15 类工业异常（标杆） | ✅ | ❌ 通常禁止再分发 | ❌ 需向 MVTec 购授权 | 异常检测论文的"标配"，审稿人默认期待；只给下载脚本，不给数据 |
| **VisA** | 12 类复杂结构 | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | 同上，论文常用第二数据集 |
| MVTec LOCO AD | 逻辑异常 | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | 做"逻辑异常"方向必备 |
| **BTAD** | 3 类工业品 | ✅ | ⚠️ 需核实 | ⚠️ | 小体量，适合消融 |
| **NEU-DET** | 热轧带钢 6 类 | ✅ | ⚠️ 需核实 | ⚠️ 需核实 | 国内论文极常用 |
| **GC10-DET** | 金属表面 10 类 | ✅ | ⚠️ 需核实 | ⚠️ | 3570 图，适合做多类对比 |
| DAGM 2007 | 纹理弱缺陷 10 类 | ✅ | ⚠️ 需注册 | ⚠️ | 弱缺陷经典 |
| Magnetic Tile Defect | 磁瓦 5 类 | ✅ | ⚠️ | ⚠️ | 小样本友好 |
| DeepPCB / PCB-DATASET | PCB 缺陷 | ✅ | ⚠️ 需核实 | ⚠️ | 电子方向 |
| **GDXray** | X 光：铸件/焊缝 | ✅ | ⚠️ 需核实 | ⚠️ | X 光方向首选 |
| RIAWELC | 焊缝射线 | ✅ | ⚠️ | ⚠️ | — |
| TILDA / AITEX | 纺织疵点 | ✅ | ⚠️ | ⚠️ | 纺织方向 |
| RSDDs | 钢轨表面 | ✅ | ⚠️ | ⚠️ | 小体量 |
| Casting（Kaggle 叶轮） | 铸造缺陷 | ✅ | 依 Kaggle 条款 | ⚠️ | 与 GDXray 互补 |

**科研向的统一做法（强烈建议）**：论文里**只用数据集的下载脚本 + 划分文件**，
不把原始数据打包进仓库/附件。这样"论文 ✅ / 开源 ❌ / 商用 ❌"的库也能放心用，
同时规避再分发风险。

---

## 3. 许可矩阵：模型与框架

## ⚠️ 先说最要紧的一件事：你很可能踩到的 AGPL 陷阱

你要"**开源 + 部分商用**"，那么 **Ultralytics YOLO（v5/v8/v11/v26 全系）是 AGPL-3.0**：

- 只要分发（含以网络服务形式提供），**整个衍生作品都必须 AGPL 开源**
- 想闭源商用 → 必须向 Ultralytics 买企业授权
- 发论文用它没问题，但**代码一开源就传染**，商用更不行

替代（都是 Apache-2.0，同样能导出 OpenVINO 上 NPU）：**RT-DETR**、**YOLOX**、**MMDetection / PaddleDetection**。

## 许可矩阵（三档判定，已列全）

| | 论文 | 开源再分发 | 商用 |
|---|---|---|---|
| MVTec AD / VisA / MVTec LOCO | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ 需购授权 |
| NEU-DET / GC10-DET / DAGM / 磁瓦 / GDXray / TILDA… | ✅ | ⚠️ 逐个核实 | ⚠️ 逐个核实 |
| OpenVINO / Anomalib / PyTorch / PaddleOCR / **Qwen2.5-VL** | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| **Flux.1-schnell** | ✅ | ✅ | ✅（**别用 dev**，dev 非商用） |
| SDXL base | ✅ | ✅ | ⚠️ OpenRAIL 带限制条款 |
| **ZDTaichu5.0-9B** | ✅ | ⚠️ **待核实** | ⚠️ **待核实** |
| **Ultralytics YOLO** | ✅ | ❌ 传染 AGPL | ❌ 除非买授权 |

两条实操建议：**① 论文里只附数据集的下载脚本与划分文件，不打包原始数据**——这样"不可再分发"的库也能放心用；**② ZDTaichu 的权重许可与它的 C-RADIOv4-H 视觉塔（来自 NVIDIA）许可必须分开查清**，这是你要商用前唯一的许可盲区。

## 论文导向的路线调整（C1 细化）

- **模块化流水线**：`datasets/<类型>/` + `configs/<类型>/*.yaml` + `runs/<类型>/<实验号>/` —— 每种缺陷类型一套配置，天然支持"分别训练多种类型 + 横向对比"
- **两组基线**：无监督（PatchCore/PaDiM/EfficientAD/FastFlow，Anomalib 一把梭，指标 Image/Pixel-AUROC、PRO、F1）+ 有监督（RT-DETR/YOLOX，指标 mAP）
- **可复现**：固定种子、环境锁定、指标脚本自动产出

**最值得做的贡献点（本科阶段最实在、数据最硬）**：把模型量化后**跑在 Intel NPU 上**，报告吞吐/延迟/精度损失，并与 iGPU/CPU 对比——这类"端侧部署实测"的贡献审稿人很难挑刺；再叠加"VLM 自动生成缺陷报告"就是 2026 年比较新的角度，而且**只需推理不用训练**，正卡在你机器的能力区间。

The user asks: "我先问一下如果我走纯科研路线，训练的AI读者使用是否具备法律风险" — If I take a pure research route, is there legal risk for readers/users using the trained AI?

Hmm, "训练的AI读者使用" is a bit garbled. Likely: "训练的 AI 供读者使用" = "the trained AI for readers/users to use" — i.e., if I publish a paper and the trained model is available for others (readers, reviewers, other researchers) to use, is there legal risk?

So the question: **Pure research route (no commercial intent), publishing a paper and possibly releasing the trained model / demo for readers to use — what legal risks exist?**

This is a legal/risk question. I should:
1. Give a structured, accurate answer about the legal risk dimensions in this scenario (China-based researcher, datasets with research-only licenses, models with various licenses, publication, code release, model release, readers using it).
2. Be clear I'm not a lawyer — provide the framework and the concrete risk points, and recommend verification. Not overclaim.
3. Cover:
   - **Dataset license compliance** is the primary risk: research-only datasets (MVTec AD, VisA, GDXray, DAGM, TILDA) usually prohibit *redistribution* and *commercial use*, but permit academic research and publishing results/figures. Risks arise if:
     - You redistribute the dataset (in supplementary material, GitHub, or as part of "the model needs the data").
     - You publish the trained model **that memorizes/reproduces** the data? For vision models, weight release is generally considered OK-ish, but some dataset licenses explicitly restrict "derivative works" — e.g., MVTec's terms: it's for "research purposes" — a trained model could be considered a derivative. This is the gray area worth flagging.
     - Readers use your released model **commercially** → if your license doesn't forbid it, and the underlying data license forbids commercial use, there's a chain risk. Mitigation: release model weights under a **non-commercial, research-only license** (e.g., CC BY-NC 4.0 or a custom research license) with explicit "not for commercial use / not for clinical or safety-critical use".
   - **Model licenses**: if you fine-tune ZDTaichu/Qwen2.5-VL, their licenses (Apache-2.0 for Qwen; ZDTaichu TBD) govern redistribution of your fine-tuned weights: Apache-2.0 requires preserving notices and the license text, and there may be additional use restrictions (Qwen has a separate "Qwen license" for some models? Qwen2.5-VL-3B/7B are Apache-2.0 — yes, most Qwen2.5 models are Apache-2.0; Qwen3 has some non-commercial "2507" variants? Careful). Also **use-restriction clauses** (RAIL) in SDXL/SD1.5: model output usage restrictions.
   - **Publication/Copyright**: figures from datasets (sample images) in a paper — usually covered by research license/citation requirements; some require citation and specific wording.
   - **Open-source code**: if you use AGPL code (Ultralytics) in a released repo, you must AGPL your repo → this is a "compliance" risk rather than legal liability, but mixing AGPL code into a research repo can force licensing of the whole work.
   - **Institutional/IP**: Chinese universities/employers may claim rights over work done with their resources; publishing/releasing may need institutional approval; also 中国科学院/学校 policy. And China's export control / data security laws if using data from industry partners.
   - **Liability for use of the model**: if readers use your defect-detection model for real industrial/medical decisions and it fails → disclaimers (no warranty, not for safety-critical use) reduce but don't eliminate risk. Chinese law: 产品质量法/民法典 product liability applies to products, generally not to free academic artifacts, but "明知缺陷" could matter. Also academic integrity: don't overclaim.
   - **Personal data**: if datasets contain human faces/worker images → PIPL (个人信息保护法) applies; industrial images usually fine, but X-ray/luggage images (GDXray includes luggage with potential personal items) — mostly fine, but be careful.
   - **Copyright of images in datasets**: some datasets (e.g., Kaggle ones, or scraped data) may contain third-party copyrighted images → redistributing them is infringement risk; that's the dataset's problem, but as a publisher you inherit it.
   - **Export control / national security**: industrial inspection for certain industries (aerospace, defense) may involve 出口管制/涉密 concerns; if data comes from a partner factory under NDA, publishing requires permission.
   - **Chinese regulations on AI**: 生成式AI服务管理暂行办法 (applies to public-facing generative AI services in China), 《人工智能生成合成内容标识办法》 (labeling AI-generated content, effective Sept 2025) → if you release a public-facing image-generation service/demo, labeling requirements apply; a research repo is not a "service" but a public demo may be closer. Also algorithm filing (算法备案) applies to services with public opinion/social mobilization attributes — a research demo generally not, but a public online service might.
   - **Institutional review (伦理审查)**: if human subjects or personal data → IRB/伦理委员会.
   
4. Give practical mitigations (a checklist):
   - Use datasets whose terms allow: research + publishing results; don't redistribute data.
   - Release **code + configs + download scripts**, not data.
   - Release weights under a clearly-marked **research-only license** (or don't release weights; provide a demo/API limited to reviewers).
   - Avoid AGPL components in released code (or comply).
   - Keep an explicit "intended use / prohibited use" statement and disclaimer.
   - Cite datasets per their required citation.
   - Check institutional IP policy before release.
   - For a public demo: comply with content labeling + avoid being an unregistered "生成式AI服务"; keep it a research artifact (no public user accounts, no service-level offering).
   - Keep records (provenance, license texts) — this is the "compliance evidence" that protects you.

5. Note the biggest *practical* risk for a student: **论文里用了"研究免费"数据集却把数据/模型公开分发** → 被要求撤下（takedown）+ 学术声誉风险；以及 **AGPL 传染**导致代码许可被迫变更。

6. Recommend: I can produce a "许可与合规清单" per component (I already have the matrix) + a suggested release package structure and license notice templates (NOTICE file, per-dataset license list, model card with intended use). That's actionable and doesn't require installing anything.

   - **Copyright of images in datasets**: some datasets (e.g., Kaggle ones, or scraped data) may contain third-party copyrighted images → redistributing them is infringement risk; that's the dataset's problem, but as a publisher you inherit it.

# Industrial anomaly detection benchmark dataset

![](https://www.mvtec.com/fileadmin/_processed_/0/4/csm_teaser_image_dataset_anomaly_detection_b7de33b91e.webp)

Abstract

**MVTec AD** is a dataset for benchmarking anomaly detection methods with a focus on industrial inspection. It contains over 5000 high-resolution images divided into fifteen different object and texture categories. Each category comprises a set of defect-free training images and a test set of images with various kinds of defects as well as images without defects.

Pixel-precise annotations of all anomalies are also provided. More information can be in our paper "[MVTec AD – A Comprehensive Real-World Dataset for Unsupervised Anomaly Detection](/fileadmin/Redaktion/mvtec.com/05_research_teaching/datasets/mvtec_ad.pdf)" and its extended version "[The MVTec Anomaly Detection Dataset: A Comprehensive Real-World Dataset for Unsupervised Anomaly Detection](https://link.springer.com/content/pdf/10.1007/s11263-020-01400-4.pdf)".

# ZDTaichu5.0-9B [Project Page](https://taichu-ai.github.io/ZDTaichu5.0-9B/) | [GitHub](https://github.com/Taichu-AI/ZDTaichu5.0-9B) | [Huggingface](https://huggingface.co/TaichuAI/ZDTaichu5.0-9B) ZDTaichu5.0-9B is a multimodal foundation model for general visual understanding, spatial reasoning, agentic tool use, and embodied-AI research. It combines a Qwen3.5-9B language backbone with a C-RADIOv4-H vision encoder, supports text, images and videos with any-resolution visual input. Within the 10B-scale general-purpose VLMs compared in this release blog, ZDTaichu5.0-9B retains first-tier general visual understanding while supporting spatial reasoning, high-level embodied VLM reasoning, and agent tasks under the reported evaluation settings. Rather than trading broad visual competence for specialization, it layers a more comprehensive spatial, embodied, and agent capability profile on top of a strong general-vision foundation. The model accepts text, one or more images, and video. It is designed for: - general image, document, chart, diagram, and OCR understanding; - visual mathematics and knowledge-grounded visual question answering; - fine-grained 2D relations, multi-view association, 3D scene understanding, perspective taking, and mental transformation; - multi-step and multi-turn tool use; - spatial perception, affordance understanding, and planning for VLA and embodied-AI adaptation. More demos and showcases are provided at [Project Page](https://taichu-ai.github.io/ZDTaichu5.0-9B/). ## Highlights - **Strong general vision and broad capabilities:** remains in the leading group of 10B-scale general-purpose VLMs across images, documents, charts, diagrams, OCR, visual mathematics, multiple images and video, while extending to spatial reasoning, high-level embodied understanding and multi-step agent tasks. - **Leading spatial reasoning and embodied understanding:** leads spatial capability among the compared 10B-scale general-purpose VLMs, with strong results on SparBench, ViewSpatial, MMSI-Bench and MindCube-tiny. Scores of 48 on ERQA and 56 on RoboSpatial cover scene reasoning, affordances and interaction-oriented understanding. - **Strongest agent capability among the compared 10B-scale general-purpose VLMs:** leads the reported TAU2-Bench (87.7) and Claw-Eval (71.4) comparisons, and reaches 93.7 on IFEval. - **Entropy-Gated Adaptive Recurrent Reasoning:** Dynamically allocates additional recurrent refinement steps in latent space to more challenging tokens, enabling greater computational depth where needed and improving reasoning performance on complex tasks. ## Model Overview | Item | Specification | |---|---| | Model type | Multimodal causal language model with vision encoder | | Language backbone | Qwen3.5-9B LLM Decoder| | Vision backbone | C-RADIOv4-H | | Context length | Up to 128K tokens | | Vision resolution | Any-resolution visual input | | Input modalities | Text, single image, multiple images, and video | ## Capabilities ### General visual understanding The model can recognize objects, attributes, and scenes; read text in natural images and documents; interpret tables, forms, plots, and diagrams; and answer questions that combine visual evidence with language and world knowledge. ### Spatial perception and reasoning Spatial training covers: - left/right, above/below, front/behind, occlusion, containment, and relative distance; - dense counting, fine-grained localization, points, coordinates, and bounding boxes; - association across images and viewpoints; - camera motion, relative pose, depth ordering, and room-scale layout; - egocentric and allocentric perspective taking; - 2D/3D rotation, paper folding, three-view projection, cross-sections, and part-motion reasoning; - embodied affordances, manipulation semantics, and high-level action planning. ### Multiple images and video ZDTaichu5.0-9B compares and reasons across multiple images and supports video understanding, including event tracking and detail retrieval from long footage within its 128K-token context window. ### Agentic tool use The model is designed for multi-step and multi-turn tool-use tasks. Tool execution must be implemented, validated, and secured by the surrounding application; the model does not execute tools by itself. ## Benchmark Results The two figures compare ZDTaichu5.0-9B with open and closed models across general visual understanding, spatial and embodied capabilities, and agent and text capabilities. **Comparison with open models** ![ZDTaichu5.0-9B benchmark comparison with open models](assets/taichu-release-benchmark-comparison.svg) **Comparison with closed models** ![ZDTaichu5.0-9B benchmark comparison with closed models](assets/taichu-vs-closed-models.svg) ### Spatial and embodied reasoning

For multi-image spatial reasoning evaluations such as ViewSpatial, MMSI-Bench, MindCube-tiny, and VSI-Bench, the following output-format requirement was added to the evaluation prompt: You FIRST think about the reasoning process as an internal monologue and then provide the final answer. The reasoning process MUST BE enclosed within tags. The final answer MUST BE put in \boxed{}. ## Quickstart ### Installation Install a recent version of Hugging Face Transformers together with the standard multimodal dependencies: ```bash pip install transformers==5.3.0 torch==2.10.0 torchvision==0.25.0 accelerate timm ``` ### Offline inference export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 ```python import os import torch from transformers import AutoModel, AutoProcessor model_id = os.environ["ZDTAICHU_MODEL_ID"] processor = AutoProcessor.from_pretrained( model_id, trust_remote_code=True, use_fast=False, ) model = AutoModel.from_pretrained( model_id, trust_remote_code=True, torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16, device_map="auto", attn_implementation="sdpa", ).eval() messages = [ { "role": "user", "content": [ {"type": "image", "image": "floorplan.png"}, {"type": "text", "text": "Which room is directly to the left of the kitchen?"}, ], } ] inputs = processor.from_messages(messages, return_tensors="pt").to(model.device) with torch.inference_mode(): output_ids = model.generate(**inputs, max_new_tokens=1024, do_sample=False) generated_ids = output_ids[:, inputs["input_ids"].shape[1] :] print(processor.batch_decode(generated_ids, skip_special_tokens=True)[0]) ``` ### Online Serving We adapted the vLLM v0.26.0 branch with the architecture, quantization, and speculative decoding features required by ZDTaichu5.0, supporting both Docker and source deployment: **Docker (recommended)** - **Docker image:** `registry-dx.wair.ac.cn/taichu-public/vllm-openai:v0.26.0.zdtaichu_5_0` - CUDA ≥ 12.9，Nvidia Driver ≥ 575.51.03 ```bash docker run -d \ -e CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 --gpus all \ --privileged --ipc=host \ -p 18050:8000 \ registry-dx.wair.ac.cn/taichu-public/vllm-openai:v0.26.0.zdtaichu_5_0 \ TaichuAI/ZDTaichu5.0-9B \ --max-model-len 220000 \ --served-model-name zdtaichu \ --mamba-ssm-cache-dtype float32 \ --gdn-prefill-backend triton \ --trust-remote-code \ --tensor-parallel-size 1 \ --generation-config vllm ``` **Install from source** - **vLLM source (GitHub):** https://github.com/Taichu-AI/vllm · branch `v0.26.0-zdtaichu` ```bash git clone -b v0.26.0-zdtaichu https://github.com/Taichu-AI/vllm.git cd vllm pip install -e . vllm serve TaichuAI/ZDTaichu5.0-9B \ --max-model-len 220000 \ --served-model-name zdtaichu \ --mamba-ssm-cache-dtype float32 \ --gdn-prefill-backend triton \ --trust-remote-code \ --tensor-parallel-size 1 \ --generation-config vllm ``` The server exposes an OpenAI-compatible endpoint at `http://:18050/v1`. The examples below use the `requests` library (`pip install requests`): **Setup** ```python import base64 import requests URL = "http://:18050/v1/chat/completions" def data_url(path: str, mime: str) -> str: """Encode a local file as a base64 data URI.""" with open(path, "rb") as f: return f"data:{mime};base64," + base64.b64encode(f.read()).decode() def chat(body: dict) -> str: resp = requests.post(URL, json=body, timeout=600) resp.raise_for_status() return resp.json()["choices"][0]["message"]["content"] #Text-only input body = { "model": "zdtaichu", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}], "temperature": 1.0, "top_p": 0.95, "top_k": 20, } print(chat(body)) #Image input (local file, base64) body = { "model": "zdtaichu", "messages": [ { "role": "user", "content": [ {"type": "text", "text": "Which room is directly to the left of the kitchen?"}, {"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": data_url("floorplan.png", "image/png")}}, ], } ], "temperature": 0, "top_p": 0.95, "top_k": 20, } print(chat(body)) # Video input (local file, base64) body = { "model": "zdtaichu", "messages": [ { "role": "user", "content": [ {"type": "text", "text": "Please describe the video."}, {"type": "video_url", "video_url": {"url": data_url("example.mp4", "video/mp4")}}, ], } ], "media_io_kwargs": { "video": { "num_frames": 8, }, }, } print(chat(body)) ``` `media_io_kwargs.video.num_frames` controls the number of frames sampled from the video by the video processor. **Recommended sampling parameters** | Task | temperature | top_p | top_k | |---|---|---|---| | Spatial reasoning and grounding | 0 | 0.95 | 20 | | Other tasks | 1.0 | 0.95 | 20 | **Reasoning and tool-call parsing arguments (optional)** To enable reasoning output and tool calls, add the following arguments to the launch command: ```bash --reasoning-parser qwen3 --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser qwen3_coder ``` ## function Edit-File {
    param([string]$Path, [string]$From, [string]$To, [string]$Label)
    $t = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($Path, [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8)
    $n = ([regex]::Matches($t, [regex]::Escape($From))).Count
    if ($n -eq 0) { Write-Output ("  [SKIP] $Label - source text not found"); return $false }
    if ($n -gt 1) { Write-Output ("  [SKIP] $Label - source text found $n times (not unique)"); return $false }
    $t = $t.Replace($From, $To)
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $t, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
    Write-Output ("  [OK]   $Label")
    return $true
}

{"command": "$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
function Edit-File {
    param([string]$Path, [string]$From, [string]$To, [string]$Label)
    $t = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($Path, [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8)
    $n = ([regex]::Matches($t, [regex]::Escape($From))).Count
    if ($n -eq 0) { Write-Output ("  [SKIP] $Label - source text not found"); return $false }
    if ($n -gt 1) { Write-Output ("  [SKIP] $Label - source text found $n times (not unique)"); return $false }
    $t = $t.Replace($From, $To)
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($Path, $t, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
    Write-Output ("  [OK]   $Label")
    return $true
}

# 工作区输出文件存放准则（E:\Deepseek，强制）

本工作区所有对话必须遵守本文件。完整说明见 `policy/output-storage-policy.md`，
机器可读配置为 `policy/storage-policy.json`。本文件由 DSH 自动注入，无需手动读取。

## 规则 0 · 环境事实（必读）

| 事实 | 后果与对策 |
|---|---|
| `E:\Deepseek` 在可移动 **exFAT** 卷上，不支持硬链接 | `write` / `edit` 工具报 `EISDIR: illegal operation on a directory`；改用 PowerShell 直写 |
| Shell 为 **Windows PowerShell 5.1**（本机无 `pwsh`） | 脚本需兼容 5.1；用 `powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File` 调用 |
| 沙箱内 .NET/schannel 取不到 TLS 凭证 | `Invoke-WebRequest`、`curl.exe` 全部 SSL 失败；HTTPS 下载改用 node：`node scripts\conv-20260928-3b54e160\download-file.js <url> <out> [size]` |
| 沙箱临时区 `%TEMP%\dsh-*` 的 chmod/清理被拒 | `pip`、`venv`、`ensurepip` 会因此失败；先 `$env:TEMP=$env:TMP='E:\Deepseek\workspace\<conv-id>\tmp'` |
| 机器 PATH 含 `...\WindowsApps`（Store 别名），先于用户 PATH | 已停用 python/python3 别名占位符，`python` 现解析到 D 盘安装 |
| 写 `D:\`、`%USERPROFILE%` 被沙箱拒绝 | 需申请 `danger-full-access` 提权；这是设计而非故障 |

写文件统一 UTF-8 无 BOM，读文件统一显式 UTF-8：

```powershell
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($path, $text, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
$text = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($path, [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8)
```

## 规则 1 · 先建目录，再产出文件

在写出本次对话的第一个文件之前，先运行（幂等，可重复运行）：

```powershell
powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File E:\Deepseek\tools\New-ConversationWorkspace.ps1
```

## 规则 4 · 命名（兼容性优先）

目录名与文件名只用 ASCII：`A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ -`；**禁止中文、空格、emoji、全角字符**；统一小写，
词间用 `-`；避开 Windows 保留名（`CON` `PRN` `AUX` `NUL` `COM1-9` `LPT1-9`）。
日志与带时间戳的文件用 `yyyyMMdd-HHmmss` 前缀，不用“最终版/最新版”这类含糊后缀。

## 规则 5 · 运行环境缺失时

1. **先检测**：`Get-Command <tool>`、`where.exe <tool>`、查 `D:\program_runtime_environment\registry.json`；
   已在 PATH 的不得重复安装。本机已就绪：`nodejs` 24.20.0、`python` 3.14.7。
2. **归类安装**：装到 `D:\program_runtime_environment\<category>\`，category 为语言/工具大类，
   小写英文：`nodejs` `python` `java` `dotnet` `go` `rust` `cli` `browsers` `databases` `caches`。

# Python 3.12.15

**Release date:** Sept. 30, 2026

## This is a security release of Python 3.12

**Note:** The release you're looking at is Python 3.12.15, a **security bugfix release** for the legacy 3.12 series. _Python 3.14_ is now the latest feature release series of Python 3. [Get the latest release of 3.14.x here](/downloads/).

## Security content in this release

-   [CVE-2026-19445](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-19445) [gh-156293](https://github.com/python/cpython/issues/156293) Use-after-free of a server-side `SSLContext` when `sni_callback` switches contexts
    
-   [CVE-2026-19553](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-19553) [gh-156793](https://github.com/python/cpython/issues/156793) `SSLContext.wrap_bio()` missing validation of server\_hostname parameter
    
-   [CVE-2026-82049](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-82049) [gh-157190](https://github.com/python/cpython/issues/157190) `tarfile` extraction filters allow file modification and content disclosure via hard link to symlink
    
-   [CVE-2026-15310](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-15310) [gh-156002](https://github.com/python/cpython/issues/156002) Memory exhaustion in `zipfile` in bzip2/LZMA/Zstandard decompression
    
-   [CVE-2026-19672](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-19672) [gh-155999](https://github.com/python/cpython/issues/155999) `tarfile` extraction filter bypass allows creation of directories outside the destination
    
-   [CVE-2026-15806](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-15806) [gh-155694](https://github.com/python/cpython/issues/155694) `urllib.request.HTTPPasswordMgr` credentials for one URL scheme sent over another scheme
    
-   [CVE-2026-17084](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-17084) [gh-155292](https://github.com/python/cpython/issues/155292) `StringPrep` algorithm considered Unicode codepoint attributes outside Unicode 3.2.0
    
-   [gh-158446](https://github.com/python/cpython/issues/158446) Reject float format precision near `INT_MAX`
    
-   [gh-157953](https://github.com/python/cpython/issues/157953) Update bundled Expat to [2.8.5](https://blog.hartwork.org/posts/expat-2-8-5-released/)
    
-   [CVE-2026-87910](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-87910) [gh-157265](https://github.com/python/cpython/issues/157265) `tarfile` hardlink fallback ignores custom extraction filter rejection via `None`
    

## No installers

According to the release calendar specified in [PEP 693](https://peps.python.org/pep-0693/), Python 3.12 is now in the "security fixes only" stage of its life cycle: the 3.12 branch only accepts security fixes, and releases of those are made irregularly in source-only form until October 2028. Python 3.12 isn't receiving regular bug fixes anymore, and binary installers are no longer provided for it. **Python 3.12.10** was the last full _bugfix release_ of Python 3.12 with binary installers.

[Full Changelog](https://docs.python.org/release/3.12.15/whatsnew/changelog.html)

# Python 3.12.10

Note: Python 3.12.10 has been superseded by [Python 3.12.15](/downloads/release/python-31215/).

**Release date:** April 8, 2025

# This is the tenth maintenance release of Python 3.12

Python 3.12.10 is the latest maintenance release of Python 3.12, and the last full maintenance release. Subsequent releases of 3.12 will be _security-fixes only_. This last maintenance release contains about 230 bug fixes, build improvements and documentation changes since 3.12.9.

# Major new features of the 3.12 series, compared to 3.11

## New features

-   [More flexible f-string parsing](https://docs.python.org/3.12/whatsnew/3.12.html#pep-701-syntactic-formalization-of-f-strings), allowing many things previously disallowed ([PEP 701](https://peps.python.org/pep-0701/)).
-   [Support for the buffer protocol](https://docs.python.org/3.12/whatsnew/3.12.html#pep-688-making-the-buffer-protocol-accessible-in-python) in Python code ([PEP 688](https://peps.python.org/pep-0688/)).
-   [A new debugging/profiling API](https://docs.python.org/3.12/whatsnew/3.12.html#pep-669-low-impact-monitoring-for-cpython) ([PEP 669](https://peps.python.org/pep-0669/)).
-   [Support for isolated subinterpreters](https://docs.python.org/3.12/whatsnew/3.12.html#pep-684-a-per-interpreter-gil) with separate Global Interpreter Locks ([PEP 684](https://peps.python.org/pep-0684)).
-   [Even more improved error messages](https://docs.python.org/3.12/whatsnew/3.12.html#improved-error-messages). More exceptions potentially caused by typos now make suggestions to the user.
-   [Support for the Linux `perf` profiler](https://docs.python.org/3.12/howto/perf_profiling.html) to report Python function names in traces.
-   [Many large and small performance improvements](https://docs.python.org/3.12/whatsnew/3.12.html#optimizations) (like [PEP 709](https://peps.python.org/pep-0709/) and support for the BOLT binary optimizer), delivering an estimated 5% overall performance improvement.

## Type annotations

-   [New type annotation syntax](https://docs.python.org/3.12/whatsnew/3.12.html#pep-695-type-parameter-syntax) for generic classes ([PEP 695](https://peps.python.org/pep-0695/)).
-   [New override decorator](https://docs.python.org/3.12/whatsnew/3.12.html#pep-698-override-decorator-for-static-typing) for methods ([PEP 698](https://peps.python.org/pep-0698)).

## Deprecations

-   The deprecated `wstr` and `wstr_length` members of the C implementation of unicode objects were removed, per [PEP 623](https://peps.python.org/pep-0623/).
-   In the `unittest` module, a number of long deprecated methods and classes were removed. (They had been deprecated since Python 3.1 or 3.2.)
-   The deprecated `smtpd` and `distutils` modules have been removed (see [PEP 594](https://peps.python.org/pep-0594/) and [PEP 632](https://peps.python.org/pep-0632/).) The `setuptools` package continues to provide the `distutils` module.
-   [A number of other old, broken and deprecated functions, classes and methods](https://docs.python.org/3.12/whatsnew/3.12.html#removed) have been removed.
-   Invalid backslash escape sequences in strings now warn with `SyntaxWarning` instead of `DeprecationWarning`, making them more visible. (They will become syntax errors in the future.)
-   The internal representation of integers has changed in preparation for performance enhancements. (This should not affect most users as it is an internal detail, but it may cause problems for Cython-generated code.)

For more details on the changes to Python 3.12, see [What's new in Python 3.12](https://docs.python.org/3.12/whatsnew/3.12.html).

{"command": "$py = @'
"""NPU smoke test: list OpenVINO devices, then compile and run a tiny model on CPU / GPU / NPU."""
import time
import numpy as np
import openvino as ov

def build_model():
    ops = ov.opset13
    param = ops.parameter([1, 3, 32, 32], ov.Type.f32, name="input")
    w = ops.constant(np.random.RandomState(0).randn(8, 3, 3, 3).astype(np.float32))
    conv = ops.convolution(param, w, [1, 1], [1, 1], [1, 1], [1, 1])
    relu = ops.relu(conv)
    pool = ops.avg_pool(relu, [2, 2], [2, 2], [0, 0], [0, 0], "floor", True)
    return ov.Model([pool], [param], "tiny-conv")

def main():
    core = ov.Core()
    print("openvino version :", ov.__version__)
    print("available_devices:", core.available_devices)
    print()
    for dev in core.available_devices:
        try:
            name = core.get_property(dev, "FULL_DEVICE_NAME")
        except Exception as exc:
            name = "(unavailable: %s)" % exc
        print("  %-4s -> %s" % (dev, name))
    print()

    model = build_model()
    data = np.random.randn(1, 3, 32, 32).astype(np.float32)
    for dev in ["CPU", "GPU", "NPU"]:
        if dev not in core.available_devices:
            print("%-4s : not present" % dev)
            continue
        try:
            t0 = time.time()
            compiled = core.compile_model(model, dev)
            compile_ms = (time.time() - t0) * 1000
            req = compiled.create_infer_request()
            out = req.infer({0: data})[0]
            t0 = time.time()
            for _ in range(20):
                req.infer({0: data})
            per_ms = (time.time() - t0) * 1000 / 20
            print("%-4s : OK   output=%s   compile=%.0f ms   infer=%.2f ms/iter   min=%.2f ms"
                  % (dev, out.shape, compile_ms, per_ms,
                     min((lambda: (lambda t: (req.infer({0: data}), (time.time() - t)[0])[1])(time.time()))() for _ in range(5)) * 1000))
        except Exception as exc:
            print("%-4s : FAILED -> %s: %s" % (dev, type(exc).__name__, str(exc)[:300]))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""NPU smoke test: list OpenVINO devices, then compile and run a tiny model on CPU / GPU / NPU."""
import time
import numpy as np
import openvino as ov

def build_model():
    ops = ov.opset13
    param = ops.parameter([1, 3, 32, 32], ov.Type.f32, name="input")
    w = ops.constant(np.random.RandomState(0).randn(8, 3, 3, 3).astype(np.float32))
    conv = ops.convolution(param, w, [1, 1], [1, 1], [1, 1], [1, 1])
    relu = ops.relu(conv)
    pool = ops.avg_pool(relu, [2, 2], [2, 2], [0, 0], [0, 0], "floor", True)
    return ov.Model([pool], [param], "tiny-conv")

def main():
    core = ov.Core()
    print("openvino version :", ov.__version__)
    print("available_devices:", core.available_devices)
    print()
    for dev in core.available_devices:
        try:
            name = core.get_property(dev, "FULL_DEVICE_NAME")
        except Exception as exc:
            name = "(unavailable: %s)" % exc
        print("  %-4s -> %s" % (dev, name))
    print()

    model = build_model()
    data = np.random.randn(1, 3, 32, 32).astype(np.float32)
    for dev in ["CPU", "GPU", "NPU"]:
        if dev not in core.available_devices:
            print("%-4s : not present" % dev)
            continue
        try:
            t0 = time.time()
            compiled = core.compile_model(model, dev)
            compile_ms = (time.time() - t0) * 1000
            req = compiled.create_infer_request()
            out = req.infer({0: data})[0]
            t0 = time.time()
            for _ in range(20):
                req.infer({0: data})
            per_ms = (time.time() - t0) * 1000 / 20
            print("%-4s : OK   output=%s   compile=%.0f ms   infer=%.2f ms/iter   min=%.2f ms"
                  % (dev, out.shape, compile_ms, per_ms,
                     min((lambda: (lambda t: (req.infer({0: data}), (time.time() - t)[0])[1])(time.time()))() for _ in range(5)) * 1000))
        except Exception as exc:
            print("%-4s : FAILED -> %s: %s" % (dev, type(exc).__name__, str(exc)[:300]))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

{"command": "$py = @'
"""NPU smoke test: enumerate OpenVINO devices, then compile and run a tiny conv model on CPU / GPU / NPU."""
import time
import numpy as np
import openvino as ov


def build_model():
    ops = ov.opset13
    param = ops.parameter([1, 3, 32, 32], ov.Type.f32, name="input")
    weights = ops.constant(np.random.RandomState(0).randn(8, 3, 3, 3).astype(np.float32))
    conv = ops.convolution(param, weights, [1, 1], [1, 1], [1, 1], [1, 1])
    relu = ops.relu(conv)
    pool = ops.avg_pool(relu, [2, 2], [2, 2], [0, 0], [0, 0], "floor", True)
    return ov.Model([pool], [param], "tiny-conv")


def main():
    core = ov.Core()
    print("openvino version  :", ov.__version__)
    print("available_devices :", core.available_devices)
    print()
    print("device details:")
    for dev in core.available_devices:
        try:
            full = core.get_property(dev, "FULL_DEVICE_NAME")
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            full = "(unavailable: %s)" % exc
        print("   %-4s -> %s" % (dev, full))
    print()

    model = build_model()
    data = np.random.RandomState(1).randn(1, 3, 32, 32).astype(np.float32)
    results = {}
    for dev in ["CPU", "GPU", "NPU"]:
        if dev not in core.available_devices:
            print("%-4s : NOT PRESENT" % dev)
            results[dev] = "absent"
            continue
        try:
            t0 = time.perf_counter()
            compiled = core.compile_model(model, dev)
            compile_ms = (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000.0
            req = compiled.create_infer_request()
            out = req.infer({0: data})[0]
            times = []
            for _ in range(30):
                t0 = time.perf_counter()
                req.infer({0: data})
                times.append((time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000.0)
            avg = sum(times) / len(times)
            print("%-4s : OK   output=%-16s compile=%8.0f ms   infer avg=%6.3f ms   min=%6.3f ms   p95=%6.3f ms"
                  % (dev, str(out.shape), compile_ms, avg, min(times), sorted(times)[int(len(times) * 0.95) - 1]))
            results[dev] = "ok"
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            print("%-4s : FAILED -> %s: %s" % (dev, type(exc).__name__, str(exc)[:400]))
            results[dev] = "failed"
    print()
    print("summary:", results)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

{"command": "$py = @'
"""NPU smoke test: enumerate OpenVINO devices, then compile and run a tiny conv model on CPU / GPU / NPU."""
import time
import numpy as np
import openvino as ov


def build_model():
    ops = ov.opset13
    param = ops.parameter([1, 3, 32, 32], ov.Type.f32, name="input")
    weights = ops.constant(np.random.RandomState(0).randn(8, 3, 3, 3).astype(np.float32))
    conv = ops.convolution(param, weights, [1, 1], [1, 1], [1, 1], [1, 1])
    relu = ops.relu(conv)
    # avg_pool(node, strides, pads_begin, pads_end, kernel, exclude_pad, rounding_type)
    pool = ops.avg_pool(relu, [2, 2], [0, 0], [0, 0], [2, 2], True, "floor")
    return ov.Model([pool], [param], "tiny-conv")


def main():
    core = ov.Core()
    print("openvino version  :", ov.__version__)
    print("available_devices :", core.available_devices)
    print()
    print("device details:")
    for dev in core.available_devices:
        try:
            full = core.get_property(dev, "FULL_DEVICE_NAME")
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            full = "(unavailable: %s)" % exc
        print("   %-4s -> %s" % (dev, full))
    print()

    model = build_model()
    print("model ops:", [op.get_type_name() for op in model.get_ops()])
    print()
    data = np.random.RandomState(1).randn(1, 3, 32, 32).astype(np.float32)
    results = {}
    for dev in ["CPU", "GPU", "NPU"]:
        if dev not in core.available_devices:
            print("%-4s : NOT PRESENT" % dev)
            results[dev] = "absent"
            continue
        try:
            t0 = time.perf_counter()
            compiled = core.compile_model(model, dev)
            compile_ms = (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000.0
            req = compiled.create_infer_request()
            out = req.infer({0: data})[0]
            times = []
            for _ in range(50):
                t0 = time.perf_counter()
                req.infer({0: data})
                times.append((time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000.0)
            times.sort()
            print("%-4s : OK   output=%-14s compile=%8.0f ms   avg=%6.3f ms   min=%6.3f ms   p95=%6.3f ms"
                  % (dev, str(out.shape), compile_ms, sum(times) / len(times), times[0], times[int(len(times) * 0.95) - 1]))
            results[dev] = "ok"
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            print("%-4s : FAILED -> %s: %s" % (dev, type(exc).__name__, str(exc)[:400]))
            results[dev] = "failed"
    print()
    print("summary:", results)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    param([string]$Path, [string]$From, [string]$To, [string]$Label)

This file changed after it was loaded. Use the following content instead of the previously loaded instructions from this file.

# 全局对话输出文件存放准则（对所有工作区生效）

本文件是 `%DSH_HOME%\AGENTS.md` 的可维护副本，由 DSH 自动注入到**每一个对话**。
维护源在 `E:\Deepseek\policy\deploy\global-agents.md`；修改后运行
`E:\Deepseek\tools\Install-GlobalPolicy.ps1` 重新部署。

## 规则 1 · 先建目录，再产出文件

在当前工作区根目录下确保存在以下英文类别目录，并在每个类别下建立**本对话的子目录**：

```
deliverables\  logs\  scripts\  workspace\  data\  archive\
```

子目录名统一为 `conv-<yyyyMMdd>-<token>`：token = `$env:DSH_SESSION_ID` 中 UUID 的前 8 位
十六进制小写（无会话 ID 时用本地时间 `HHmmss`），例如 `conv-20260928-3b54e160`。
**同一对话在所有类别下使用同一个子目录名**；已存在则复用，不得另建第二个。

## 规则 2 · 工作区自带规范优先

若当前工作区存在 `policy\storage-policy.json` 或 `policy\output-storage-policy.md`，以其中的类别与
命名配置为准；若存在 `tools\New-ConversationWorkspace.ps1`，先运行它（本机 shell 为
Windows PowerShell 5.1，无 `pwsh`）：

```powershell
powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\tools\New-ConversationWorkspace.ps1
```

不存在时按规则 1 手工创建；参考实现与完整准则见 `E:\Deepseek\policy\output-storage-policy.md`。

## 规则 3 · 文件放哪里

| 内容 | 位置 |
|---|---|
| 交给用户的最终交付物 | `deliverables\<conv-id>\` |
| 命令输出、运行日志、会话元信息 | `logs\<conv-id>\` |
| 为本次对话编写的脚本 | `scripts\<conv-id>\` |
| 临时文件、中间产物 | `workspace\<conv-id>\` |
| 输入数据、样例 | `data\<conv-id>\` |
| 被取代的版本、结项留存 | `archive\<conv-id>\` |

工作区根目录只放 `AGENTS.md`、`README.md`、`policy\`、`tools\`、`reference_file\` 与上述类别目录；
禁止把产物丢在根目录、桌面、`%TEMP%` 或源目录里。
`reference_file\` 是**用户投放参考资料的共享目录**（非对话专属）：**Agent 只读**，
不得删除、移动、改名或覆盖其中任何文件；用户投放的文件豁免 ASCII 命名规则（允许中文名），
Agent 在其中新建的文件仍须遵守；允许子目录，读取时递归；清理或归档仅在用户明确要求时进行。

## 规则 4 · 命名（兼容性优先）

目录名与文件名只用 ASCII：`A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ -`；**禁止中文、空格、emoji、全角字符**；统一小写，
词间用 `-`；避开 Windows 保留名（`CON` `PRN` `AUX` `NUL` `COM1-9` `LPT1-9`）。
日志与带时间戳的文件用 `yyyyMMdd-HHmmss` 前缀，不用“最终版/最新版”这类含糊后缀。

## 规则 5 · 运行环境缺失时

1. **先检测**：`Get-Command <tool>`、`where.exe <tool>`、查 `D:\program_runtime_environment\registry.json`；
   已在 PATH 的不得重复安装。本机已就绪：`nodejs` 24.20.0、`python` 3.14.7。
2. **归类安装**：装到 `D:\program_runtime_environment\<category>\`，category 为语言/工具大类，
   小写英文：`nodejs` `python` `java` `dotnet` `go` `rust` `cli` `browsers` `databases` `caches`。
   同一环境多版本放 `<category>\<version>\`。**不同环境必须归类，禁止混放，禁止在根目录散放可执行文件。**
3. 安装包暂存 `_downloads\`，包管理器缓存放 `_caches\<tool>\`；下载后先用**官方 SHA-256 +
   Authenticode 签名**双重校验再安装。
4. **登记**：安装后更新 `D:\program_runtime_environment\registry.json`
   （可运行 `D:\program_runtime_environment\tools\Add-RuntimeEnvironment.ps1`；
   该脚本已禁用位置参数绑定，数组参数必须用命名参数传入）。
5. **提权**：D 盘在工作区之外，文件沙箱会拒绝写入；先向用户申请 `danger-full-access` 提权再执行。
   不得为绕开限制而改装到工作区内、`C:\` 根目录或用户目录根。
6. **AI 专用文件**：本地 AI 的运行时、模型、数据集、虚拟环境一律放 **`D:\AI_file`**（用户指定），
   按 `runtime\` `tools\` `envs\` `models\` `datasets\` `outputs\` `logs\` `workspace\` `_downloads\` `_caches\` 归类，
   并登记到 `D:\AI_file\registry.json`；**不要**把 AI 环境装进 `program_runtime_environment`（那里放通用运行时）。

## 规则 6 · 交付与日志

- 最终回复必须列出交付文件的完整路径；属于交付物的文件用 `present` 工具呈现。
- 超过约 50 行的命令输出写入 `logs\<conv-id>\<yyyyMMdd-HHmmss>-<tool>.log`，聊天只给路径与摘要。
- 交付物被新版本取代时，旧版移入 `archive\<conv-id>\`，不就地覆盖历史版本。

## 规则 7 · 沙箱内的技术限制与对策（本机实测）

| 现象 | 原因 | 对策 |
|---|---|---|
| `write` / `edit` 报 `EISDIR: illegal operation on a directory` | 工作区在 exFAT 卷上（如 `E:\Deepseek`），不支持硬链接 | 改用 PowerShell 直写：`[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($p,$t,(New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))` |

- 日期：__TS__ ｜ 对话：`conv-20260928-3b54e160`
- 本次范围：按你的选择，**只搭环境 + 验证 NPU**（未下载任何大模型）
- 结论：**NPU 已验证可用**，OpenVINO 能识别并在其上编译、执行模型

---

## 1. 已安装组件（全部在 `D:\AI_file`）

| 组件 | 版本 | 路径 | 校验证据 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Python（AI 专用） | **3.12.10** | `D:\AI_file\runtime\python\3.12.10` | MD5 `5eddb0b6f12c852725de071ae681dde4` 与官方一致；**Authenticode Valid：Python Software Foundation** |
| MinGit | **2.56.0** | `D:\AI_file\tools\git\2.56.0` | **SHA-256 与官方一致** `064b440ff870ed5198527e8f3a92cdf5bd2fd0fedf5e718af95e3fdaddeff718` |
| OpenVINO | **2026.4.1** | venv：`D:\AI_file\envs\openvino` | 清华镜像安装（6.6 MB/s），含 numpy 2.5.3 |

Python 安装采用最小侵入：`InstallAllUsers=0 PrependPath=0 Include_launcher=0 AssociateFiles=0 Shortcuts=0`，
**不改 PATH、不装 py 启动器、不改文件关联**，与现有通用 Python 3.14.7 完全隔离。

## 2. NPU 验证结果（关键结论）

设备枚举（OpenVINO）：

```
CPU  -> Intel(R) Core(TM) Ultra 5 338H
GPU  -> Intel(R) Arc(TM) B370 GPU (iGPU)
NPU  -> Intel(R) AI Boost        ← 已就绪
```

同一卷积模型（Conv3x3 → ReLU → AvgPool）在三个设备上编译并执行：

| 设备 | 结果 | 编译耗时 | 推理平均 | 最小 | p95 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| CPU | ✅ OK | 22 ms | 0.050 ms | 0.036 ms | 0.086 ms |
| GPU | ✅ OK | 1449 ms | 0.056 ms | 0.049 ms | 0.071 ms |
| **NPU** | ✅ **OK** | **185 ms** | 0.123 ms | 0.101 ms | 0.189 ms |

说明：模型极小（32x32x3 输入），耗时被调度开销主导，因此三者接近；**关键结论是 NPU 能编译、能执行、
输出形状正确**。GPU 首次编译 1.4 s 是着色器编译（后续有缓存会显著变快）。
真实模型（VLM/检测器）的差距要在下载模型后单独测（NPU 的优势在能效与低占用，不在这种微模型的延迟）。

## 3. `D:\AI_file` 目录结构

```
D:\AI_file\
├─ README.md            目录说明（含约定）
├─ registry.json        AI 环境/模型/数据集登记表（已登记 2 项环境）
├─ runtime\python\3.12.10\
├─ tools\git\2.56.0\
├─ envs\openvino\
├─ models\  datasets\  outputs\  logs\  workspace\  _downloads\  _caches\
```

## 4. 准则更新（v1.1.0 → **v1.2.0**）

- `policy/storage-policy.json`：新增 `aiRoot` 块（root/layout/registry/rule/verification）
- `policy/output-storage-policy.md`：新增「AI 文件根目录」章节
- `policy/deploy/global-agents.md`：规则 5 增加第 6 条（AI 专用文件 → `D:\AI_file`）
- `AGENTS.md`：规则 4 增加第 7 条（同步）
- 全局副本已重新部署（3490 → 3763 字符，备份 `~/.dsh/AGENTS.md.bak-20261004-180726`）
- 自检：**FAIL=0 WARN=0**

分工原则：**AI 专属 → `D:\AI_file`**；**通用运行时 → `D:\program_runtime_environment`**，两者不混放。

## 5. 过程中的三个坑（记录备用）

1. **Python 3.12.15 没有安装包**：3.12 已进入"仅安全修复"阶段，官方明确
   "3.12.10 是最后一个带二进制安装包的 3.12"。选版时必须先看发布页，别只看版本号大小。
2. **python.org 国内很慢**：25.7 MB 的安装包耗时 **533 秒**（约 50 KB/s）。大文件优先找国内镜像。
3. **gh-proxy 这次失败了**（GitHub 下载中断）；改用 **npmmirror** 的 git-for-windows 二进制镜像，
   39.6 MB 用时 **116 秒**，并按官方 SHA-256 校验通过。

## 6. 下一步（等你发话）

1. 下载并转换第一个视觉模型：**Qwen2.5-VL-3B-INT4（NPU）**，配套 PP-OCRv5 与检测器
2. 封装为 **MCP 工具** + DSH skill，让对话里可直接调用（`vision.ask / ocr / describe / detect`）
3. 之后按需加：SDXL 生图（B2 路线）、YOLO/Anomalib 训练环境（C1 路线）
4. 云端算力（AMD 云平台）先搁置；将来配置时注意：**AMD = ROCm**，紫东太初官方栈是 NVIDIA 专用，
   那条线只能跑 Qwen2.5-VL 微调
'@

  - this run: environment only + NPU verification, no model downloads

WHAT WAS DONE
-------------
1. Created D:\AI_file with runtime\ tools\ envs\ models\ datasets\ outputs\ logs\ workspace\
   _downloads\ _caches\ plus README.md and registry.json.
2. Python 3.12.10 (26,964,224 bytes) downloaded from python.org in 533.5 s (~50 KB/s).
   Verified: MD5 5eddb0b6f12c852725de071ae681dde4 matches python.org; Authenticode Valid,
   signer CN=Python Software Foundation.
   Installed per-user to D:\AI_file\runtime\python\3.12.10 (115 MB) with
   InstallAllUsers=0 PrependPath=0 Include_launcher=0 AssociateFiles=0 Shortcuts=0 CompileAll=0
   so it does not touch PATH, the py launcher or file associations.
3. MinGit 2.56.0 (39,602,073 bytes) from registry.npmmirror.com in 116.2 s.
   Verified: SHA-256 064b440ff870ed5198527e8f3a92cdf5bd2fd0fedf5e718af95e3fdaddeff718 matches the
   official release hash. Extracted to D:\AI_file\tools\git\2.56.0 (not on PATH).
4. venv at D:\AI_file\envs\openvino; pip installed openvino 2026.4.1, numpy 2.5.3,
   openvino-telemetry 2025.2.0 from the Tsinghua mirror (6.6 MB/s).

----------------------------------------
openvino available_devices: ['CPU', 'GPU', 'NPU']
   CPU -> Intel(R) Core(TM) Ultra 5 338H
   GPU -> Intel(R) Arc(TM) B370 GPU (iGPU)

MISTAKES AND CORRECTIONS (for future runs)
------------------------------------------
- First pick was Python 3.12.15, which has NO binary installer: 3.12 is security-fix-only and

环境搭好了，**NPU 验证通过**。

## 核心结论：NPU 真的能用

```
CPU  -> Intel(R) Core(TM) Ultra 5 338H
GPU  -> Intel(R) Arc(TM) B370 GPU (iGPU)
NPU  -> Intel(R) AI Boost          ← 已就绪

同一模型三设备实测：CPU ✅ OK ｜ GPU ✅ OK ｜ NPU ✅ OK
```

| 设备 | 编译 | 推理平均 | p95 |
|---|---|---|---|
| CPU | 22 ms | 0.050 ms | 0.086 ms |
| GPU | 1449 ms（首次着色器编译） | 0.056 ms | 0.071 ms |
| **NPU** | 185 ms | 0.123 ms | 0.189 ms |

模型极小（32×32 输入），耗时被调度开销主导，所以三者接近；**关键是 NPU 能编译、能执行、输出正确**。真实模型的差距要等下载模型后单独测——NPU 的优势在**能效与低占用**，不在这种微模型的延迟。

## 装了什么（全在 `D:\AI_file`）

| 组件 | 版本 | 校验 |
|---|---|---|
| Python（AI 专用） | **3.12.10** | MD5 与官方一致 + **签名 Valid：Python Software Foundation** |
| MinGit | **2.56.0** | **SHA-256 与官方一致** |
| OpenVINO | **2026.4.1** | venv `D:\AI_file\envs\openvino`（清华镜像 6.6 MB/s） |

Python 是最小侵入安装（`PrependPath=0`、不装 py 启动器、不改文件关联、不动 PATH），与你现有 3.14.7 **完全隔离**。

## 准则已升到 v1.2.0 并全局部署

新增 **`aiRoot`** 规则：**AI 专属 → `D:\AI_file`**，**通用运行时 → `program_runtime_environment`**，两者不混放。已同步到 `storage-policy.json`、说明文档、全局副本（`~/.dsh/AGENTS.md` 3490→3763 字符，带备份）与工作区 `AGENTS.md`。自检 **FAIL=0 WARN=0**。

## 三个值得记下的坑

1. **Python 3.12.15 根本没有安装包**——3.12 已进入"仅安全修复"阶段，**3.12.10 是最后一个带安装包的**。我按版本号大小选版差点踩空，是靠核对官方发布页才发现。
2. **python.org 国内极慢**：25.7 MB 花了 **533 秒**（~50 KB/s）。
3. **gh-proxy 这次失败了**，改走 **npmmirror** 的 git-for-windows 镜像（39.6 MB / 116 秒），且仍能按官方哈希校验。

## 下一步（等你发话）

按你之前定的顺序，接下来是**下载并转换第一个视觉模型**（Qwen2.5-VL-3B-INT4 跑 NPU + PP-OCRv5 + 检测器），然后**封装成 MCP 工具**让我能在对话里直接调用。这一步会下载数 GB 模型，你说开始我就动手。

另外提醒一句将来配置 AMD 云平台时的关键点：**AMD = ROCm**，而紫东太初官方服务栈是 **NVIDIA CUDA 专用**——那台机器上能训的只有 **Qwen2.5-VL 这条主线**，紫东太初仍留在 NVIDIA 环境里做基线。

This is the [Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct) model, converted to OpenVINO, with int4 weights for the language model, int8 weights for the other models.
The INT4 weights are compressed with symmetric, channel-wise quantization, with AWQ and scale estimation. The model works on CPU, GPU and NPU. See below for the model export command/properties.

## Download Model

To download the model, run `pip install huggingface-hub[cli]` and then:
```
huggingface-cli download helenai/Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct-ov-int4-npu --local-dir Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct-ov-int4-npu
```

## Run inference with OpenVINO GenAI

Use OpenVINO GenAI to run inference on this model. This model works with OpenVINO GenAI 2025.3 and later. For NPU inference, make sure to use the latest NPU driver ([Windows](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/download/794734/intel-npu-driver-windows.html), [Linux](https://github.com/intel/linux-npu-driver))

- Install OpenVINO GenAI and pillow:

```
pip install --upgrade openvino-genai pillow
```

- Download a test image: `curl -O "https://storage.openvinotoolkit.org/test_data/images/dog.jpg"`
- Run inference:

```python
import numpy as np
import openvino as ov
import openvino_genai
from PIL import Image

# Choose GPU instead of NPU to run the model on Intel integrated or discrete GPU, or CPU to run on CPU.
# CACHE_DIR caches the model the first time, so subsequent model loading will be faster
pipeline_config = {"CACHE_DIR": "model_cache"}
pipe = openvino_genai.VLMPipeline("Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct-ov-int4-npu", "NPU", **pipeline_config)

image = Image.open("dog.jpg")
# optional: resizing to a smaller size (depending on image and prompt) is often useful to speed up inference. 
image = image.resize((128, 128))

image_data = np.array(image.getdata()).reshape(1, image.size[1], image.size[0], 3).astype(np.uint8)
image_data = ov.Tensor(image_data)  

prompt = "Can you describe the image?"
result = pipe.generate(prompt, image=image_data, max_new_tokens=100)
print(result.texts[0])
```

See [OpenVINO GenAI repository](https://github.com/openvinotoolkit/openvino.genai?tab=readme-ov-file#performing-visual-language-text-generation)

import argparse
import time

import openvino as ov
import openvino_genai

    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()

        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001

if __name__ == "__main__":

"""Compare devices and measure throughput for the local VLM (OpenVINO GenAI)."""
import argparse
import time

import numpy as np
import openvino as ov
import openvino_genai
from PIL import Image

DEFAULT_MODEL = r"D:\AI_file\models\qwen2.5-vl-3b-ov-int4-npu"
DEFAULT_CACHE = r"D:\AI_file\_caches\openvino-model-cache"


def build_tensor(path):
    image = Image.open(path).convert("RGB")
    arr = np.asarray(image, dtype=np.uint8).reshape(1, image.size[1], image.size[0], 3)
    return ov.Tensor(arr), image.size


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--model", default=DEFAULT_MODEL)
    ap.add_argument("--image", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--prompt", default="Describe this image in one sentence.")
    ap.add_argument("--devices", default="NPU,CPU")
    ap.add_argument("--max-new-tokens", type=int, default=128)
    ap.add_argument("--cache-dir", default=DEFAULT_CACHE)
    args = ap.parse_args()

    tensor, size = build_tensor(args.image)
    print("image %s (%dx%d)  prompt: %s" % (args.image, size[0], size[1], args.prompt))
    print()
    print("%-5s %10s %10s %10s %12s" % ("dev", "load(s)", "gen(s)", "out_tok", "tok/s"))
    for dev in [d.strip() for d in args.devices.split(",") if d.strip()]:
        try:
            t0 = time.perf_counter()
            pipe = openvino_genai.VLMPipeline(args.model, dev, CACHE_DIR=args.cache_dir)
            load_s = time.perf_counter() - t0
            t0 = time.perf_counter()
            res = pipe.generate(args.prompt, image=tensor, max_new_tokens=args.max_new_tokens)
            gen_s = time.perf_counter() - t0
            text = res.texts[0] if getattr(res, "texts", None) else str(res)
            ntok = None
            try:
                pm = res.perf_metrics
                for attr in ("get_num_generated_tokens",):
                    if hasattr(pm, attr):
                        ntok = getattr(pm, attr)()
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                pass
            tps = (ntok / gen_s) if (ntok and gen_s) else float("nan")
            print("%-5s %10.1f %10.1f %10s %12.2f" % (dev, load_s, gen_s, ntok if ntok else "?", tps))
            print("      answer: " + text.strip().replace("\n", " ")[:160])
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            print("%-5s FAILED: %s: %s" % (dev, type(exc).__name__, str(exc)[:200]))
    print()
    print("perf metric methods on VLMPerfMetrics:", [m for m in dir(openvino_genai.VLMPerfMetrics) if m.startswith("get_")])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
