tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

## Introduction[#](#introduction)

ZDTaichu5.0-9B is a multimodal foundation model for general visual understanding, spatial reasoning, agentic tool use, and embodied-AI research. It combines a Qwen3.5-9B language backbone with a C-RADIOv4-H vision encoder, supports text, images and videos with any-resolution visual input.

Within the 9B-scale general-purpose VLMs compared in this release blog, ZDTaichu5.0-9B retains first-tier general visual understanding while supporting spatial reasoning, high-level embodied VLM reasoning, and agent tasks under the reported evaluation settings. Rather than trading broad visual competence for specialization, it layers a more comprehensive spatial, embodied, and agent capability profile on top of a strong general-vision foundation.

The model accepts text, one or more images, and video. It is designed for:

-   general image, document, chart, diagram, and OCR understanding;
-   visual mathematics and knowledge-grounded visual question answering;
-   fine-grained 2D relations, multi-view association, 3D scene understanding, perspective taking, and mental transformation;
-   multi-step and multi-turn tool use;
-   spatial perception, affordance understanding, and planning for VLA and embodied-AI adaptation.

## Highlights[#](#highlights)

-   **Strong general vision and broad capabilities:** remains in the leading group of 9B-scale general-purpose VLMs across images, documents, charts, diagrams, OCR, visual mathematics, multiple images and video, while extending to spatial reasoning, high-level embodied understanding and multi-step agent tasks.
-   **Leading spatial reasoning and embodied understanding:** leads spatial capability among the compared 9B-scale general-purpose VLMs, with strong results on SparBench, ViewSpatial, MMSI-Bench and MindCube-tiny. Scores of 48 on ERQA and 56 on RoboSpatial cover scene reasoning, affordances and interaction-oriented understanding.
-   **Strongest agent capability among the compared 9B-scale general-purpose VLMs:** leads the reported TAU2-Bench (87.7) and Claw-Eval (71.4) comparisons, and reaches 93.7 on IFEval.
-   **Entropy-Gated Adaptive Recurrent Reasoning:** Dynamically allocates additional recurrent refinement steps in latent space to more challenging tokens, enabling greater computational depth where needed and improving reasoning performance on complex tasks.

## Model Overview[#](#model-overview)

| Item | Specification |
| --- | --- |
| Model type | Multimodal causal language model with vision encoder |
| Language backbone | Qwen3.5-9B LLM Decoder |
| Vision backbone | C-RADIOv4-H |
| Context length | Up to 128K tokens |
| Vision resolution | Any-resolution visual input |
| Input modalities | Text, single image, multiple images, and video |

# Python 3.12.15

**Release date:** Sept. 30, 2026

## This is a security release of Python 3.12

**Note:** The release you're looking at is Python 3.12.15, a **security bugfix release** for the legacy 3.12 series. _Python 3.14_ is now the latest feature release series of Python 3. [Get the latest release of 3.14.x here](/downloads/).

## Security content in this release

-   [CVE-2026-19445](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-19445) [gh-156293](https://github.com/python/cpython/issues/156293) Use-after-free of a server-side `SSLContext` when `sni_callback` switches contexts
    
-   [CVE-2026-19553](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-19553) [gh-156793](https://github.com/python/cpython/issues/156793) `SSLContext.wrap_bio()` missing validation of server\_hostname parameter
    
-   [CVE-2026-82049](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-82049) [gh-157190](https://github.com/python/cpython/issues/157190) `tarfile` extraction filters allow file modification and content disclosure via hard link to symlink
    
-   [CVE-2026-15310](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-15310) [gh-156002](https://github.com/python/cpython/issues/156002) Memory exhaustion in `zipfile` in bzip2/LZMA/Zstandard decompression
    
-   [CVE-2026-19672](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-19672) [gh-155999](https://github.com/python/cpython/issues/155999) `tarfile` extraction filter bypass allows creation of directories outside the destination
    
-   [CVE-2026-15806](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-15806) [gh-155694](https://github.com/python/cpython/issues/155694) `urllib.request.HTTPPasswordMgr` credentials for one URL scheme sent over another scheme
    
-   [CVE-2026-17084](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-17084) [gh-155292](https://github.com/python/cpython/issues/155292) `StringPrep` algorithm considered Unicode codepoint attributes outside Unicode 3.2.0
    
-   [gh-158446](https://github.com/python/cpython/issues/158446) Reject float format precision near `INT_MAX`
    
-   [gh-157953](https://github.com/python/cpython/issues/157953) Update bundled Expat to [2.8.5](https://blog.hartwork.org/posts/expat-2-8-5-released/)
    
-   [CVE-2026-87910](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-87910) [gh-157265](https://github.com/python/cpython/issues/157265) `tarfile` hardlink fallback ignores custom extraction filter rejection via `None`

# Python 3.12.10

Note: Python 3.12.10 has been superseded by [Python 3.12.15](/downloads/release/python-31215/).

**Release date:** April 8, 2025

# This is the tenth maintenance release of Python 3.12

Python 3.12.10 is the latest maintenance release of Python 3.12, and the last full maintenance release. Subsequent releases of 3.12 will be _security-fixes only_. This last maintenance release contains about 230 bug fixes, build improvements and documentation changes since 3.12.9.

# Major new features of the 3.12 series, compared to 3.11

## New features

-   [More flexible f-string parsing](https://docs.python.org/3.12/whatsnew/3.12.html#pep-701-syntactic-formalization-of-f-strings), allowing many things previously disallowed ([PEP 701](https://peps.python.org/pep-0701/)).
-   [Support for the buffer protocol](https://docs.python.org/3.12/whatsnew/3.12.html#pep-688-making-the-buffer-protocol-accessible-in-python) in Python code ([PEP 688](https://peps.python.org/pep-0688/)).
-   [A new debugging/profiling API](https://docs.python.org/3.12/whatsnew/3.12.html#pep-669-low-impact-monitoring-for-cpython) ([PEP 669](https://peps.python.org/pep-0669/)).
-   [Support for isolated subinterpreters](https://docs.python.org/3.12/whatsnew/3.12.html#pep-684-a-per-interpreter-gil) with separate Global Interpreter Locks ([PEP 684](https://peps.python.org/pep-0684)).
-   [Even more improved error messages](https://docs.python.org/3.12/whatsnew/3.12.html#improved-error-messages). More exceptions potentially caused by typos now make suggestions to the user.
-   [Support for the Linux `perf` profiler](https://docs.python.org/3.12/howto/perf_profiling.html) to report Python function names in traces.
-   [Many large and small performance improvements](https://docs.python.org/3.12/whatsnew/3.12.html#optimizations) (like [PEP 709](https://peps.python.org/pep-0709/) and support for the BOLT binary optimizer), delivering an estimated 5% overall performance improvement.

## Type annotations

-   [New type annotation syntax](https://docs.python.org/3.12/whatsnew/3.12.html#pep-695-type-parameter-syntax) for generic classes ([PEP 695](https://peps.python.org/pep-0695/)).
-   [New override decorator](https://docs.python.org/3.12/whatsnew/3.12.html#pep-698-override-decorator-for-static-typing) for methods ([PEP 698](https://peps.python.org/pep-0698)).

## Deprecations

-   The deprecated `wstr` and `wstr_length` members of the C implementation of unicode objects were removed, per [PEP 623](https://peps.python.org/pep-0623/).
-   In the `unittest` module, a number of long deprecated methods and classes were removed. (They had been deprecated since Python 3.1 or 3.2.)

lines.text: description: "MCP client bridge for deployments and maintainers choosing, configuring, or debugging connections to external MCP servers whose tools register on ctx.tools."

`dsh-mcp-client` lets the model use tools and resources from external Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers. Configure one server per entry; its tools use names such as `mcp__github__create_issue`. No server is enabled by default. Shipped profiles already provide [shared resource discovery and reading](../mcp-resources/README.md). An empty caller scope adds no MCP tools or prompt text. Server instructions join the logged system prompt as literal text; MCP prompt templates are unsupported. Slow or crashed servers can delay startup or fail calls until recovery.

Add `dsh-mcp-client` when the model should call tools from an external MCP server as if they were native. Give each server a unique name and transport. The official SDK selects the 2026-07-28 protocol when available and falls back to supported legacy revisions. Choose stdio for a local program and Streamable HTTP for a service; stdio negotiation starts a temporary probe process before the serving process.
Add one entry per server; nothing else is required. After the harness starts, the server's tools appear in the model's tool list.
| `serverName` | required | Namespace for the server's tool names; `[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,32}`, unique inside one registration scope |
| `command` / `args` / `env` / `cwd` | — | stdio: executable, arguments, extra env merged over scrubbed ambient env, working directory |
| `url` / `headers` | — | streamable-http: endpoint URL and extra request headers |
| `maxInstructionBytes` | `32,768` | Maximum UTF-8 bytes of server instructions including attribution; an oversized value rejects the connection |
| `failOnStartupError` | `false` | Reject plugin activation when the initial connection or tool synchronization fails |
| `reconnect.enabled` | `true` | Reconnect automatically after a lost connection |
| `reconnect.initialDelayMs` | `500` | First reconnect delay; doubles per consecutive failed attempt |
| `reconnect.maxDelayMs` | `30,000` | Backoff ceiling; also the uptime after which the attempt budget resets |
| `reconnect.maxAttempts` | `10` | Consecutive failed attempts per outage before giving up |
The generated [configuration catalog](../../../docs/config-catalog.md#deepseek-aidsh-mcp-client) is the exhaustive source for every accepted field.

After startup, the server's tools appear as `mcp__<serverName>__<tool>` — try a prompt that uses one. If the initial connection fails, the harness still starts but no tools from that server appear, and an error is logged. Setting `failOnStartupError: true` rejects plugin activation; [app-boot's startup policy](../../boot/app-boot/README.md) still permits an optional MCP entry to fail without aborting the harness.

The model sees each tool under a stable server-qualified name: `mcp__<serverName>__<rawName>`, for example `mcp__github__create_issue` — the same naming shape Claude Code and Codex use. Names stay stable while the server keeps the same tool name, so session history and permission rules survive restarts and reloads. Two servers can both offer a tool named `search` and coexist as `mcp__github__search` and `mcp__web__search`.
- Two servers publishing the same tool name (for example `search`) coexist under their own namespaces.
- Two entries using the same server name: the later one fails to load with a clear error.
- A server that lists the same tool twice gets its tool list rejected as invalid, and the previous tool set stays active.
- The SDK owns discovery pagination and its page limit. A discovery failure preserves the previous tools; malformed cursor chains follow the SDK's behavior.
- An update that conflicts with an already-registered tool name is rejected entirely — you never get a partial tool set from that server.

When the model calls an MCP tool, the call runs against the remote server with a per-call timeout (default 60 seconds) and can be cancelled like any other tool call. The result comes back as ordinary text in block order; resource links appear as text with their name and URI. If the server reports an error, the call fails visibly — the model does not see a fake success.

Images are supported when the current model accepts image input and the harness attachment feature is enabled; they then appear in the conversation like other images. Otherwise — and for audio or embedded resources — the model sees a clear diagnostic message instead of nothing.

The server's tools appear before the harness starts its first turn. When the server changes its tool list, the model's tool set updates automatically; if the update fails, the previous tool set keeps working.

When a server connection drops — for example a local server process crashes — the plugin reconnects automatically with delays that double from 500 ms up to 30 s and then refreshes the tool set; reconnect progress is visible in the logs. During an outage the last known tools stay listed but calls to them fail until the server recovers. After ten consecutive failed attempts the server's tools are removed and reconnection stops until you reload the configuration or restart the harness; a server that stays connected for a while resets that counter. Set `reconnect.enabled: false` to disable automatic reconnection — tools then stay listed but fail until you reload. Editing the configuration entry reloads the server connection in place, and unchanged names stay unchanged.
This section explains the design decisions behind the bridge and points at the code that realizes them; the observable behavior is fully covered in [Use this package](#use-this-package).

- **Server-qualified identity.** Every MCP tool has the stable identity `(serverName, rawName)`. The namespace is local configuration, never the remote `serverInfo.name` — the remote name is untrusted, not unique across deployments, and can change on upgrade, none of which may silently rename model-facing tools.

- **Naming is a pinned contract.** Public names are pure functions of `(serverName, rawName)` and satisfy the DeepSeek function-name contract; lossy normalization appends a 12-hex-char SHA-256 hash so distinct identities never collapse. Session history and permission rules therefore survive HMR swaps, re-syncs, and other servers' changes.
- **The raw name is the only wire name.** `tools/call` always receives the raw name; the public name is never sent to the server and never parsed to recover the raw name.
- **Full generation or none.** Syncs swap generations atomically: a fetch failure keeps the previous generation, and a registration conflict rolls back the entire attempted generation.

- **One canonical value, one projection.** The executor preserves the complete canonical MCP value and prepares ordered text/image content. `projectContent` installs that content before `tools/post-execute`, so retention sees real images. Subsequent content replacement, value replacement, and blocking remain authoritative.
| [`src/index.ts`](src/index.ts) | Plugin entry: `Config` schema, `serverName` reservation, activation await |
| [`src/connection.ts`](src/connection.ts) | Connection supervisor: client generations, reconnect policy, attempt budget, disposal |
| [`src/server-context.ts`](src/server-context.ts) | Resource-provider registration and literal server instructions |
| [`src/tools.ts`](src/tools.ts) | Tool bridge: discovery, naming, registration swap, execution, image projection |

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. **一张室内 cosplay 摄影作品**：一位**戴兔耳发饰、棕色长发**的女生，坐在**打开的黄色扭蛋机（gachapon）出货口**内。

The user asks: "你能不能同时访问多个工作区" — Can you access multiple workspaces at the same time?

This is a question about my capabilities/architecture. Let me think about what's true and verifiable:

1. **What is a "workspace" in DSH?** From the docs I've read: a DSH session has a **workspace root** (the cwd / session workspace). The `dsh` launcher says "the directory you run the command in becomes the default workspace root". Profiles have sessions stored per workspace: `~/.dsh/sessions/--E-Deepseek--/session-...` — the directory name encodes the workspace path (`--E-Deepseek--` = E:\Deepseek). So **sessions are grouped by workspace root**.

2. **Can I access files outside my workspace?** Yes — with the file tools I can read absolute paths anywhere (I've been reading `C:\Users\...\.dsh`, `D:\AI_file`, etc.), and with `danger-full-access` escalation I can write outside. So *file access* to multiple locations is possible.

3. **But** a single session has **one workspace root**:
   - Relative paths resolve against it.
   - The file sandbox's write permission is scoped to it (workspace-write).
   - Instructions (AGENTS.md chain) are loaded for that workspace.
   - Sessions are listed per workspace.

4. **Multiple workspaces simultaneously**: 
   - In one session? Not as "workspace roots" — but effectively yes for file access (absolute paths, with escalation for writes).
   - Multiple sessions on different workspaces can run **in parallel** (the host can serve multiple sessions; each session has its own workspace). The user could open another conversation/window with a different workspace. The GUI (web) supports multiple sessions.
   - Are they "simultaneous"? Two sessions can run concurrently if the host schedules them; a session's turns are sequential, but different sessions are independent agents.

5. **What about the workspace-relative tools?** `glob`/`grep` default to the session workspace; I can pass an explicit `path` to search another directory (grep has a `path` param, glob has a `path` param ✓). So I can search other trees.

6. **The practical constraints I've hit**:
   - `pwsh` commands run with the session workspace as cwd (and earlier, when E:\Deepseek disappeared, EVERYTHING broke — because the harness resolves the cwd at startup; and `workdir` didn't help in that broken state).
   - Writing outside the workspace requires escalation approval (I've done this many times for D:\AI_file and ~/.dsh).
   - The MCP vision server is workspace-agnostic (absolute paths) ✓ so the AI tools work for any workspace.
   - AGENTS.md instructions differ per workspace: my standard (E:\Deepseek) is injected for this workspace, plus the global one for all.

Let me verify some specifics before answering, to be accurate and concrete:
- Check the sessions directory: are there sessions for other workspaces? `~/.dsh/sessions/` subdirs = workspaces that have sessions. That shows whether the user has other workspaces in use.
- Check whether the profile config/capabilities allow multiple concurrent sessions (the web GUI supports multiple; how many can run at once?).
- Check DSH's docs for "workspace" semantics (maybe there's a `--workspace` flag or config for allowed roots).

Also relevant: the DSH **sandbox policy** (workspace-write) and whether additional writable roots can be configured (e.g., `settings.yaml` with extra roots?). If there's a config for extra writable paths/roots, that's the answer to "can I work across multiple workspaces without repeated escalation".

That's an important practical angle: the user has been approving `danger-full-access` repeatedly — maybe DSH has a way to declare additional workspace roots or writable paths (e.g., settings `sandbox.additionalRoots`), which would make multi-workspace work smoother.

Let me investigate:
1. `~/.dsh/sessions/` — list workspace dirs (evidence of multiple workspaces).
2. Search DSH docs/config for workspace-related settings: e.g., `dsh --dump-config-schema` (huge), or grep the CLI/app for "workspace" config keys. Better: search the installed CLI's README/docs for "workspace".
3. Check `settings.yaml` (project or global) for sandbox/permission settings — `~/.dsh/settings.yaml`? Earlier I saw `settings.yaml.imported` in ~/.dsh but not settings.yaml. Let me check for a settings file that defines the file policy.

Let me do a quick investigation, then answer with:
- Direct answer: In one session I have exactly **one workspace root** (used for relative paths, the write sandbox, and the injected AGENTS.md), but I can **read anywhere** and **write elsewhere with approval**; and **multiple sessions on different workspaces can run in parallel**.
- Evidence: sessions dir shows per-workspace grouping; my own actions in this session (read D:/C: freely, wrote to D: with approval).
- Practical implications: what works well (this session using E:\Deepseek + D:\AI_file + ~/.dsh), what doesn't (auto-relative paths, no workspace-scoped permissions for other roots, and if the workspace drive disappears everything breaks).
- Options: how to make multi-workspace smoother (e.g., declare extra roots if DSH supports it; or open separate conversations per workspace; or set the AI tools' paths absolutely as I did).

- 相对路径只解析到本工作区
- 不带 `path` 的 `glob`/`grep` 只搜本工作区
- `pwsh` 默认 cwd 是本工作区（可传 `workdir`，但依赖 cwd 的解析仍在启动时发生）
- 两个目录**不能平等地当"工作区根"**

## 一个真实的风险（本对话亲身踩过）

本会话工作区在**可移动卡 E:** 上。有一次卡拔掉后，`pwsh`／`glob`／`grep` **全部失效**——连命令都启动不了，因为 harness 启动时要先解析工作目录是否存在。后来只能等卡插回来。**工作区放在可移动介质上很脆弱。**

1. **想让我在 `D:\AI_file` 免审批写入** → 用 `D:\AI_file` 作为工作区开新会话（你机器上已有一个），AI 相关的活儿都在那儿干最顺
2. **保持现状**（E: 工作区 + D: 提权写）也合理：D 盘干活、E 盘存档交付；代价是每次跨区写弹一次审批
3. **AI 工具不受工作区限制**：MCP 视觉工具走绝对路径，任何工作区的会话都能用同一套 NPU 视觉能力

顺便说一句：DSH 还支持 `--patch` 覆盖层和"从模板创建 profile"，所以如果你想让**所有**工作区都共享某套规则（比如把我们定的存放准则、AI 工具路径约定），现在已经通过全局 `~/.dsh/AGENTS.md` 实现了——**换工作区也照样生效**。

要不要我帮你把 AI 相关的工作流整体迁到 `D:\AI_file` 工作区（在那儿建目录规范、把脚本和交付物搬过去）？还是保持现在这种"E 盘工作区 + D 盘提权"的方式？

本会话工作区在**可移动卡 E:** 上。有一次卡拔掉后，`pwsh`／`glob`／`grep` **全部失效**——连命令都启动不了，因为 harness 启动时要先解析工作目录是否存在。后来只能等卡插回来。**工作区放在可移动介质上很脆弱。**

1. **想让我在 `D:\AI_file` 免审批写入** → 用 `D:\AI_file` 作为工作区开新会话（你机器上已有一个），AI 相关的活儿都在那儿干最顺

3. **AI 工具不受工作区限制**：MCP 视觉工具走绝对路径，任何工作区的会话都能用同一套 NPU 视觉能力

content.arguments:
{"command": "$policy = @'
# AI 工具调用规则（AI Tool Calling Policy）

- 版本：1.0.0 ｜ 更新：__DATE__
- 适用：**所有工作区、所有对话**。规则源在本文件；机器可读版 `policy\ai-tools.json`。
- 目的：让 Agent 在"看图 / 读文档 / 出图 / 检测"时**选对工具、知道边界、不误信结果**。

---

## 1. 工具清单（本机已部署，实测数据）

| 工具 | 后端 | 设备 | 实测耗时 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `vision_read_document(path, pages, dpi, prefer)` | PDF 文字层 → PP-OCR → VLM | CPU/NPU | 文字层 ~0 s；OCR 1.3–4.1 s/页；VLM 11–18 s | **文档的首选入口**，自动分流 |
| `vision_ocr(image_path)` | rapidocr PP-OCRv6-small（OpenVINO） | **CPU**（上游写死） | 0.6–4.1 s | 原生分辨率、**无 token 上限**；小字、表格、引脚图都读得出 |
| `vision_describe(image_path)` | Qwen2.5-VL-3B INT4（OpenVINO GenAI） | **NPU** | 11–18 s | 图形/图表/框图/场景/照片 |
| `vision_ask(image_path, question)` | 同上 | NPU | 11–18 s | 视觉问答：计数、方位、图表读数、缺陷提问 |
| `vision_status()` | — | — | 瞬时 | 查引擎、设备、token 预算 |

模型侧工具名形如 **`mcp__vision__vision_ocr`**。服务端：`D:\AI_file\mcp\vision-server.py`（v1.4）。

## 2. 路由规则（按顺序判断，命中即用）

```
1) 是 PDF 且是电子原生（有文字层）  → vision_read_document        ← 精确、瞬时，禁止绕道 OCR
2) 是扫描件/照片里的文字/截图/标签   → vision_ocr                  ← 原生分辨率，小字也准
3) 是图形、图表、框图、曲线、场景、照片 → vision_describe / vision_ask
4) 需要具体数值（型号/序列号/尺寸/金额/电压/剂量）
                                    → 必须来自 文字层 或 vision_ocr；**禁止采信 VLM**
5) 图片很大且要看细节               → 先裁出目标区域再调用（VLM 会把图缩到 ≤980 token）
6) 表格                           → vision_ocr（VLM 只适合给结构提示，不适合抄表）
```

**一句话记忆**：**文字走 OCR/文字层，图形走 VLM；数字只信 OCR。**

## 3. 硬限制与已知缺陷（必须知道，否则会白等）

| 限制 | 数值/表现 | 对策 |
|---|---|---|
| **NPU 视觉输入上限** | **≤1024 token ≈ 80 万像素**；超过直接报错 | 服务端已自动裁白边并降到 ≤980 token；要细节就**先裁区域** |
| `MAX_PROMPT_LEN` | **NPU 专属**，GPU/CPU 拒绝；且抬高后**输出为空** → 不可用 | 不要试图抬高上限 |
| **空输出（偶发）** | 模型有时把 EOS 当第一个 token，返回空 | 服务端已用 `min_new_tokens` 阶梯（1→32→96）自动重试；仍失败则换工具或裁小块重试 |
| 大图必被降采样 | 4096×2730 的照片会被降到 **26%**（940 token） | 主体/姿态/配色可靠；**面部、纹理、小字会丢** → 裁切或改 OCR |
| PP-OCR 走 CPU | 上游 `compile_model(..., device_name="CPU")` 写死 | 1–4 s/页可接受，NPU 留给 VLM；**不要声称 OCR 用了 NPU** |
| VLM 幻觉 | 实测把型号 CH634 说成 "CH63034" | 标识符/数字**一律以 OCR/文字层为准**，并在回答里注明来源 |
| VLM 输出长度 | 约 400–900 字符/次（受 `max_new_tokens` 限制） | 长文档**逐页**读，不要指望一次读完 |

## 4. 结果可信度与验证（写进回答里的硬要求）

1. **可信度分级**：文字层 = 精确；PP-OCR = 高（逐字准确，实测与文字层一致）；VLM = **中等偏低**（语义可靠、细节不可靠）。
2. **凡引用数字/型号/规格**：必须来自文字层或 OCR；若只有 VLM 结果，须标注"**未经 OCR 校验**"。
3. **回答里给出来源**：说明用了哪个工具、什么设备、耗时多少（如"文字层，瞬时"、"PP-OCR 4.1 s"、"VLM/NPU 17 s"）。
4. **不确定就说**：VLM 对品类/型号的判断经常不准，不要把它当作事实转述。

## 5. 调用规范

1. **路径**：全部传**绝对 Windows 路径**；PDF 用 `vision_read_document`（不要先转图再 OCR）。
2. **分页**：`pages` 支持 `'1'`、`'1,3'`、`'2-5'`；`dpi` 默认 150（表格/小字可提到 200–300，但单页像素别超 80 万太多，否则 VLM 会被降采样）。
3. **优先低成本路径**：文字层 > PP-OCR > VLM。文档类任务**不要**直接上 VLM。
4. **中间产物**：渲染页缓存于 `D:\AI_file\workspace\pdf-pages\`；服务端日志 `D:\AI_file\logs\vision-mcp.log`。
5. **跨工作区写入**：`D:\AI_file` 在工作区之外，写入需 `danger-full-access` 提权；只读调用无需提权。
6. **调用失败先看日志**：`D:\AI_file\logs\vision-mcp.log` 记录了每次调用的设备、耗时、裁剪/降采样与重试过程。

## 6. 隐私与成本

- **全部本地推理**：无网络请求，**数据不出本机**。涉密/客户资料可以放心交给这些工具。
- **无 API 费用**：本地算力，不需要节省调用次数；但要**节省时间**——按第 2 节路由选最合适的工具。
- 需要外部模型（紫东太初等）时，走云端需另经许可，**不得默认外发**。

## 7. 预留工具（尚未部署，名字先占位）

| 预留名 | 计划后端 | 设备 | 用途 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `image_generate` | SDXL（先）/ Flux.1-schnell（后），OpenVINO | iGPU | 生成图片 |
| `vision_detect` | RT-DETR / YOLOX（Apache-2.0） | NPU/GPU | 目标/缺陷检测定位 |
| `anomaly_score` | Anomalib（PatchCore/EfficientAD） | NPU | 工业异常检测评分 |

新工具上线时必须：① 在 `D:\AI_file\registry.json` 登记；② 通过 MCP 暴露；③ **同步更新本文件与 `policy\ai-tools.json`**，
并在 `%DSH_HOME%\AGENTS.md` 里保持一句话索引。

## 8. 变更流程

1. 改本文件 + `policy\ai-tools.json`；
2. 若影响所有对话，同步 `policy\deploy\global-agents.md`；
3. 运行 `E:\Deepseek\tools\Install-GlobalPolicy.ps1` 重新部署全局副本；
4. 在 `logs\<conv-id>\` 留一条变更日志。

## 9. 快速参考卡

| 我要… | 用 |
|---|---|
| 读一份 PDF | `vision_read_document`（文字层自动优先） |
| 读扫描件/截图/标签 | `vision_ocr` |
| 看一张照片/图表讲清楚 | `vision_describe` |
| 问图里"有几个/在哪/是什么" | `vision_ask` |
| 抄型号、序列号、数字 | `vision_ocr`（**永远不要用 VLM 抄数字**） |
| 表格 | `vision_ocr` |
| 查后端状态 | `vision_status` |
'@

# AI 工具调用规则（AI Tool Calling Policy）

- 版本：1.0.0 ｜ 更新：__DATE__
- 适用：**所有工作区、所有对话**。规则源在本文件；机器可读版 `policy\ai-tools.json`。
- 目的：让 Agent 在"看图 / 读文档 / 出图 / 检测"时**选对工具、知道边界、不误信结果**。

---

## 1. 工具清单（本机已部署，实测数据）

| 工具 | 后端 | 设备 | 实测耗时 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `vision_read_document(path, pages, dpi, prefer)` | PDF 文字层 → PP-OCR → VLM | CPU/NPU | 文字层 ~0 s；OCR 1.3–4.1 s/页；VLM 11–18 s | **文档的首选入口**，自动分流 |
| `vision_ocr(image_path)` | rapidocr PP-OCRv6-small（OpenVINO） | **CPU**（上游写死） | 0.6–4.1 s | 原生分辨率、**无 token 上限**；小字、表格、引脚图都读得出 |
| `vision_describe(image_path)` | Qwen2.5-VL-3B INT4（OpenVINO GenAI） | **NPU** | 11–18 s | 图形/图表/框图/场景/照片 |
| `vision_ask(image_path, question)` | 同上 | NPU | 11–18 s | 视觉问答：计数、方位、图表读数、缺陷提问 |
| `vision_status()` | — | — | 瞬时 | 查引擎、设备、token 预算 |

模型侧工具名形如 **`mcp__vision__vision_ocr`**。服务端：`D:\AI_file\mcp\vision-server.py`（v1.4）。

## 2. 路由规则（按顺序判断，命中即用）

```
1) 是 PDF 且是电子原生（有文字层）  → vision_read_document        ← 精确、瞬时，禁止绕道 OCR
2) 是扫描件/照片里的文字/截图/标签   → vision_ocr                  ← 原生分辨率，小字也准
3) 是图形、图表、框图、曲线、场景、照片 → vision_describe / vision_ask
4) 需要具体数值（型号/序列号/尺寸/金额/电压/剂量）
                                    → 必须来自 文字层 或 vision_ocr；**禁止采信 VLM**
5) 图片很大且要看细节               → 先裁出目标区域再调用（VLM 会把图缩到 ≤980 token）
6) 表格                           → vision_ocr（VLM 只适合给结构提示，不适合抄表）
```

**一句话记忆**：**文字走 OCR/文字层，图形走 VLM；数字只信 OCR。**

## 3. 硬限制与已知缺陷（必须知道，否则会白等）

| 限制 | 数值/表现 | 对策 |
|---|---|---|
| **NPU 视觉输入上限** | **≤1024 token ≈ 80 万像素**；超过直接报错 | 服务端已自动裁白边并降到 ≤980 token；要细节就**先裁区域** |
| `MAX_PROMPT_LEN` | **NPU 专属**，GPU/CPU 拒绝；且抬高后**输出为空** → 不可用 | 不要试图抬高上限 |
| **空输出（偶发）** | 模型有时把 EOS 当第一个 token，返回空 | 服务端已用 `min_new_tokens` 阶梯（1→32→96）自动重试；仍失败则换工具或裁小块重试 |
| 大图必被降采样 | 4096×2730 的照片会被降到 **26%**（940 token） | 主体/姿态/配色可靠；**面部、纹理、小字会丢** → 裁切或改 OCR |
| PP-OCR 走 CPU | 上游 `compile_model(..., device_name="CPU")` 写死 | 1–4 s/页可接受，NPU 留给 VLM；**不要声称 OCR 用了 NPU** |
| VLM 幻觉 | 实测把型号 CH634 说成 "CH63034" | 标识符/数字**一律以 OCR/文字层为准**，并在回答里注明来源 |
| VLM 输出长度 | 约 400–900 字符/次（受 `max_new_tokens` 限制） | 长文档**逐页**读，不要指望一次读完 |

## 4. 结果可信度与验证（写进回答里的硬要求）

1. **可信度分级**：文字层 = 精确；PP-OCR = 高（逐字准确，实测与文字层一致）；VLM = **中等偏低**（语义可靠、细节不可靠）。
2. **凡引用数字/型号/规格**：必须来自文字层或 OCR；若只有 VLM 结果，须标注"**未经 OCR 校验**"。
3. **回答里给出来源**：说明用了哪个工具、什么设备、耗时多少（如"文字层，瞬时"、"PP-OCR 4.1 s"、"VLM/NPU 17 s"）。
4. **不确定就说**：VLM 对品类/型号的判断经常不准，不要把它当作事实转述。

## 5. 调用规范

1. **路径**：全部传**绝对 Windows 路径**；PDF 用 `vision_read_document`（不要先转图再 OCR）。
2. **分页**：`pages` 支持 `'1'`、`'1,3'`、`'2-5'`；`dpi` 默认 150（表格/小字可提到 200–300，但单页像素别超 80 万太多，否则 VLM 会被降采样）。
3. **优先低成本路径**：文字层 > PP-OCR > VLM。文档类任务**不要**直接上 VLM。
4. **中间产物**：渲染页缓存于 `D:\AI_file\workspace\pdf-pages\`；服务端日志 `D:\AI_file\logs\vision-mcp.log`。
5. **跨工作区写入**：`D:\AI_file` 在工作区之外，写入需 `danger-full-access` 提权；只读调用无需提权。
6. **调用失败先看日志**：`D:\AI_file\logs\vision-mcp.log` 记录了每次调用的设备、耗时、裁剪/降采样与重试过程。

## 6. 隐私与成本

- **全部本地推理**：无网络请求，**数据不出本机**。涉密/客户资料可以放心交给这些工具。
- **无 API 费用**：本地算力，不需要节省调用次数；但要**节省时间**——按第 2 节路由选最合适的工具。
- 需要外部模型（紫东太初等）时，走云端需另经许可，**不得默认外发**。

## 7. 预留工具（尚未部署，名字先占位）

| 预留名 | 计划后端 | 设备 | 用途 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `image_generate` | SDXL（先）/ Flux.1-schnell（后），OpenVINO | iGPU | 生成图片 |
| `vision_detect` | RT-DETR / YOLOX（Apache-2.0） | NPU/GPU | 目标/缺陷检测定位 |
| `anomaly_score` | Anomalib（PatchCore/EfficientAD） | NPU | 工业异常检测评分 |

新工具上线时必须：① 在 `D:\AI_file\registry.json` 登记；② 通过 MCP 暴露；③ **同步更新本文件与 `policy\ai-tools.json`**，
并在 `%DSH_HOME%\AGENTS.md` 里保持一句话索引。

## 8. 变更流程

1. 改本文件 + `policy\ai-tools.json`；
2. 若影响所有对话，同步 `policy\deploy\global-agents.md`；
3. 运行 `E:\Deepseek\tools\Install-GlobalPolicy.ps1` 重新部署全局副本；
4. 在 `logs\<conv-id>\` 留一条变更日志。

## 9. 快速参考卡

| 我要… | 用 |
|---|---|
| 读一份 PDF | `vision_read_document`（文字层自动优先） |
| 读扫描件/截图/标签 | `vision_ocr` |
| 看一张照片/图表讲清楚 | `vision_describe` |
| 问图里"有几个/在哪/是什么" | `vision_ask` |
| 抄型号、序列号、数字 | `vision_ocr`（**永远不要用 VLM 抄数字**） |
| 表格 | `vision_ocr` |
| 查后端状态 | `vision_status` |
'@
$policy = $policy.Replace('__DATE__', (Get-Date).ToString('yyyy-MM-dd'))
$pp = 'E:\Deepseek\policy\ai-tool-policy.md'
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($pp, $policy, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
Write-Output ('policy doc: ' + $pp + '  (' + (Get-Item -LiteralPath $pp).Length + ' bytes)')

$json = @'
{
  "policyVersion": "1.0.0",
  "updatedAt": "__DATE__",
  "policyDoc": "policy\\ai-tool-policy.md",
  "scope": "all workspaces and conversations",

    { "name": "vision_describe", "backend": "Qwen2.5-VL-3B INT4 (OpenVINO GenAI)", "device": "NPU", "latencyMs": [11000, 18000], "useFor": "figures, charts, diagrams, scenes, photos", "limits": "auto crop + downscale to <=980 visual tokens" },

  ],
  "hardLimits": {

    { "name": "image_generate", "planned": "SDXL then Flux.1-schnell via OpenVINO", "device": "iGPU" },

'@
$json = $json.Replace('__DATE__', (Get-Date).ToString('yyyy-MM-dd'))
$jp = 'E:\Deepseek\policy\ai-tools.json'
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($jp, $json, (New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
try { $o = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($jp, [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8) | ConvertFrom-Json; Write-Output ('policy json: OK  tools=' + @($o.tools).Count + ' routing=' + @($o.routing).Count) } catch { Write-Output ('policy json ERROR: ' + $_.Exception.Message) }", "description": "Write AI tool policy and machine config", "timeoutMs": 300000}

| 大图必被降采样 | 4096×2730 的照片会被降到 **26%**（940 token） | 主体/姿态/配色可靠；**面部、纹理、小字会丢** → 裁切或改 OCR |
| PP-OCR 走 CPU | 上游 `compile_model(..., device_name="CPU")` 写死 | 1–4 s/页可接受，NPU 留给 VLM；**不要声称 OCR 用了 NPU** |

| VLM 输出长度 | 约 400–900 字符/次（受 `max_new_tokens` 限制） | 长文档**逐页**读，不要指望一次读完 |

## 4. 结果可信度与验证（写进回答里的硬要求）

1. **可信度分级**：文字层 = 精确；PP-OCR = 高（逐字准确，实测与文字层一致）；VLM = **中等偏低**（语义可靠、细节不可靠）。
2. **凡引用数字/型号/规格**：必须来自文字层或 OCR；若只有 VLM 结果，须标注"**未经 OCR 校验**"。
3. **回答里给出来源**：说明用了哪个工具、什么设备、耗时多少（如"文字层，瞬时"、"PP-OCR 4.1 s"、"VLM/NPU 17 s"）。
4. **不确定就说**：VLM 对品类/型号的判断经常不准，不要把它当作事实转述。

## 5. 调用规范

1. **路径**：全部传**绝对 Windows 路径**；PDF 用 `vision_read_document`（不要先转图再 OCR）。
2. **分页**：`pages` 支持 `'1'`、`'1,3'`、`'2-5'`；`dpi` 默认 150（表格/小字可提到 200–300，但单页像素别超 80 万太多，否则 VLM 会被降采样）。

5. **跨工作区写入**：`D:\AI_file` 在工作区之外，写入需 `danger-full-access` 提权；只读调用无需提权。
6. **调用失败先看日志**：`D:\AI_file\logs\vision-mcp.log` 记录了每次调用的设备、耗时、裁剪/降采样与重试过程。

## 6. 隐私与成本

- **全部本地推理**：无网络请求，**数据不出本机**。涉密/客户资料可以放心交给这些工具。
- **无 API 费用**：本地算力，不需要节省调用次数；但要**节省时间**——按第 2 节路由选最合适的工具。
- 需要外部模型（紫东太初等）时，走云端需另经许可，**不得默认外发**。

# 全局对话输出文件存放准则（对所有工作区生效）

本文件是 `%DSH_HOME%\AGENTS.md` 的可维护副本，由 DSH 自动注入到**每一个对话**。
维护源在 `E:\Deepseek\policy\deploy\global-agents.md`；修改后运行
`E:\Deepseek\tools\Install-GlobalPolicy.ps1` 重新部署。

## 规则 1 · 先建目录，再产出文件

在当前工作区根目录下确保存在以下英文类别目录，并在每个类别下建立**本对话的子目录**：

```
deliverables\  logs\  scripts\  workspace\  data\  archive\
```

子目录名统一为 `conv-<yyyyMMdd>-<token>`：token = `$env:DSH_SESSION_ID` 中 UUID 的前 8 位
十六进制小写（无会话 ID 时用本地时间 `HHmmss`），例如 `conv-20260928-3b54e160`。
**同一对话在所有类别下使用同一个子目录名**；已存在则复用，不得另建第二个。

## 规则 2 · 工作区自带规范优先

若当前工作区存在 `policy\storage-policy.json` 或 `policy\output-storage-policy.md`，以其中的类别与
命名配置为准；若存在 `tools\New-ConversationWorkspace.ps1`，先运行它（本机 shell 为
Windows PowerShell 5.1，无 `pwsh`）：

```powershell
powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\tools\New-ConversationWorkspace.ps1
```

不存在时按规则 1 手工创建；参考实现与完整准则见 `E:\Deepseek\policy\output-storage-policy.md`。

## 规则 3 · 文件放哪里

| 内容 | 位置 |
|---|---|
| 交给用户的最终交付物 | `deliverables\<conv-id>\` |
| 命令输出、运行日志、会话元信息 | `logs\<conv-id>\` |
| 为本次对话编写的脚本 | `scripts\<conv-id>\` |
| 临时文件、中间产物 | `workspace\<conv-id>\` |
| 输入数据、样例 | `data\<conv-id>\` |
| 被取代的版本、结项留存 | `archive\<conv-id>\` |

工作区根目录只放 `AGENTS.md`、`README.md`、`policy\`、`tools\`、`reference_file\` 与上述类别目录；
禁止把产物丢在根目录、桌面、`%TEMP%` 或源目录里。
`reference_file\` 是**用户投放参考资料的共享目录**（非对话专属）：**Agent 只读**，
不得删除、移动、改名或覆盖其中任何文件；用户投放的文件豁免 ASCII 命名规则（允许中文名），
Agent 在其中新建的文件仍须遵守；允许子目录，读取时递归；清理或归档仅在用户明确要求时进行。

## 规则 4 · 命名（兼容性优先）

目录名与文件名只用 ASCII：`A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ -`；**禁止中文、空格、emoji、全角字符**；统一小写，
词间用 `-`；避开 Windows 保留名（`CON` `PRN` `AUX` `NUL` `COM1-9` `LPT1-9`）。
日志与带时间戳的文件用 `yyyyMMdd-HHmmss` 前缀，不用“最终版/最新版”这类含糊后缀。

## 规则 5 · 运行环境缺失时

1. **先检测**：`Get-Command <tool>`、`where.exe <tool>`、查 `D:\program_runtime_environment\registry.json`；
   已在 PATH 的不得重复安装。本机已就绪：`nodejs` 24.20.0、`python` 3.14.7。
2. **归类安装**：装到 `D:\program_runtime_environment\<category>\`，category 为语言/工具大类，
   小写英文：`nodejs` `python` `java` `dotnet` `go` `rust` `cli` `browsers` `databases` `caches`。
   同一环境多版本放 `<category>\<version>\`。**不同环境必须归类，禁止混放，禁止在根目录散放可执行文件。**
3. 安装包暂存 `_downloads\`，包管理器缓存放 `_caches\<tool>\`；下载后先用**官方 SHA-256 +
   Authenticode 签名**双重校验再安装。
4. **登记**：安装后更新 `D:\program_runtime_environment\registry.json`
   （可运行 `D:\program_runtime_environment\tools\Add-RuntimeEnvironment.ps1`；
   该脚本已禁用位置参数绑定，数组参数必须用命名参数传入）。
5. **提权**：D 盘在工作区之外，文件沙箱会拒绝写入；先向用户申请 `danger-full-access` 提权再执行。
   不得为绕开限制而改装到工作区内、`C:\` 根目录或用户目录根。
6. **AI 专用文件**：本地 AI 的运行时、模型、数据集、虚拟环境一律放 **`D:\AI_file`**（用户指定），

- 最终回复必须列出交付文件的完整路径；属于交付物的文件用 `present` 工具呈现。
- 超过约 50 行的命令输出写入 `logs\<conv-id>\<yyyyMMdd-HHmmss>-<tool>.log`，聊天只给路径与摘要。
- 交付物被新版本取代时，旧版移入 `archive\<conv-id>\`，不就地覆盖历史版本。

## 规则 1 · 先建目录，再产出文件

在当前工作区根目录下确保存在以下英文类别目录，并在每个类别下建立**本对话的子目录**：

```

十六进制小写（无会话 ID 时用本地时间 `HHmmss`），例如 `conv-20260928-3b54e160`。
**同一对话在所有类别下使用同一个子目录名**；已存在则复用，不得另建第二个。

## 规则 2 · 工作区自带规范优先

不存在时按规则 1 手工创建；参考实现与完整准则见 `E:\Deepseek\policy\output-storage-policy.md`。

## 规则 3 · 文件放哪里

| 内容 | 位置 |
|---|---|
| 交给用户的最终交付物 | `deliverables\<conv-id>\` |
| 命令输出、运行日志、会话元信息 | `logs\<conv-id>\` |
| 为本次对话编写的脚本 | `scripts\<conv-id>\` |
| 临时文件、中间产物 | `workspace\<conv-id>\` |

工作区根目录只放 `AGENTS.md`、`README.md`、`policy\`、`tools\`、`reference_file\` 与上述类别目录；
禁止把产物丢在根目录、桌面、`%TEMP%` 或源目录里。
`reference_file\` 是**用户投放参考资料的共享目录**（非对话专属）：**Agent 只读**，
不得删除、移动、改名或覆盖其中任何文件；用户投放的文件豁免 ASCII 命名规则（允许中文名），
Agent 在其中新建的文件仍须遵守；允许子目录，读取时递归；清理或归档仅在用户明确要求时进行。

## 规则 4 · 命名（兼容性优先）

目录名与文件名只用 ASCII：`A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ -`；**禁止中文、空格、emoji、全角字符**；统一小写，
词间用 `-`；避开 Windows 保留名（`CON` `PRN` `AUX` `NUL` `COM1-9` `LPT1-9`）。

1. **先检测**：`Get-Command <tool>`、`where.exe <tool>`、查 `D:\program_runtime_environment\registry.json`；

3. 安装包暂存 `_downloads\`，包管理器缓存放 `_caches\<tool>\`；下载后先用**官方 SHA-256 +

4. **登记**：安装后更新 `D:\program_runtime_environment\registry.json`

## 规则 6 · 交付与日志

- 最终回复必须列出交付文件的完整路径；属于交付物的文件用 `present` 工具呈现。
- 超过约 50 行的命令输出写入 `logs\<conv-id>\<yyyyMMdd-HHmmss>-<tool>.log`，聊天只给路径与摘要。
- 交付物被新版本取代时，旧版移入 `archive\<conv-id>\`，不就地覆盖历史版本。

| 现象 | 原因 | 对策 |
|---|---|---|
| `write` / `edit` 报 `EISDIR: illegal operation on a directory` | 工作区在 exFAT 卷上（如 `E:\Deepseek`），不支持硬链接 | 改用 PowerShell 直写：`[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($p,$t,(New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))` |

`Valid`），任一不符即停止安装。

本机已部署本地视觉工具（MCP，模型侧名形如 `mcp__vision__vision_ocr`），**全部本地推理、无网络、无费用**。

- **允许仅凭 VLM 回答，但必须提示**：只来自视觉模型的内容须标注"未与文字层/OCR 交叉校验"，

  #!/usr/bin/env python

  import torch.nn as nn
  
  from .yolo_head import YOLOXHead
  from .yolo_pafpn import YOLOPAFPN
  
  
  class YOLOX(nn.Module):
      """
      YOLOX model module. The module list is defined by create_yolov3_modules function.
      The network returns loss values from three YOLO layers during training
      and detection results during test.
      """
  
      def __init__(self, backbone=None, head=None):
          super().__init__()
          if backbone is None:
              backbone = YOLOPAFPN()
          if head is None:
              head = YOLOXHead(80)
  
          self.backbone = backbone
          self.head = head
  
      def forward(self, x, targets=None):
          # fpn output content features of [dark3, dark4, dark5]
          fpn_outs = self.backbone(x)
  
          if self.training:
              assert targets is not None
              loss, iou_loss, conf_loss, cls_loss, l1_loss, num_fg = self.head(
                  fpn_outs, targets, x
              )
              outputs = {
                  "total_loss": loss,
                  "iou_loss": iou_loss,
                  "l1_loss": l1_loss,
                  "conf_loss": conf_loss,
                  "cls_loss": cls_loss,
                  "num_fg": num_fg,
              }
          else:
              outputs = self.head(fpn_outs)
  
          return outputs

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

{"command": "$py = @'
"""YOLOX-Tiny detector: preprocess, OpenVINO inference, YOLOX decode + NMS. Validation run."""
import os
import time

import numpy as np
import openvino as ov
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw

XML = r"D:\AI_file\models\yolox-tiny\openvino\yolox-tiny.xml"
OUT_DIR = r"D:\AI_file\outputs"
os.makedirs(OUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)
SIZE = 416
STRIDES = (8, 16, 32)

COCO = ("person bicycle car motorcycle airplane bus train truck boat traffic_light fire_hydrant stop_sign "
        "parking_meter bench bird cat dog horse sheep cow elephant bear zebra giraffe backpack umbrella "
        "handbag tie suitcase frisbee skis snowboard sports_ball kite baseball_bat baseball_glove skateboard "
        "surfboard tennis_racket bottle wine_glass cup fork knife spoon bowl banana apple sandwich orange "
        "broccoli carrot hot_dog pizza donut cake chair couch potted_plant bed dining_table toilet tv "
        "laptop mouse remote keyboard cell_phone microwave oven toaster sink refrigerator book clock vase "
        "scissors teddy_bear hair_drier toothbrush").split()
assert len(COCO) == 80, len(COCO)

core = ov.Core()
_cache = {}


def compiled(device):
    if device not in _cache:
        _cache[device] = core.compile_model(XML, device)
    return _cache[device]


def preprocess(img, size=SIZE):
    r = min(size / img.size[1], size / img.size[0])
    resized = img.resize((int(img.size[0] * r), int(img.size[1] * r)), Image.BILINEAR)
    canvas = Image.new("RGB", (size, size), (114, 114, 114))
    canvas.paste(resized, (0, 0))
    arr = np.asarray(canvas, dtype=np.float32)[:, :, ::-1]                     # BGR
    arr = (arr - np.array([123.675, 116.28, 103.53], dtype=np.float32)) / np.array([58.395, 57.12, 57.375], dtype=np.float32)
    return np.ascontiguousarray(arr.transpose(2, 0, 1)[None]), r


def nms(boxes, scores, iou_thr):
    order = scores.argsort()[::-1]
    keep = []
    while order.size > 0:
        i = order[0]
        keep.append(i)
        if order.size == 1:
            break
        xx1 = np.maximum(boxes[i, 0], boxes[order[1:], 0])
        yy1 = np.maximum(boxes[i, 1], boxes[order[1:], 1])
        xx2 = np.minimum(boxes[i, 2], boxes[order[1:], 2])
        yy2 = np.minimum(boxes[i, 3], boxes[order[1:], 3])
        w = np.maximum(0.0, xx2 - xx1)
        h = np.maximum(0.0, yy2 - yy1)
        inter = w * h
        area_i = (boxes[i, 2] - boxes[i, 0]) * (boxes[i, 3] - boxes[i, 1])
        area_o = (boxes[order[1:], 2] - boxes[order[1:], 0]) * (boxes[order[1:], 3] - boxes[order[1:], 1])
        iou = inter / (area_i + area_o - inter + 1e-9)
        order = order[1:][iou <= iou_thr]
    return keep


def postprocess(out, ratio, img_size, conf=0.25, iou=0.45):
    pred = out[0]                                    # (3549, 85)
    boxes_xywh = pred[:, :4]
    scores = pred[:, 4:5] * pred[:, 5:]              # obj * cls
    cls_ids = scores.argmax(axis=1)
    cls_scores = scores[np.arange(scores.shape[0]), cls_ids]
    mask = cls_scores >= conf
    if not mask.any():
        return []
    b = boxes_xywh[mask]
    s = cls_scores[mask]
    c = cls_ids[mask]
    xyxy = np.empty_like(b)
    xyxy[:, 0] = b[:, 0] - b[:, 2] / 2
    xyxy[:, 1] = b[:, 1] - b[:, 3] / 2
    xyxy[:, 2] = b[:, 0] + b[:, 2] / 2
    xyxy[:, 3] = b[:, 1] + b[:, 3] / 2
    xyxy /= ratio                                     # undo letterbox
    xyxy[:, [0, 2]] = xyxy[:, [0, 2]].clip(0, img_size[0])
    xyxy[:, [1, 3]] = xyxy[:, [1, 3]].clip(0, img_size[1])
    dets = []
    for cls in np.unique(c):
        idx = np.where(c == cls)[0]
        for k in nms(xyxy[idx], s[idx], iou):
            dets.append((float(s[idx][k]), int(cls), xyxy[idx][k].tolist()))
    dets.sort(reverse=True)
    return dets


def detect(path, device="NPU", conf=0.25, iou=0.45):
    img = Image.open(path).convert("RGB")
    blob, ratio = preprocess(img)
    req = compiled(device).create_infer_request()
    req.infer({0: blob})
    out = req.get_output_tensor(0).data.copy()
    return img, postprocess(out, ratio, img.size, conf, iou), out


if __name__ == "__main__":
    PHOTO = r"E:\Deepseek\reference_file\720421F869216DB8CE295D95710712E5.png"
    print("=== 参考照片（4096x2730，扭蛋机 cosplay 场景） ===")
    for dev in ("NPU", "CPU"):
        t0 = time.perf_counter()
        img, dets, raw = detect(PHOTO, dev)
        dt = time.perf_counter() - t0
        print("  %-4s %.0f ms  detections=%d" % (dev, dt * 1000, len(dets)))
        for score, cls, box in dets[:8]:
            print("      %-14s %.3f  [%5.0f, %5.0f, %5.0f, %5.0f]" % (COCO[cls], score, box[0], box[1], box[2], box[3]))
        if dev == "NPU":
            npu_raw = raw
            drawn = img.copy()
            d = ImageDraw.Draw(drawn)
            for score, cls, box in dets[:30]:
                d.rectangle(box, outline=(255, 0, 0), width=max(3, img.size[0] // 300))
                d.text((box[0] + 6, box[1] + 6), "%s %.2f" % (COCO[cls], score), fill=(255, 255, 0))
            out_path = os.path.join(OUT_DIR, "detect-reference-photo.jpg")
            drawn.save(out_path, quality=90)
            print("  annotated: " + out_path)
        else:
            diff = float(np.abs(raw - npu_raw).max())
            print("  NPU vs CPU max abs diff on raw output: %.4f" % diff)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- YOLOX detector

DETECT_XML = os.environ.get("DSH_DETECT_MODEL", r"D:\AI_file\models\yolox-tiny\openvino\yolox-tiny.xml")
DETECT_SIZE = int(os.environ.get("DSH_DETECT_SIZE", "416"))
OUTPUT_DIR = os.environ.get("DSH_OUTPUT_DIR", r"D:\AI_file\outputs")
COCO_CLASSES = (
    "person bicycle car motorcycle airplane bus train truck boat traffic_light fire_hydrant stop_sign "
    "parking_meter bench bird cat dog horse sheep cow elephant bear zebra giraffe backpack umbrella "
    "handbag tie suitcase frisbee skis snowboard sports_ball kite baseball_bat baseball_glove skateboard "
    "surfboard tennis_racket bottle wine_glass cup fork knife spoon bowl banana apple sandwich orange "
    "broccoli carrot hot_dog pizza donut cake chair couch potted_plant bed dining_table toilet tv "
    "laptop mouse remote keyboard cell_phone microwave oven toaster sink refrigerator book clock vase "
    "scissors teddy_bear hair_drier toothbrush").split()

_det_models: dict[str, object] = {}


def detector(device: str):
    with _lock:
        compiled = _det_models.get(device)
        if compiled is None:
            import openvino as ov

            if not os.path.isfile(DETECT_XML):
                raise FileNotFoundError("detector IR not found: %s" % DETECT_XML)
            t0 = time.perf_counter()
            compiled = ov.Core().compile_model(DETECT_XML, device)
            _det_models[device] = compiled
            log("YOLOX-Tiny loaded on %s in %.1fs" % (device, time.perf_counter() - t0))
        return compiled


def detect_preprocess(image, size: int):
    import numpy as np

    ratio = min(size / image.size[1], size / image.size[0])
    resized = image.resize((int(image.size[0] * ratio), int(image.size[1] * ratio)), Image.BILINEAR)
    canvas = Image.new("RGB", (size, size), (114, 114, 114))
    canvas.paste(resized, (0, 0))
    arr = np.asarray(canvas, dtype=np.float32)[:, :, ::-1]          # YOLOX takes BGR
    arr = (arr - np.array([123.675, 116.28, 103.53], dtype=np.float32)) / np.array([58.395, 57.12, 57.375], dtype=np.float32)
    return np.ascontiguousarray(arr.transpose(2, 0, 1)[None]), ratio


def _nms(boxes, scores, iou_thr):
    import numpy as np

    order = scores.argsort()[::-1]
    keep = []
    while order.size > 0:
        i = order[0]
        keep.append(int(i))
        if order.size == 1:
            break
        xx1 = np.maximum(boxes[i, 0], boxes[order[1:], 0])
        yy1 = np.maximum(boxes[i, 1], boxes[order[1:], 1])
        xx2 = np.minimum(boxes[i, 2], boxes[order[1:], 2])
        yy2 = np.minimum(boxes[i, 3], boxes[order[1:], 3])
        inter = np.maximum(0.0, xx2 - xx1) * np.maximum(0.0, yy2 - yy1)
        area_i = (boxes[i, 2] - boxes[i, 0]) * (boxes[i, 3] - boxes[i, 1])
        area_o = (boxes[order[1:], 2] - boxes[order[1:], 0]) * (boxes[order[1:], 3] - boxes[order[1:], 1])
        iou = inter / (area_i + area_o - inter + 1e-9)
        order = order[1:][iou <= iou_thr]
    return keep


def detect(image_path: str, device: str, conf: float, iou: float, max_det: int, wanted: list[str]):
    import numpy as np
    from PIL import Image as _Image

    if not os.path.isfile(image_path):
        raise FileNotFoundError("image not found: %s" % image_path)
    image = _Image.open(image_path).convert("RGB")
    blob, ratio = detect_preprocess(image, DETECT_SIZE)
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    request = detector(device).create_infer_request()
    request.infer({0: blob})
    elapsed = time.perf_counter() - t0
    pred = request.get_output_tensor(0).data[0]                     # (3549, 85)
    scores_all = pred[:, 4:5] * pred[:, 5:]
    cls_ids = scores_all.argmax(axis=1)
    cls_scores = scores_all[np.arange(scores_all.shape[0]), cls_ids]
    keep_mask = cls_scores >= conf
    results = []
    if keep_mask.any():
        boxes = pred[keep_mask, :4]
        scores = cls_scores[keep_mask]
        classes = cls_ids[keep_mask]
        xyxy = np.empty_like(boxes)
        xyxy[:, 0] = boxes[:, 0] - boxes[:, 2] / 2
        xyxy[:, 1] = boxes[:, 1] - boxes[:, 3] / 2
        xyxy[:, 2] = boxes[:, 0] + boxes[:, 2] / 2
        xyxy[:, 3] = boxes[:, 1] + boxes[:, 3] / 2
        xyxy /= ratio
        xyxy[:, [0, 2]] = xyxy[:, [0, 2]].clip(0, image.size[0])
        xyxy[:, [1, 3]] = xyxy[:, [1, 3]].clip(0, image.size[1])
        for cls in np.unique(classes):
            idx = np.where(classes == cls)[0]
            for k in _nms(xyxy[idx], scores[idx], iou):
                name = COCO_CLASSES[int(cls)] if int(cls) < len(COCO_CLASSES) else str(int(cls))
                if wanted and name not in wanted and str(int(cls)) not in wanted:
                    continue
                results.append({"label": name, "class_id": int(cls), "score": round(float(scores[idx][k]), 3),
                                "box": [int(v) for v in xyxy[idx][k]]})
    results.sort(key=lambda d: -d["score"])
    return image, results[:max_det], elapsed


def annotate(image, detections):
    from PIL import ImageDraw

    drawn = image.copy()
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(drawn)
    width = max(3, image.size[0] // 300)
    for det in detections:
        draw.rectangle(det["box"], outline=(255, 0, 0), width=width)
        draw.text((det["box"][0] + width * 2, det["box"][1] + width * 2),
                  "%s %.2f" % (det["label"], det["score"]), fill=(255, 255, 0))
    os.makedirs(OUTPUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)
    name = "detect-%s-%s.jpg" % (os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(image_path))[0][:40], datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S"))
    path = os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, name)
    drawn.save(path, quality=90)
    return path

<system-reminder>
Updated instructions from: ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md

This file changed after it was loaded. Use the following content instead of the previously loaded instructions from this file.

# 全局对话输出文件存放准则（对所有工作区生效）

本文件是 `%DSH_HOME%\AGENTS.md` 的可维护副本，由 DSH 自动注入到**每一个对话**。
维护源在 `E:\Deepseek\policy\deploy\global-agents.md`；修改后运行
`E:\Deepseek\tools\Install-GlobalPolicy.ps1` 重新部署。

## 规则 1 · 先建目录，再产出文件

在当前工作区根目录下确保存在以下英文类别目录，并在每个类别下建立**本对话的子目录**：

```
deliverables\  logs\  scripts\  workspace\  data\  archive\
```

子目录名统一为 `conv-<yyyyMMdd>-<token>`：token = `$env:DSH_SESSION_ID` 中 UUID 的前 8 位
十六进制小写（无会话 ID 时用本地时间 `HHmmss`），例如 `conv-20260928-3b54e160`。
**同一对话在所有类别下使用同一个子目录名**；已存在则复用，不得另建第二个。

## 规则 2 · 工作区自带规范优先

若当前工作区存在 `policy\storage-policy.json` 或 `policy\output-storage-policy.md`，以其中的类别与
命名配置为准；若存在 `tools\New-ConversationWorkspace.ps1`，先运行它（本机 shell 为
Windows PowerShell 5.1，无 `pwsh`）：

```powershell
powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\tools\New-ConversationWorkspace.ps1
```

不存在时按规则 1 手工创建；参考实现与完整准则见 `E:\Deepseek\policy\output-storage-policy.md`。

## 规则 3 · 文件放哪里

| 内容 | 位置 |
|---|---|
| 交给用户的最终交付物 | `deliverables\<conv-id>\` |
| 命令输出、运行日志、会话元信息 | `logs\<conv-id>\` |
| 为本次对话编写的脚本 | `scripts\<conv-id>\` |
| 临时文件、中间产物 | `workspace\<conv-id>\` |
| 输入数据、样例 | `data\<conv-id>\` |
| 被取代的版本、结项留存 | `archive\<conv-id>\` |

工作区根目录只放 `AGENTS.md`、`README.md`、`policy\`、`tools\`、`reference_file\` 与上述类别目录；
禁止把产物丢在根目录、桌面、`%TEMP%` 或源目录里。
`reference_file\` 是**用户投放参考资料的共享目录**（非对话专属）：**Agent 只读**，
不得删除、移动、改名或覆盖其中任何文件；用户投放的文件豁免 ASCII 命名规则（允许中文名），
Agent 在其中新建的文件仍须遵守；允许子目录，读取时递归；清理或归档仅在用户明确要求时进行。

## 规则 4 · 命名（兼容性优先）

目录名与文件名只用 ASCII：`A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ -`；**禁止中文、空格、emoji、全角字符**；统一小写，
词间用 `-`；避开 Windows 保留名（`CON` `PRN` `AUX` `NUL` `COM1-9` `LPT1-9`）。
日志与带时间戳的文件用 `yyyyMMdd-HHmmss` 前缀，不用“最终版/最新版”这类含糊后缀。

## 规则 5 · 运行环境缺失时

1. **先检测**：`Get-Command <tool>`、`where.exe <tool>`、查 `D:\program_runtime_environment\registry.json`；
   已在 PATH 的不得重复安装。本机已就绪：`nodejs` 24.20.0、`python` 3.14.7。
2. **归类安装**：装到 `D:\program_runtime_environment\<category>\`，category 为语言/工具大类，
   小写英文：`nodejs` `python` `java` `dotnet` `go` `rust` `cli` `browsers` `databases` `caches`。
   同一环境多版本放 `<category>\<version>\`。**不同环境必须归类，禁止混放，禁止在根目录散放可执行文件。**
3. 安装包暂存 `_downloads\`，包管理器缓存放 `_caches\<tool>\`；下载后先用**官方 SHA-256 +
   Authenticode 签名**双重校验再安装。
4. **登记**：安装后更新 `D:\program_runtime_environment\registry.json`
   （可运行 `D:\program_runtime_environment\tools\Add-RuntimeEnvironment.ps1`；
   该脚本已禁用位置参数绑定，数组参数必须用命名参数传入）。
5. **提权**：D 盘在工作区之外，文件沙箱会拒绝写入；先向用户申请 `danger-full-access` 提权再执行。

# vision_detect 落地报告（YOLOX-Tiny → OpenVINO → NPU）

- 日期：__TS__ ｜ 对话：`conv-20260928-3b54e160`
- 依据策略：`policy\ai-tool-policy.md` v1.2.0（`vision_detect` 由"预留"转为"已部署"）
- 结果：**第 6 个 MCP 工具上线**，NPU 热态 **7 ms/帧**，MCP 协议实测通过

---

## 1. 选型与来源（可追溯）

| 项 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| 模型 | **YOLOX-Tiny**（Megvii），80 类 COCO，anchor-free |
| 许可 | **Apache-2.0**（符合策略里的许可证要求；避开了 Ultralytics 的 AGPL） |
| 权重 | `yolox_tiny.pth`，40,726,661 B，来自 **OpenVINO Model Zoo 官方镜像** |
| 校验 | **SHA-384 与 `model.yml` 公布值完全一致** ✓（`9083e8c9…cd8138`） |
| 权威配方 | OMZ 的 `models/public/yolox-tiny/model.yml`（输入 416×416、均值/方差、BGR、输出名 `output`） |

**一个自查纠正**：我第一次把公布值当成 SHA-256 去比对，报了 MISMATCH；实际那是 **SHA-384**（96 个十六进制字符），
文件大小与官方一致，换对算法后 **MATCH**。**教训：先看校验值长度再选算法**（64=SHA-256，96=SHA-384，128=SHA-512）。

## 2. 转换（PyTorch → OpenVINO IR）

- 从 GitHub API 取回导出所需的 YOLOX 源码（锁定 commit `69f1173a`），打了两个补丁：
  `loguru` → 桩类；`from yolox.utils import bboxes_iou` → 包内相对导入。
- `torch.load` → `load_state_dict(strict=True)`：**missing=0 / unexpected=0** ✓
- **直接 fx 转换**（`ov.convert_model(model, example_input=...)`）成功，**2.6 s**，未走 ONNX 弯路。
- 转换后是动态形状 → `reshape([1,3,416,416])` 固定为静态（**NPU 的硬要求**），IR 落盘 9.6 MB。
- torch 输出 `[1, 3549, 85]` 与 OpenVINO 输出**完全一致** ✓

## 3. 三设备实测（416×416，纯推理）

| 设备 | 加载 | 推理 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| **NPU** | 1.3 s | **7.0 ms** | 默认设备 |
| GPU（iGPU） | 2.1 s | **2.2 ms** | 最快 |
| CPU | 0.2 s | 21.4 ms | 后备 |

**NPU 与 CPU 的检测结果逐框一致**（分数差 ≤0.001），跨设备数值可靠。

## 5. 能力边界（诚实记录）

- **YOLOX-Tiny + 416 分辨率**：框的位置稳定，但**类别会错**——实测把扭蛋机认成 `suitcase`（0.6）、
  把兔耳认成 `dog`（0.25），人物置信度只有 0.375。
- **正确用法**：定位/计数（框在哪、几个）可靠；**类别判断要留余地**；要精确类别应微调训练。
- 大图（4096×2730）预处理约 1.4 s（PIL 缩放），推理只占 7 ms——**瓶颈在预处理，不在 NPU**。
- 想提精度有两条现成路：① 导出 **640×640** 变体；② 换 **YOLOX-S**（同源同许可，权重同样有官方镜像）。

`vision_detect` 现在是**可微调的底座**：把 COCO 头换成缺陷类别、用 `D:\AI_file\datasets\` 里的数据训练，
再按同一路径导出 IR 即可复用这条流水线（`vision_detect` 的 `DSH_DETECT_MODEL` 环境变量可指向新 IR）。
配合尚未上线的 `anomaly_score`（Anomalib），就构成路线 C1 的"有监督定位 + 无监督异常"双支。

content.arguments:
{"command": "$py = @'
"""Generate a self-contained synthetic surface-defect dataset (no third-party licence entanglement).

Layout follows the MVTec AD convention so Anomalib can consume it directly:
  train/good/*.png, test/good/*.png, test/<defect>/*.png, ground_truth/<defect>/*_mask.png
"""
import os

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw

ROOT = r"D:\AI_file\datasets\synthetic-defect-v1"
SIZE = 256
CLASSES = ["scratch", "stain", "missing_hole", "crack", "dent"]
N_TRAIN_GOOD, N_TEST_GOOD, N_TEST_BAD = 40, 10, 5


def base_part(rng):
    """A grey machined plate with a 5x5 grid of drilled holes, plus lighting and texture noise."""
    img = np.full((SIZE, SIZE), 148.0, np.float32)
    yy, xx = np.mgrid[0:SIZE, 0:SIZE].astype(np.float32)
    img += 10.0 * np.sin(xx / SIZE * np.pi) + 6.0 * np.cos(yy / SIZE * np.pi)      # lighting gradient
    img += rng.normal(0, 3.2, (SIZE, SIZE))                                        # surface texture
    pil = Image.fromarray(np.clip(img, 0, 255).astype(np.uint8), "L").convert("RGB")
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(pil)
    cx0 = rng.integers(28, 40)
    step = 44
    for i in range(5):
        for j in range(5):
            cx = int(cx0 + i * step + rng.integers(-1, 2))
            cy = int(cx0 + j * step + rng.integers(-1, 2))
            r = 9
            draw.ellipse([cx - r, cy - r, cx + r, cy + r], fill=(96, 96, 96), outline=(58, 58, 58), width=2)
            draw.ellipse([cx - r + 3, cy - r + 3, cx + r - 3, cy + r - 3], fill=(74, 74, 74))
    return pil


def add_defect(kind, img, rng):
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
    mask = Image.new("L", (SIZE, SIZE), 0)
    mdraw = ImageDraw.Draw(mask)
    if kind == "scratch":
        x0, y0 = rng.integers(30, 150), rng.integers(40, 210)
        x1, y1 = x0 + rng.integers(60, 120), y0 + rng.integers(-40, 40)
        w = int(rng.integers(2, 4))
        draw.line([x0, y0, x1, y1], fill=(205, 205, 205), width=w)
        mdraw.line([x0, y0, x1, y1], fill=255, width=w + 2)
    elif kind == "stain":
        cx, cy = rng.integers(60, 200), rng.integers(60, 200)
        r = int(rng.integers(12, 22))
        draw.ellipse([cx - r, cy - r, cx + r, cy + r], fill=(104, 104, 104))
        mdraw.ellipse([cx - r - 2, cy - r - 2, cx + r + 2, cy + r + 2], fill=255)
    elif kind == "missing_hole":
        i, j = rng.integers(0, 5), rng.integers(0, 5)
        cx, cy = int(33 + i * 44), int(33 + j * 44)
        draw.ellipse([cx - 13, cy - 13, cx + 13, cy + 13], fill=(150, 150, 150))
        mdraw.ellipse([cx - 14, cy - 14, cx + 14, cy + 14], fill=255)
    elif kind == "crack":
        i = int(rng.integers(0, 5))
        cx, cy = int(33 + i * 44), int(rng.integers(50, 200))
        pts = [(cx, cy)]
        for k in range(4):
            cx += int(rng.integers(-16, 17))
            cy += int(rng.integers(12, 26))
            pts.append((cx, cy))
        draw.line(pts, fill=(70, 70, 70), width=2)
        mdraw.line(pts, fill=255, width=4)
    else:  # dent
        cx, cy = rng.integers(70, 190), rng.integers(70, 190)
        r = int(rng.integers(18, 28))
        for k in range(6, 0, -1):
            shade = 150 - k * 9
            rr = int(r * k / 6)
            draw.ellipse([cx - rr, cy - rr, cx + rr, cy + rr], fill=(shade, shade, shade))
        mdraw.ellipse([cx - r, cy - r, cx + r, cy + r], fill=255)
    return img, mask


def save(img, path):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
    img.save(path)


def main():
    rng = np.random.default_rng(20261004)
    counts = {}
    for n in range(N_TRAIN_GOOD):
        save(base_part(rng), os.path.join(ROOT, "train", "good", "%03d.png" % n))
    counts["train/good"] = N_TRAIN_GOOD
    for n in range(N_TEST_GOOD):
        save(base_part(rng), os.path.join(ROOT, "test", "good", "%03d.png" % n))
    counts["test/good"] = N_TEST_GOOD
    for kind in CLASSES:
        for n in range(N_TEST_BAD):
            img, mask = add_defect(kind, base_part(rng), rng)
            save(img, os.path.join(ROOT, "test", kind, "%03d.png" % n))
            save(mask, os.path.join(ROOT, "ground_truth", kind, "%03d_mask.png" % n))
        counts["test/" + kind] = N_TEST_BAD
    print("dataset root: " + ROOT)
    for k, v in counts.items():
        print("  %-18s %d images" % (k, v))
    total = sum(counts.values())
    print("  total %d images (%d normal, %d anomalous)" % (total, N_TRAIN_GOOD + N_TEST_GOOD, total - N_TRAIN_GOOD - N_TEST_GOOD))

    # contact sheet for quick visual verification
    sheet = Image.new("RGB", (SIZE * 6, SIZE), (20, 20, 20))
    sheet.paste(Image.open(os.path.join(ROOT, "train", "good", "000.png")), (0, 0))
    for k, kind in enumerate(CLASSES):
        sheet.paste(Image.open(os.path.join(ROOT, "test", kind, "000.png")), (SIZE * (k + 1), 0))
    out = r"D:\AI_file\datasets\synthetic-defect-v1\contact-sheet.png"
    sheet.save(out)
    print("contact sheet: " + out)


main()

"""Generate a self-contained synthetic surface-defect dataset (no third-party licence entanglement).

Layout follows the MVTec AD convention so Anomalib can consume it directly:
  train/good/*.png, test/good/*.png, test/<defect>/*.png, ground_truth/<defect>/*_mask.png
"""
import os

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw

ROOT = r"D:\AI_file\datasets\synthetic-defect-v1"
SIZE = 256
CLASSES = ["scratch", "stain", "missing_hole", "crack", "dent"]
N_TRAIN_GOOD, N_TEST_GOOD, N_TEST_BAD = 40, 10, 5


def base_part(rng):
    """A grey machined plate with a 5x5 grid of drilled holes, plus lighting and texture noise."""
    img = np.full((SIZE, SIZE), 148.0, np.float32)
    yy, xx = np.mgrid[0:SIZE, 0:SIZE].astype(np.float32)
    img += 10.0 * np.sin(xx / SIZE * np.pi) + 6.0 * np.cos(yy / SIZE * np.pi)      # lighting gradient
    img += rng.normal(0, 3.2, (SIZE, SIZE))                                        # surface texture
    pil = Image.fromarray(np.clip(img, 0, 255).astype(np.uint8), "L").convert("RGB")
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(pil)
    cx0 = rng.integers(28, 40)
    step = 44
    for i in range(5):
        for j in range(5):
            cx = int(cx0 + i * step + rng.integers(-1, 2))
            cy = int(cx0 + j * step + rng.integers(-1, 2))
            r = 9
            draw.ellipse([cx - r, cy - r, cx + r, cy + r], fill=(96, 96, 96), outline=(58, 58, 58), width=2)
            draw.ellipse([cx - r + 3, cy - r + 3, cx + r - 3, cy + r - 3], fill=(74, 74, 74))
    return pil


def add_defect(kind, img, rng):
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
    mask = Image.new("L", (SIZE, SIZE), 0)
    mdraw = ImageDraw.Draw(mask)
    if kind == "scratch":
        x0, y0 = rng.integers(30, 150), rng.integers(40, 210)
        x1, y1 = x0 + rng.integers(60, 120), y0 + rng.integers(-40, 40)
        w = int(rng.integers(2, 4))
        draw.line([x0, y0, x1, y1], fill=(205, 205, 205), width=w)
        mdraw.line([x0, y0, x1, y1], fill=255, width=w + 2)
    elif kind == "stain":
        cx, cy = rng.integers(60, 200), rng.integers(60, 200)
        r = int(rng.integers(12, 22))
        draw.ellipse([cx - r, cy - r, cx + r, cy + r], fill=(104, 104, 104))
        mdraw.ellipse([cx - r - 2, cy - r - 2, cx + r + 2, cy + r + 2], fill=255)
    elif kind == "missing_hole":
        i, j = rng.integers(0, 5), rng.integers(0, 5)
        cx, cy = int(33 + i * 44), int(33 + j * 44)
        draw.ellipse([cx - 13, cy - 13, cx + 13, cy + 13], fill=(150, 150, 150))
        mdraw.ellipse([cx - 14, cy - 14, cx + 14, cy + 14], fill=255)
    elif kind == "crack":
        i = int(rng.integers(0, 5))
        cx, cy = int(33 + i * 44), int(rng.integers(50, 200))
        pts = [(cx, cy)]
        for k in range(4):
            cx += int(rng.integers(-16, 17))
            cy += int(rng.integers(12, 26))
            pts.append((cx, cy))
        draw.line(pts, fill=(70, 70, 70), width=2)
        mdraw.line(pts, fill=255, width=4)
    else:  # dent
        cx, cy = rng.integers(70, 190), rng.integers(70, 190)
        r = int(rng.integers(18, 28))
        for k in range(6, 0, -1):
            shade = 150 - k * 9
            rr = int(r * k / 6)
            draw.ellipse([cx - rr, cy - rr, cx + rr, cy + rr], fill=(shade, shade, shade))
        mdraw.ellipse([cx - r, cy - r, cx + r, cy + r], fill=255)
    return img, mask


def save(img, path):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
    img.save(path)


def main():
    rng = np.random.default_rng(20261004)
    counts = {}
    for n in range(N_TRAIN_GOOD):
        save(base_part(rng), os.path.join(ROOT, "train", "good", "%03d.png" % n))
    counts["train/good"] = N_TRAIN_GOOD
    for n in range(N_TEST_GOOD):
        save(base_part(rng), os.path.join(ROOT, "test", "good", "%03d.png" % n))
    counts["test/good"] = N_TEST_GOOD
    for kind in CLASSES:
        for n in range(N_TEST_BAD):
            img, mask = add_defect(kind, base_part(rng), rng)
            save(img, os.path.join(ROOT, "test", kind, "%03d.png" % n))
            save(mask, os.path.join(ROOT, "ground_truth", kind, "%03d_mask.png" % n))
        counts["test/" + kind] = N_TEST_BAD
    print("dataset root: " + ROOT)
    for k, v in counts.items():
        print("  %-18s %d images" % (k, v))
    total = sum(counts.values())
    print("  total %d images (%d normal, %d anomalous)" % (total, N_TRAIN_GOOD + N_TEST_GOOD, total - N_TRAIN_GOOD - N_TEST_GOOD))

    # contact sheet for quick visual verification
    sheet = Image.new("RGB", (SIZE * 6, SIZE), (20, 20, 20))
    sheet.paste(Image.open(os.path.join(ROOT, "train", "good", "000.png")), (0, 0))
    for k, kind in enumerate(CLASSES):
        sheet.paste(Image.open(os.path.join(ROOT, "test", kind, "000.png")), (SIZE * (k + 1), 0))
    out = r"D:\AI_file\datasets\synthetic-defect-v1\contact-sheet.png"
    sheet.save(out)
    print("contact sheet: " + out)


main()

Same error with pandas 2.3.3 → so it's **not** a pandas version issue. It's a **dataset layout** issue:

```
ValueError: NumPy boolean array indexing assignment cannot assign 25 input values to the 35 output values where the mask is true
```
35 abnormal samples found, 25 masks available.

So anomalib treats **35 images as abnormal** — that means `abnormal_dir="test"` makes it scan ALL of `test/` (10 good + 25 defects = 35), and `normal_test_dir="test/good"` is applied *later* — but the mask lookup expects masks only for the 25 real defects → mismatch.

Looking at the anomalib source logic (line ~246): it computes `abnormal` samples (from abnormal_dir) and their masks. With `abnormal_dir="test"` **and** `normal_test_dir="test/good"`, the normal test images get filtered... but apparently the filtering happens after the mask assignment, or the `label == ABNORMAL` mask query returns 35 rows because the good test images are inside the abnormal dir.

The standard MVTec recipe in anomalib docs:
```python
datamodule = Folder(
    name="mvtec",
    root="./datasets/MVTec",
    normal_dir="train/good",
    abnormal_dir="test",
    normal_test_dir="test/good",
    mask_dir="ground_truth",
    ...
)
```
Hmm, that IS the documented recipe... but maybe in 2.6.2 the expected usage is different: perhaps `abnormal_dir="test"` should be `abnormal_dir="test"` with the good images NOT under test/ (MVTec has test/good though!). So the recipe should work.

Wait — maybe the issue is my *order*: in the mask_dir, for each abnormal image, anomalib looks up `<mask_dir>/<defect>/<name>_mask.png`. My masks are named `%03d_mask.png` while the images are `%03d.png` ✓ that matches MVTec convention.

Hmm, so why 35 vs 25? Let me look at the source to understand:
```python
samples.loc[samples.label == DirType.ABNORMAL.value, "mask_path"] = samples.loc[
    samples.label == DirType.ABNORMAL.value, "image_path"
].apply(...)
```
If `samples` has 35 rows with label ABNORMAL (because "good" images under `test/` were marked abnormal — perhaps because `normal_test_dir` handling differs), then the assignment would produce 35 values, not 25. The error says the *input* has 25 values and the *target mask* has 35 true entries — so the RHS produced 25 values (masks found for 25 images) while the LHS mask selects 35 rows. That means: among the 35 rows labeled ABNORMAL, only 25 have masks (the real defects) — the other 10 are the "good" test images that got labeled ABNORMAL.

So: **anomalib 2.6.2 labeled my `test/good/*` images as ABNORMAL**. Why? Because with `abnormal_dir="test"`, the good test images ARE inside the abnormal dir; anomalib 2.6 presumably expects `normal_test_dir` to point to a directory *outside* `abnormal_dir`... 

Hmm, but the MVTec recipe works in their docs/tests... Possibly the recipe expects `abnormal_dir="test"` and `normal_test_dir="test/good"` and anomalib handles the overlap by excluding the normal_test_dir subtree from the abnormal scan. Maybe the exclusion is based on path prefix and my Windows paths with backslashes break it? Hmm.

Practical fix (avoid depending on that logic): **restructure my dataset** so normal test images are NOT under the abnormal dir:
```
train/good/*.png
test/good/*.png          → keep for reference
test_abnormal/<defect>/*.png
ground_truth/<defect>/*_mask.png
```
i.e., pass `abnormal_dir="test_abnormal"`, `normal_test_dir="test/good"` → clean separation, no overlap.

That's a small dataset change (move `test/<defect>` → `test_abnormal/<defect>`). Let me do that: physically move the 5 defect folders to `test_abnormal/`.

Then update the script accordingly.

Let me also handle masks: `mask_dir="ground_truth"` ✓ (structure `ground_truth/<defect>/<file>_mask.png`).

Let me do it: move folders + patch the script + rerun.

Also — to be efficient, let me check the anomalib source quickly to confirm the expectation... no, the empirical fix is clear and cheap. Let me just restructure.

import inspect
import os
import time

import numpy as np
import openvino as ov

XML = r"D:\AI_file\models\patchcore-synth-v1\weights\openvino\model.xml"

print("inputs :")
for i in model.inputs:
    print("   %-16s %s  %s" % (i.get_any_name(), i.get_partial_shape(), i.get_element_type()))
print("outputs:")
for o in model.outputs:
    print("   %-16s %s  %s" % (o.get_any_name(), o.get_partial_shape(), o.get_element_type()))

print()
print("=== anomalib.deploy 里可用的推理封装 ===")
import anomalib.deploy as dep
names = [n for n in dir(dep) if not n.startswith("_")]
print("  ", ", ".join(names))
for n in names:
    obj = getattr(dep, n)
    if inspect.isclass(obj):
        try:
            print("   %-24s %s" % (n, str(inspect.signature(obj.__init__))[:150]))
        except Exception:
            print("   %-24s (no signature)" % n)

print()
print("=== 三设备编译测试（输入 1x3x256x256 float32） ===")
x = np.zeros((1, 3, 256, 256), dtype=np.float32)
for dev in ("NPU", "GPU", "CPU"):
    try:
        t0 = time.perf_counter()
        compiled = core.compile_model(model, dev)
        load = time.perf_counter() - t0
        req = compiled.create_infer_request()
        t0 = time.perf_counter()
        res = req.infer({0: x})
        dt = time.perf_counter() - t0
        outs = []
        for o in compiled.outputs:
            arr = res[o]
            outs.append("%s%s range[%.3f, %.3f]" % (o.get_any_name(), list(arr.shape), float(np.min(arr)), float(np.max(arr))))
        print("  %-4s load %6.1fs infer %7.1f ms  %s" % (dev, load, dt * 1000, " | ".join(outs)))
    except Exception as exc:
        print("  %-4s FAILED %s" % (dev, str(exc).replace("\n", " ")[:200]))
